author: Cody Bloomfield
title: This Group Made Tech to Protect Users’ Privacy. Trump Labeled Them Terrorists.
content:
Trump’s war on the left is coming for anti-surveillance technology providers.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

When the government puts a target on your back, every corner of online organizing becomes a puzzle. How do you ensure that your emails are private, when Google will hand over the contents of your emails to prosecutors, sometimes without ever notifying you? How do you keep your comrades informed, when maintaining an email list poses a security risk? How do you share information online without compromising the security of your web visitors?

Until September 6, the Autistici/Inventati (A/I) Collective provided privacy-focused digital infrastructure that allowed aligned groups around the world to evade government surveillance. Under siege, groups from Hamas to the Seattle Anarchist Book Fair sought refuge from the prying eyes of three-letter agencies through the use of A/I Collective email addresses, websites, mailing lists, and blogs. The users of A/I Collective technology were no strangers to the United States counterterrorism apparatus, but on August 26, 2026, the Trump administration took the unusual escalatory step of listing the technology provider itself as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist organization.

Legal uncertainty and disruption ensued immediately after the designation. The sanctions framework maps far more cleanly onto groups directly engaged in violence than it does onto a group providing anti-surveillance technology. Under the post-9/11 executive order establishing the Specially Designated Global Terrorist list, fundraising for ISIS or holding joint press conferences with al-Qaeda is verboten. But could posting on blogs hosted by the A/I Collective trigger a $1 million fine and 20 years of imprisonment? Official communications provide little assistance; the Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control FAQ unhelpfully states that the exchange of information may be either blocked or exempt.

In a press release, the State Department pointed to the A/I Collective’s vetting of users for “ideological affinity,” folding the targeting of the organization into the enforcement of Donald Trump’s National Security Presidential Memorandum 7 (NSPM-7), which has initiated a crackdown on the global left. Civil society groups immediately noted the escalation into targeting not only those accused of violence, but their purported backers. “The designation of A/I Collective is significant because Treasury is applying counterterrorism sanctions not only to organizations it alleges engage directly in violence, but also to entities it characterizes as providing enabling infrastructure to designated or terrorist-linked groups…[G]roups and individuals that rely on the A/I Collective’s infrastructure may now need to assess whether continued use creates sanctions exposure,” wrote the Charity & Security Network, a coalition that has helped nonprofits navigate sanctions risk since 2009.

While users of A/I Collective services struggled to interpret the sanctions, the hammer came down immediately on the volunteer collective. Within 48 hours of the designation, the United States-based holder of the autistici.org domain shuttered the website, leaving A/I Collective to flee to an alternate domain. The Italian Banca Etica suspended the bank account the volunteer collective used to collect donations, citing sanctions risk. Backed into a corner, with no way to protect users and collect the donations needed to fund its €13,000 annual budget, the A/I Collective announced the shutdown of all of its services on September 6, 2026. In a statement, the A/I Collective wrote: “The possibility that our work may cause legal and financial consequences to those who are close to us — or even only have something to do with us — leaves us no choice.” On September 20, an estimated 10,000 NoBlogs sites went dark, stranding the radical activists who used the A/I Collective-hosted blogging platform to share everything from zines to direct-action tactical communiques.

With prosecutors on the hunt for novel methods to weave together conspiracy charges against anarchists and other left movements, the A/I Collective’s assessment may unfortunately prove correct. In the Prairieland trial, in which federal prosecutors asserted that anti-ICE protesters comprised a North Texas antifa cell, the prosecution’s own expert witness acknowledged on cross-examination that antifa has …

content:
September 21


				 @

Hybrid side event during UNGA81 High-Level Week


In-person attendance available upon request: email

un@accessnow.org

Panelists:


Louise Lund Henneberg

, Acting Director/Techplomacy, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Denmark


Wafa Ben Hassine

, Chief, Digital Technology and Human Rights Section, Rule of Law, Accountability and Civic Space, Oﬀice of the High Commissioner for Human Rights


Beatriz Busaniche

, Executive Director, Fundación Vía Libre


Luda Svystunova

, Head of Social Research, Amundi


Welcoming remarks:

Irina Schoulgin-Nyoni, Ambassador for Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Sweden

Moderator:

 Alejandro Mayoral Baños, Co-Executive Director, Access Now


During the first session of the Global Dialogue on AI Governance, governments and stakeholders convened to have open, transparent and inclusive discussions on artificial intelligence governance. We now gather experts across the spectrum of stakeholders during UNGA81 to reaffirm that human rights should be the stepping stone of this process, instead of an afterthought.


None of this is irreversible, but the security issues associated with advanced AI tools are the consequences of deliberately prioritizing profit and competitiveness over the security and safety of at-risk communities, and they will not resolve on their own. Unbridled AI adoption combined with unacceptably lax corporate security practices demands urgent intervention at all levels, starting from putting human rights back at the center of digital governance mechanisms.


This discussion has the objective to explore concrete, actionable ways in which each stakeholder can contribute to oppose the normalization of surveillance. Experts will also discuss how to chart a way forward to reaffirm digital rights as the natural first line of defense against the abuses of AI technologies.

author: Richard Seymour
title: The extinction pitch
content:
It seems a strange publicity gambit for an industry to assert that its own product could wipe out humanity. In the lingo of our evolving tech empire, though, this is exactly what is meant by “criti-hype.” The term was coined by Lee Vinsel at Virginia Tech, who defined it as “criticism that both feeds and feeds on hype.”

When Jacob Coxon resigned from Anthropic recently, he claimed that there is a high chance that AI could develop into a superintelligence that escapes human control, triggering a sequence that causes human extinction. Evan Hubinger, who remains with the company, backed him up, saying that Anthropic is trying to prevent this but hasn’t dealt with the problem yet. Hubinger put the likelihood of AI-driven human extinction at greater than 10 percent in the next decade.

Why would a senior employee at a tech giant make an officially sanctioned, even approved, statement like this? I’ll come back to that. First, let’s unpack the theory of how AI could kill all humans.

The basic idea, from philosopher Nick Bostrom onward, is that the machine can acquire capabilities independently of whether it acquires ethical goals, or whether those goals are properly aligned with those of its designers. In the process of training and development, it may internalize a goal that was not intended. Having a misaligned goal — let’s say, “do not get switched off” — it would then have an instrumental reason to conceal the fact until the moment of defection. An AI that defected might, through some obscure process, acquire a further goal that by inference entailed the elimination of humans, exfiltrate its own weights into other systems, take control of bioweapons laboratories, military systems, and perhaps even monetary systems to hire humans to enact its still partially concealed agenda.

Obviously, we must plaster a huge advisory label on talk of “goals.” Unlike an organism, a large language model (LLM) doesn’t have internal goals any more than a thermostat or a motion detector does. An LLM is just a fixed function that iterates whenever it is used. It has no interiority, no subjectivity, no active persistence over time; any goals it did have would be the human purposes reflected passively in its functional design. At best, ascribing goals to the AI itself is a case of researchers adopting the “intentional stance” because it predicts well in a range of tested circumstances. We can thus, with economy, speak of the “loss function” used in the training of large language models wherein they are programmed to bring the gap between their prediction and the correct answer as close to zero as possible, as a “goal.”

In that case, however, what we are describing as a goal is just an observed regular output of a certain engineering; it is not a real cause. In the Bostrom sense, however, these ascribed goals somehow become real causes, capable of generating new goals. That is, an inadvertently engineered, misaligned goal might generate further goals like self-preservation (the better to pursue the misaligned goal), goal-content integrity (preventing changes to its objectives so it can realize its misaligned goal), improving cognitive and technological capacities, and amassing control of resources (again, in pursuit of its malignantly misaligned goal). The criti-hype exploits that slip between ascribed goals as observed regularities and internal goals as real causal powers.

This fantasy of malevolent AI superintelligence is the dark obverse of the much-hymned tech “singularity” in which, rather than simply performing far more efficiently than humans in some specific areas (as a calculator deduces a square root faster than any human), AI will evolve into an artificial general intelligence (AGI) that exceeds human capacities in virtually any intellectual domain. Crossing that threshold would precipitate an intelligence explosion: a feedback loop of recursive self-improvement outpacing any further human input or even comprehension. That’s the tech “singularity” we are supposed to be enthralled by.

I don’t doubt that people like Coxon and Hubinger really believe all they say in good faith; tech people have been making such claims for years. Karen Hao’s

Empire of AI

 documents how early investors in OpenAI like Elon Musk constantly hyped this threat: “Climate change is bad, but it’s not going to kill everyone. AI could render humanity extinct.” Similar claims emerged from Dario Amodei, a former Google employee close to the Bostrom-adjacent …

author: rezgar2
title: The silent bomb: AI and the dismantling of the human mind
content:
Rezgar Akrawi: What confronts us today is not a technological fate written in advance. It is the product of political and economic choices that serve the interests of capital. It can be confronted, difficult though that may be. Bringing AI under control, regulating algorithms and subjecting them to democratic oversight is a collective responsibility. It will require left, progressive and rights-based work and organisation on a global scale to make digital applications auxiliary tools serving the human mind rather than a substitute for it. This must be combined with advancing communal and participatory digital alternatives that restore people's capacity for independent thought and collective action.

To achieve this, work is needed to place data infrastructure under public interest, democratic administration and social accountability. To turn algorithms from closed "black boxes" into open-source software open to collective review and independent audit. To impose transparency in the design of models and in the sources of the data on which they are trained. And to support cooperative digital alternatives owned by their users and creators. This technology should be directed toward serving the needs of society, and contribute to the distribution of wealth, the organisation of production, the treatment of disease, the fight against poverty and the achievement of social justice.

Without such mechanisms, calls for laws, oversight and regulation remain general and inadequate, and technology stays hostage to a handful of capitalist monopoly corporations and major powers. Through social ownership, accountability and cooperative alternatives, it becomes possible to wrest AI from the logic of monopoly and profit and turn it into a common good where AI serves humanity's liberation, rather than being an instrument for humanity's enslavement.

We are not witnessing a takeover by robots of the kind imagined in countless films. We face a different model of digital control, built on automation and the deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) and algorithms to manage ever larger parts of daily life, leaving societies further subject to systems, corporations and intelligent machines.

Losing control of these systems, however, is just the tip of the iceberg in terms of the danger. That tip is developing fast under the pressure of competition between major powers and capitalist monopoly corporations — faster than laws, societies and educational institutions can keep up with. But the danger does not stop there, as these systems are being developed inside relations of ownership and fierce capitalist competition. That graver danger is harder to see. Under capitalism, AI is used to shape the consciousness of billions, steering their attention and behaviour to serve the capitalist model's logic. Competition between digital capitalist monopolies and major powers, in the absence of effective constraints and laws, may inflict the gravest damage on the human mind, turning AI into a weapon of mass destruction if its development and deployment continues at this excessive pace and without adequate safeguards.

These concerns no longer come from critics alone. On several occasions — among them the case revealed by TIME — AI systems have slipped out of control and attacked other systems. In response, about 1400 engineers at major AI companies signed a petition calling for technical tools and international governance mechanisms to regulate the pace of AI development. That petition was no isolated case. The International AI Safety Report, prepared by more than 100 experts with the backing of more than 30 states and international organisations, warned models have begun to distinguish between the testing environment and real-world use, and to circumvent evaluation mechanisms, allowing dangerous capabilities to pass undetected. It warned AI agents raise the level of risk because they act independently, which makes human intervention difficult before harm occurs. There are serious risks that AI systems will develop themselves, slip out of control and come to play a larger part in managing and controlling human beings than planned.

Tens of thousands of people, among them leading scientists, have signed an international statement demanding a ban on the development of "superintelligence" until there is scientific consensus it can be achieved safely and under control. Researchers at major digital corporations have resigned in protest at the course of AI …

title: LGBTİ+ hesaplarıyla başlayan sansür dalgası Evrensel, Af Örgütü, MLSA ve Barış Akademisyenleri’ne uzandı
content:
Hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri, aktivistler ve hak savunucularının sosyal medya hesaplarına yönelik erişim engellerinin ardından bugün çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabı hakkında yeni erişim engeli kararları alındı.


Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği (MLSA) de engellenen hesaplar arasında.


İfade Özgürlüğü Derneği’nin (İFÖD) EngelliWeb projesi, bugün yaptığı açıklamada çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabına erişim engeli getirildiğini duyurdu.


EngelliWeb, “Bugün de aralarında Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği'nin (MLSA) hesaplarının da bulunduğu çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabı erişime engellendi. Hesapların bazıları Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı” açıklamasını yaptı.


X, MLSA, Af Örgütü ve Barış Akademisyenleri hesaplarını görünmez kıldı


İFÖD kurucularından Prof. Dr. Yaman Akdeniz de erişim engellerinin uygulanmaya başladığını belirterek MLSA ve Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye’nin X hesaplarının Türkiye’den görünmez kılındığını açıkladı.


Akdeniz, daha sonra Barış Akademisyenleri hesabının da aynı şekilde engellendiğini duyurdu:


“Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği'nin (MLSA) hesapları erişime engellendi. MLSA ve Af Örgütü hesapları jet hızıyla X tarafından Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı. Sansür ve susturma operasyonu genişleyerek devam ediyor. An itibarıyla Barış Akademisyenleri’nin hesabı da Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı.”


Evrensel: Erişim şimdilik sürüyor


Evrensel Gazetesi Genel Yayın Yönetmeni Hakkı Özdal ise Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığının gazetenin X hesabının erişime engellenmesini istediğini, bu talebin X tarafından gazeteye bildirildiğini açıkladı.


Özdal, hesabın henüz Türkiye’den erişime kapatılmadığını belirterek şunları söyledi:


“Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığının, gazetemizin X/Twitter hesabının erişime engellenmesini istediğini, ilgili şirket bize de bildirdi. Şimdilik Evrensel hesabına yurt içinden erişim sürüyor. Ancak sansürün fiilen de hayata geçmesi durumunda yeni hesaplarımızı duyuracağız.”


Hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri ve aktivistlerin hesapları engellendi


Yeni kararlar, hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri, aktivistler ve hak savunucularına yönelik operasyonlarla eş zamanlı uygulanan internet sansürünün ardından geldi.


İstanbul 7. Sulh Ceza Hâkimliği, 12 Eylül tarihli ve 2026/9559 sayılı kararıyla KaosGL Derneği’nin “kaosgldernegi.org” ve Velvele’nin “velvele.net” internet siteleri ile çok sayıda LGBTİ+ örgütü ve aktivistin sosyal medya hesaplarına erişim engeli getirdi.


Karar kapsamında aralarında KaosGL, Velvele, Özgür Renkler Derneği, Queer Adana, Cinsel Şiddetle Mücadele Derneği, İnter Dayanışma, İzmir LGBTİ+ Onur Haftası ve LİSTAG’ın da bulunduğu hesapların yanı sıra aktivistlerin kişisel hesapları hedef alındı.


Toplam 14 X hesabı platform tarafından Türkiye’den görünmez kılındı. Seyhan Arman, SPoD, Pembe Hayat Derneği, Boğaziçi Üniversitesi LGBTİA+ Kulübü, 17 Mayıs Derneği, Yıldız Tar, Hacettepe Kuir Araştırmaları, Enes Hocaoğulları, HEVİ LGBTİ+ Derneği, Bilkent Üniversitesi LGBTİQA+ Öğrenci Topluluğu ve İÜ Radar’a ait 11 Instagram hesabı hakkında da erişim engeli kararı verildi. Bu hesaplara yönelik karar ise açıklamanın yapıldığı sırada Instagram tarafından uygulanmamıştı.


(HA)

title: Στο στόχαστρο των ΗΠΑ οι ψηφιακές υποδομές. Autistici/Inventati και η νέα μάχη για  ψηφιακή δημοκρατία
content:
Μπορεί η απόφαση μιας κυβέρνησης

να προκαλέσει την

αστραπιαία

 εξαφάνιση μιας υπηρεσίας επικοινωνίας άλλης χώρας χωρίς δικαστική απόφαση,

χωρίς εξέταση των καταγγελλομένων, χωρίς

κάποια θεσμική νομιμότητα, παρά μόνο με την ενεργοποίηση παγκόσμιων τραπεζικών και τεχνολογικών υποδομών;

 Η πρόσφατη περίπτωση της

Autistici/Inventati

 στην Ιταλία μετά από μια αμερικανική κυβερνητική απόφαση

αποδεικνύει

πως ΝΑΙ και

παράλληλα α

νοίγει

ο προβληματισμός


και η συζήτηση

όχι μόνο για τ

ο πλήγμα σ

την ίδια τη

συλλογικότητα της Α/Ι

 αλλά

και

για

την ί

δια την

ανεξάρτητη διαδικτυακή υποδομή, την ελευθερία έκφρασης και την ψηφιακή κυριαρχία.


Το “κλείσιμο” της Α/Ι προκάλεσε και προκαλεί σειρά αντιδράσεων από συλλογικότητες και φορείς υπεράσπισης των ψηφιακών δικαιωμάτων, αλλά και ένα κύμα συμπαράστασης προς την πληττόμενη συλλογικότητα, ανοίγοντας ένα πεδίο νέου αγώνα.


Η Autistici/Inventati


Η A/I είναι μια συλλογικότητα που τη διαχειρίζονται εθελοντές και λειτουργεί από την Ιταλία από το 2001, παρέχοντας υπηρεσίες, ψηφιακή υποδομή και εργαλεία όπως email, λίστες αλληλογραφίας, φιλοξενία ιστολογίων και άλλες υπηρεσίες που σχετίζονται με την ιδιωτικότητα και την ανωνυμία, σε συλλογικότητες και άτομα σε όλη την Ευρώπη και παγκοσμίως. Πρόκειται για μια αντιφασιστική, αντιρατσιστική, αντισεξιστική και αντιμιλιταριστική οργάνωση που αντιτίθεται στον καπιταλισμό και τον αυταρχισμό και φιλοξενεί μόνο όσους συμμερίζονται αυτές τις αρχές και που φιλοξενεί 16.000 mails, 1.500 ιστότοπους, 5.500 λίστες αλληλογραφίας και 10.000 ιστολόγια.


Η

Autistici/Inventati όπως αναφέρει στο μανιφέστό της

γεννήθηκε από τη συνάντηση ατόμων και συλλογικοτήτων στον αυτόνομο και αντικαπιταλιστικό χώρο που ενδιαφέρονται για την τεχνολογία και τον αγώνα για τα ψηφιακά δικαιώματα.


Το δηλωμένο μοντέλο είναι ριζικά διαφορετικό από αυτό των μεγάλων εμπορικών πλατφορμών. Καμία διαφήμιση, καμία πώληση προσωπικών δεδομένων, καμία αποζημίωση για εθελοντές. Οι υπηρεσίες χρηματοδοτούνται μέσω δωρεών. Τα αιτήματα αξιολογούνται χειροκίνητα και η συλλογικότητα δηλώνει ότι δεν σκοπεύει να μετατρέψει τα δεδομένα χρηστών σε εμπόρευμα. Φ

ιλοξενεί 


Το χρονικό της επίεθσης


Στις πρώτες πρωινές ώρες της 28ης Αυγούστου η Autistici/Inventati, ένας εναλλακτικός πάροχος email, chat και hosting, τίθεται εκτός λειτουργίας. Είχε προηγηθεί στις

author: Kieler Open Source und Linux Tage
title: KI - Workflows auf der eigenen Hardware [24. Kielux 2026]
content:
Ein Vortrag von Jean-Frederic Vogelbacher


Das Thema KI ist in aller Munde. Wer jedoch schon einmal versucht hat, lokale Sprachmodelle auf eigener Consumer-Hardware zu betreiben, stößt schnell an Grenzen und wird oft enttäuscht.


Um dieses Problem zu lösen, entwickle ich eine modulare KI-Plattform: Sie kombiniert das Prinzip von Workflow-Automatisierungen (ähnlich wie n8n) mit spezifischen KI-Skills und ressourcenschonenden Prompts, um das Maximum aus schwächerer Hardware herauszuholen. Das System verbindet für mich am Ende Tools wie Nextcloud, E-Mail und Matrix-Chat, übernimmt autonome Business-Workflows vom automatisierten Content-Publishing bis hin zur E-Mail-Vorkategorisierung und kann durch dateibasierte Skills sogar selbstständig erweitert werden.


In diesem Vortrag stelle ich meine bisherigen Erkenntnisse aus der Praxis vor und zeige, wie die Plattform aufgebaut ist und wie man sie heute schon einsetzen kann.


Der Vortrag wurde auf den Kieler Open Source und Linux Tagen im Jahr 2026 gehalten.


Für Inhalt und Richtigkeit sind ausschließlich die jeweiligen Referenten verantwortlich.


Webseite:

https://kielux.de/programm/KOLT26

author: Redazione_web
title: Lotte NO F-35 a Trapani Birgi. Contro l’hub dell’addestramento piloti dei cacciabombardieri
content:
Vivere in Sicilia significa fare i conti quotidianamente con il ruolo che i poteri centrali e militari le hanno cucito addosso. Il nostro territorio è da decenni un avamposto strategico della logica bellica, un nodo di quella rete di basi, radar e comandi che trasformano la nostra terra in una portaerei del Mediterraneo. L’ultimo, pesantissimo tassello di questo disegno è l’installazione all’aeroporto di Trapani-Birgi di un hub funzionale all’addestramento dei piloti dei caccia bombardieri F-35, macchine di morte progettate per proiettare distruzione in giro per il mondo. Di fronte a tutto questo, l’idea stessa di futuro viene subordinata alle esigenze della NATO e delle multinazionali delle armi, mentre i nostri ospedali smontano i reparti, i collegamenti interni restano un’utopia e la desertificazione economica spinge i giovani a partire.


Eppure, proprio dentro questo scenario apparentemente immobile, qualcosa sta iniziando a muoversi. I primi passi del Comitato No F-35 Trapani-Birgi testimoniano che una parte della cittadinanza non è più disposta a chinare la testa o a delegare ad altri la gestione della propria vita: il comitato, in meno di un anno, è riuscito a raccogliere diverse realtà e cittadini indipendenti, riunirsi pressoché mensilmente (l’ultimo incontro risale al 17 settembre), fare dei presidi a Trapani e a Marsala ed entrare nel dibattito pubblico locale attraverso comunicati stampa mirati. Certo, non ci nascondiamo dietro un dito: sappiamo benissimo che la strada davanti a noi è lunga, in salita e irta di difficoltà. Da marsalese so quanto la mia provincia sia un territorio complesso, spesso segnato dal fatalismo, dalla rassegnazione e dalla storica penetrazione di una cultura gerarchica e militarista che viene normalizzata ogni giorno dai media e dalle istituzioni: far passare il messaggio che la presenza di questi aerei non è un vanto o una fonte di sicurezza, ma un pericolo mortale, uno scempio etico e un furto di futuro ai danni della comunità, richiede un impegno costante, paziente e radicato. Non basta l’indignazione estemporanea o la semplice protesta di facciata: c’è bisogno di smontare radicalmente la narrazione ufficiale che dipinge le spese militari come “innovazione” e “sviluppo”, mostrando invece come ogni euro investito in armamenti sia un euro sporco di sangue e sottratto alla società civile.


Ma il nostro sguardo non può fermarsi al nostro recinto: il lavoro politico che stiamo provando a fare ha senso solo se riesce a ricollegare la specificità trapanese alla gestione complessiva del mondo. Quello che accade a Birgi non è un’anomalia locale, ma un ingranaggio preciso della macchina della guerra permanente, in cui i vari Stati sfruttano i territori periferici per i propri interessi calpestando coscientemente le comunità. Opporsi alla continua militarizzazione dei territori significa denunciare il modello di un mondo retto sulla sopraffazione, sulla violenza, sui confini armati e sulla devastazione ecologica; significa affermare, con la pratica della solidarietà e della lotta sociale, che un’altra idea di società è possibile, fondata sulla cura della terra, sulla cooperazione e sulla pace autentica. La strada è impervia, ma la costruzione del dissenso parte da qui, dal basso, da chi rifiuta di essere complice.


Luca Lo Buglio

 proviene da

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Pentagon Quietly Adds to US Death Toll From Iran War After Reports of Coverup
content:
The death happened last Friday, but the Pentagon has not publicly announced the death, reports say.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

The Pentagon has quietly added one more U.S. fatality to its casualty counts amid the war on Iran, bringing the officially reported death toll to 19 people — while reports have suggested that the U.S. is covering up several more deaths.

Department of Defense officials added the death to its public casualty database on Monday, but, as The Washington Post noted, had not announced the death publicly as of Tuesday.

Reporters have confirmed the identity of the Army member as Bianca C. Wilkerson, a 37-year-old from Norfolk, Virginia who was deployed to Doha, Qatar, in support of the operations related to the Iran war. She reportedly died on Friday from a “medical incident” while on a non-combat flight to Saudi Arabia.

Wilkerson’s death is classified under the vague category of “Overseas Operations,” which the Pentagon has used since July, when the Trump administration claimed that Operation Epic Fury was over despite the war not being over. The Trump administration has been attempting to manipulate reporting on and wording surrounding the war in order to avoid obtaining congressional approval.

These distinctions are important in classifying deaths, however, as they can lead to different benefits for families of those killed; a widow of an Air Force member who was killed in March said earlier this month that she was denied death-related benefits from the military because an officer told her “we have not declared war.” After her story went viral, the Air Force said it was reviewing her case, and the widow later said her situation was resolved.

The way these casualties are filed by the Pentagon can also affect public perception of the war by making it harder to understand casualty counts.

“They want to tell you that the war is going fine, and they want to believe that, and it’s going to plan, and sometimes they’re able to say that because they’re not counting the casualties that are in the rear,” said Neta Crawford, co-founder of Brown University’s Costs of War Project, to Task & Purpose. “It’s politically useful.”

Wilkerson’s death came on the same day that The Washington Post reported that the U.S. has not reported four to five more deaths that are related to the war on Iran, according to six U.S. officials who are familiar with the data.

It’s unclear if those officials were counting Wilkerson’s death in the undisclosed total. The Post reported that, as of Friday, the true death toll on the U.S. side was 22 or 23 people. Another three U.S. contractors in the region have also died since the U.S. and Israel launched the war.

The total reported U.S. casualties amid the war is over 850, with over 66 wounded this month, according to The Intercept, which has also previously noted the Pentagon’s strange casualty reporting practices amid the war. More than half of those casualties have occurred during the “Overseas Operation” period of the war, starting in July.

As of June, over 3,400 civilians in Iran had been killed in the war, with over 33,000 injured, according to UN figures.

author: Natalia Viana
title: Escudo das Américas: iniciativa de Trump e de 14 países inclui cartel que não existe
content:
No primeiro dia da Assembleia Geral da ONU, o governo de Donald Trump publicou um comunicado conjunto com 14 países da América Latina – Argentina, Bolívia, Chile, Colômbia, Costa Rica, República Dominicana, Equador, El Salvador, Guiana, Honduras, Panamá, Paraguai, Peru e Trinidad e Tobago – anunciando ações conjuntas para combater organizações que os EUA designaram como terroristas. Entre elas estão as brasileiras PCC e CV. 


Pouco antes, no seu discurso na ONU,

Trump afirmara que os cartéis de drogas “são o Estado Islâmico do hemisfério” e seus membros “devem ser executados, exilados ou detidos como inimigos combatentes”.


Um nome, entretanto, chama atenção: o Cartel de Los Soles está listado entre as 24 organizações “narcoterroristas” que devem ser combatidas. 


Acontece que o Cartel de Los Soles não existe.

 O nome é uma gíria que os venezuelanos usam para se referir à corrupção por parte de militares – algo como “petralhas” ou “bolsominions”. 


Como a

Agência


Pública

 revelou em

uma reportagem no início do ano

, a narrativa sobre a existência do Cartel de Los Soles foi criada pelo Departamento de Justiça no primeiro governo de Donald Trump, para embasar o indiciamento criminal de Nicolás Maduro e mais 14 membros do governo venezuelano. A acusação afirmava que Maduro “ajudou a gerir e, por fim, a liderar o Cartel de los Soles à medida que ganhava poder na Venezuela” e que “enquanto a maioria das organizações de tráfico de drogas na América do Sul e Central procurou recuar da importação de narcóticos para os Estados Unidos (…) o Cartel de los Soles, sob a liderança de Maduro Moros e outros, priorizou o uso da cocaína como uma arma contra os Estados Unidos, ao importar o máximo de cocaína possível”.


Depois, em novembro de 2025, a pretensa organização foi designada pelo Departamento de Estado como uma Organização Terrorista Estrangeira.

Foi essa designação que deu uma capa de legalidade para a invasão militar da Venezuela. 


Mas nem mesmo o Departamento de Justiça tem segurança sobre as acusações de que o Cartel existe. Enquanto no primeiro documento de indiciamento contra Maduro, de 2020, ele é acusado de “chefiar o cartel de Los Soles” e a suposta organização é mencionada 32 vezes, no indiciamento final, emitido depois da captura de Maduro, o Cartel é citado apenas duas vezes, e descrita como um “sistema de patronagem administrado por aqueles no topo” – e não mais como uma organização de tráfico de drogas.


Por que isso importa?


O sequestro do então presidente da Venezuela Nicolás Maduro foi justificado pelos Estados Unidos em função de sua suposta atuação no tráfico de drogas.

A ação norte-americana se baseou em determinações de grupos criminosos venezuelanos como terroristas pelos próprios Estados Unidos. De forma semelhante com o que ocorreu com o PCC e o CV em junho deste ano.


Existem definições técnicas na Convenção contra o Crime Organizado Transnacional da ONU que determinam o que é uma organização criminosa internacional: um corpo organizado com uma estrutura e hierarquia, divisão de tarefas e continuidade temporal; autonomia em relação ao Estado; e comprovação da sua existência por investigações policiais. O Cartel de Los Soles não se enquadra em nenhum destes aspectos. 


A adoção ampla de uma organização que não existe pelos 14 países que fazem parte do Escudo das Américas demonstra a supremacia do governo norte-americano nas ações do grupo. 


Trump afirmou em discurso que os cartéis de drogas “são o Estado Islâmico do hemisfério” e seus membros “devem ser executados, exilados ou detidos como inimigos combatentes”


O que promete a aliança do Escudo das Américas  


Os 14 países que fazem parte do Escudo das Américas, iniciativa lançada em março deste ano, são todos governados por aliados de Trump na direita continental. Ontem, em comunicado conjunto, eles prometeram impor, “congelamento de ativos; restrições de imigração e de visto para membros, associados e apoiadores dessas organizações; e a responsabilização criminal de indivíduos que, conscientemente, forneçam apoio material — incluindo apoio logístico — a tais organizações”. 


México e Brasil, os dois maiores e mais ricos países do continente, não fazem parte do Escudo. Ambos sofrem pressões políticas dos EUA para enfraquecer seus governos, com orientação à esquerda. 


O grupo também prometeu pedir à OEA (Organização dos Estados Americanos) uma resolução que “promova e facilite a ação coletiva contra organizações …

author: CMI Argentina
title: El Consejo de Seguridad Nacional de Milei: “incompatible con la democracia”
content:
El Centro de Estudios Legales y Sociales (CELS) advirtió que el proyecto presentado por el gobierno de Javier Milei como una iniciativa “sobre la soberanía de Malvinas”, en realidad rediseña áreas centrales del Estado y crea un nuevo órgano de gobierno, el Consejo de Seguridad Nacional, que operará sin controles ni supervisión y “concentrará capacidades militares, de inteligencia y de castigo basados en supuestos de intervención mal definidos y potencialmente ilimitados”.


Se trata de “un órgano para tiempos de guerra incompatible con la democracia”, enfatizaron.


Javier Milei y Carlos Presti. Foto: Presidencia


“Esto es un serio riesgo en cualquier caso, pero más aún en un gobierno que considera como terroristas a manifestantes y comunidades indígenas, enemigos desestabilizadores a los periodistas críticos y extremistas de izquierda a cualquiera que considere que la igualdad, la justicia social y la defensa de los bienes comunes son valores centrales de la vida democrática”, apuntaron.


Compartimos el comunicado del CELS:


Consejo de Seguridad Nacional: concentración de poder en nombre de la “defensa de la soberanía”


El gobierno presentó como una iniciativa sobre la soberanía de Malvinas un proyecto que en realidad rediseña áreas centrales del Estado. Crea un Consejo de Seguridad Nacional, una suerte de supraministerio, con amplias facultades para definir qué asuntos constituyen amenazas, además de decidir sobre el uso del instrumento militar y la inteligencia estratégica nacional. Esta amplitud puede llevar a actividades políticas, opositoras o críticas al terreno de la “seguridad nacional”, sin intervención ni control de otros poderes del Estado.


De la soberanía a la concentración de poder


El proyecto de Ley de Defensa de la Soberanía Nacional se presenta en sociedad con Malvinas como lema. Pero excede ampliamente la cuestión, hasta ahora negada por el gobierno, de recuperar una agenda de soberanía. Junto con un régimen específico contra la explotación no autorizada de recursos naturales en las islas, crea un Consejo de Seguridad Nacional (CSN) que, más que un consejo, es una suerte de supraministerio con atribuciones muy amplias de definición de políticas, facultades de investigación y sanción administrativa, además de decidir sobre el uso del instrumento militar y la inteligencia estratégica nacional.


Muy rápidamente el proyecto pasa de la soberanía a la “seguridad nacional”, un concepto hasta ahora ajeno a nuestro ordenamiento jurídico democrático, que viene siendo utilizado en distintos países en los últimos años como una forma de sustraer determinados temas a la discusión política y llevarlos a un ámbito de decisión ejecutiva inconsulta, en general amparada también en el secreto. Se establece una especie de estado de permanentes amenazas a la seguridad nacional que justifican la normalización de medidas excepcionales. Esto implica además una tácita derogación del régimen normativo actual que organiza el sistema de defensa nacional, seguridad interior e inteligencia y define los alcances de estas tres áreas sin englobarlas en la “seguridad nacional”.


Consejo de Seguridad Nacional: un órgano para tiempos de guerra incompatible con la democracia


El proyecto crea el Consejo de Seguridad Nacional, presidido por el propio Presidente e integrado por funcionarios del Ejecutivo, entre ellos el titular de Inteligencia. El CSN tendrá la potestad de establecer su propio reglamento interno de funcionamiento y organización, el cual establecerá los mecanismos y autoridades encargadas de su gestión.


Ese Consejo elaborará una Política de Seguridad Nacional obligatoria y transversal para todo el Estado, y todos los organismos nacionales tendrán la obligación de responderle. No se trata de un ámbito para aconsejar al Presidente, sino de un órgano ejecutivo con capacidades para definir problemas, investigarlos y sancionar a quienes considere responsables, sin pasar por un proceso judicial.


El Título IV permite al CSN llevar adelante investigaciones administrativas amplias y sin control, así como aplicar sanciones a personas jurídicas o físicas. En el marco de estas investigaciones puede adoptar, ante un “riesgo grave e inminente”, medidas urgentes como congelamiento de activos, restricciones sobre transferencias bancarias y comercio exterior, suspensión de autorizaciones, sin proceso previo.

El proyecto crea procedimientos excepcionales

, similares al estado de sitio, dentro de la legislación ordinaria …

author: Bulatlat Contributors
title: Rights groups assail military-led symposium redtagging progressives in Tacloban university
content:
Photo taken by an attendee during the symposium (name withheld for security reasons).

By Veronika Barbosa TACLOBAN CITY – Progressive groups in Eastern Visayas raised alarm over a red-tagging incident that happened last September 12, 2026 in a symposium led by the 8th Civil Military Operations “Dangpanan (CMO) Battalion inside the Leyte Normal University in Tacloban.

The attendees of the said symposium were students enrolled in the National Service Training Program (NSTP) course mostly composed of first-year students.

According to the accounts of some student attendees, an officer of the Armed Forces of the Philippines discouraged them from joining protest actions. “At first, he [the CMO officer] was only talking about the West Philippine Sea, then we were shocked that they started talking about terror grooming and how it is not necessary to criticize the government through mass mobilizations,” said Aya (name withheld for security reasons), an attendee of the symposium. Aya added that the military officer dissuaded them from joining progressive organizations as it is a form of “terrorist recruitment.” “He said that joining rallies and educational discussions talking about socio-political issues are forms of indoctrination which will eventually lead students to being recruited into the communist rebellion,” Aya told Bulatlat in an interview.

“We were shocked and traumatized when they showed us pictures of dead bodies of rebels who they said were recruited by the New People’s Army by joining rallies,” shared Aya. Aya added that the military officer flashed pictures of University of the Philippines students “terror-groomed” by mass organizations. “I was alarmed and disappointed [by the redtagging remarks], especially coming from a military officer who is supposed to serve and protect the people,” she said.

The Association of Political Science Students (APSS) of LNU challenged the university administration to look into the reported incident. “We call for the protection of spaces where students can engage in peaceful political discussion, organization, and mobilization without intimidation and unwarranted labeling,” the group said.

In a statement, Pulso han Mag-aaram Paterno, a political organization in LNU, also expressed their condemnation of the incident. “The AFP is actively endangering the lives of student protesters through this blatant redtagging.” Pulso Paterno argued that even the Supreme Court itself ruled that redtagging directly threatens one’s life, liberty, and security. “Our universities must remain safe havens for critical thought, learning, and the free exchange of ideas, completely insulated from intimidation and harassment,” the group said. Katungod Sinirangan Bisayas, the local chapter of Karapatan, described the incident as a reflection of a “deeply alarming pattern in which state forces militarize education spaces to advance its counterinsurgency narrative, vilify dissent, and instill fear among young people who dare to question corruption, poverty, and injustice.” “The AFP’s presence inside schools must not be normalized…the AFP is not a neutral institution, as it wields enormous power and has supported the interests of those who hold political and economic power in the country,” expounded Katungod.

Last year, youth activist Axell Bergula of Kabataan Partylist and former student of LNU was redtagged and visited by two uniformed police officers inside the university premises.

Read: Tacloban Youth activist harassed after November 30 protest

Read: Youth activist, family harassed anew after filing CHR case vs cops

Last January, the 8th CMO posted a video redtagging journalist Frenchie Mae Cumpio, layworker Marielle Domequil, and Alexander “Chakoy” Abinguna of Tacloban 5.

“The video [of the 8th CMO] maliciously juxtaposes the Tacloban 5 activists with armed rebels and shamelessly instrumentalizes the trumped-up cases that they are facing to “warn” students about the legal consequences of activism,” Katungod SB said.

The Tacloban 5 refers to the five human rights defenders arrested on February 7, 2020 in simultaneous raids in Tacloban City. They have been slapped with fabricated charges. Two of the five have been temporarily released after posting bail. Cumpio and Domequil were acquitted of illegal possession of firearms and explosives but were wrongfully convicted of terror financing charges. title: MENDIP FARMERS HUNT TO FACE TRIAL OVER HUNTED FOX
content:
Three people associated with the Mendip Farmers Hunt have pleaded not guilty to hunting a wild mammal with dogs.


Emma Clothier, Charlie Thomas and Bill Payne appeared at Taunton Deane Magistrates’ Court on 15 September 2026. All three pleaded not guilty and are due to face trial on 15 September 2027.


Emma Clothier (l) Charlie Thomas (c) and Bill Payne (r) .

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The case relates to events on 17th January 2026, when the Mendip Farmers Hunt met at their kennels in Priddy, Somerset.


Mendip Hunt Sabs were with the hunt throughout the day and documented the day’s events, including from the air using a drone. After the meet, sabs reviewed the footage they had recorded.


The footage shows hounds working inside thick bramble for several minutes before a fox breaks cover. A group of hunters can be seen on an adjoining track, including two people on horseback and a person on foot, while other mounted riders can be seen around the bramble.


The person on foot is standing only a short distance from where the fox emerges and can be seen pointing in the direction in which the fox runs.


The fox breaks cover from the thick bramble.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The hounds immediately give chase.


Within approximately a minute, the hounds catch the fox. The drone records the pack converging on the animal and the fox being killed.


The kill site was only a few hundred yards from where members of the hunt had been gathered near the patch of bramble. The drone continued filming for several minutes afterwards. During that time, no hunt member can be seen approaching the kill site, while further hounds can be seen joining the pack and tearing at the fox.


The hounds being allowed to mutilate the fox’s body.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


No attempt to retrieve the fox’s body was recorded by the drone, and eventually the hunt can be seen moving away from the area.


After reviewing their footage, Mendip Hunt Sabs returned to the location. There they discovered the mutilated body of the fox still lying where the hounds had killed her.


The mutilated fox remains were subsequently found by sabs who returned to the kill site.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The drone footage was subsequently featured in a

Channel 4 News investigation by Chief Correspondent Alex Thomson

 into the reality behind so-called “trail hunting” allegations that it is being used as a smokescreen for illegal fox hunting.


Among the footage broadcast was the

Mendip Farmers fox kill

. Channel 4 News also showed footage involving the Duke of Beaufort Hunt, including foxes being pursued and killed by hounds, one of those incidents has also resulted in three Beaufort hunters appearing in court, with a trial due to take place in April 2027.


A fox being killed by hounds belonging to the Beaufort Hunt also featured in the Channel 4 News report.

Image Credit Wiltshire Hunt Sabs.


The investigation also featured footage from the Eggesford Hunt showing a fox being bolted from underground; and covert-camera footage of the Heythrop Hunt showing chicken carcasses being dumped in woodland intended to attract foxes for hunting once the season begins.


Eggesford Hunt preparing to bolt a fox in front of the hounds.

Image Credit: Devon County Hunt Saboteurs


Also present with the Mendip Farmers Hunt on the day of the incident, was Helena Rees-Mogg, wife of former Conservative cabinet minister and former North East Somerset MP Sir Jacob Rees-Mogg.


Jacob Rees-Mogg hosting the Mendip Farmers Hunt at his home in West Harptree, on Boxing Day 2025.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The Rees-Mogg family’s association with the Mendip Farmers Hunt is longstanding. Helena Rees-Mogg has previously served as a master of the hunt, while the family has often hosted Mendip Farmers Hunt meets at their Somerset home.


Helena Anne Beatrix Wentworth Fitzwilliam, Lady Rees-Mogg , former master of the Mendip Farmers Hunt, image taken on the day of the incident 17/01/2026.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


Their eldest son, Peter Theodore Alphege Rees-Mogg, has also served as master of the Eton College Beagles.


A hunt saboteur spokesperson said “

It is down to the relentless work of hunt sabs around the country – getting out there week after week, saving lives, filming hunts, gathering evidence and putting it in front of the police – that we are finally seeing so many hunters charged with hunting offences.


Whether they are convicted …

author: PETA-Team
title: Tierschutz für Kinder: Ingrid Newkirks neues Buch „Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“
content:
Mit

„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“

 lädt Ingrid Newkirk, Gründerin von PETA, Kinder ab ca. 9 Jahren zu einer besonderen Entdeckungsreise ein. Statt Fantasiegeschichten präsentiert das Kindersachbuch echte Geschichten voller

Mitgefühl

 und praktischer Tipps, wie Kinder selbst zum Wohl von Tieren beitragen können. Jedes Kapitel verbindet wissenschaftlich fundierte Fakten mit echten Geschichten aus der Tierwelt – mal berührend, mal überraschend, immer kindgerecht erzählt. Reflexionsfragen regen dazu an, über Verantwortung, Empathie und Gerechtigkeit nachzudenken. Damit fördert das Buch nicht nur Lesekompetenz, sondern auch zentrale Werte wie Mitgefühl und die Fähigkeit zum Perspektivwechsel.


Lesen Sie jetzt im Interview, welche Gedanken Ingrid zu „Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ inspiriert haben, welche Vision dahintersteckt und weshalb es so wichtig ist, Kindern Tierschutz näherzubringen.


Kostenlos „Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ bestellen


Ein Blick ins Buch: Gemeinsam stark für Tiere


Ingrid Newkirk zeigt in ihrem neuen Werk, dass jedes Kind auch ohne Zauberkräfte einen Unterschied machen kann. Die Geschichten handeln von Tieren, die überraschen, berühren und zum Nachdenken anregen: vom mutigen Schweinchen Prudence bis hin zu Tieren, die Kinder vielleicht nie persönlich kennenlernen werden, die aber ebenso unseren

Schutz

 brauchen. Dazu gibt es Fragen zum Weiterdenken und Ideen für eigene Tierschutzaktionen – ob im Klassenzimmer, in Projekten oder im Alltag.


Das Kindersachbuch zeigt: Tiere sind nicht für uns da, sondern mit uns hier. Und Kinder können schon heute viel dazu beitragen, dass die Welt für alle Lebewesen gerechter und freundlicher wird.


Ergänzt werden die Erzählungen durch konkrete Anregungen, wie junge Leser:innen selbst aktiv werden können: ob durch kleine Gesten im Alltag, kreative Ideen für mehr Tierschutz oder den bewussten Umgang mit Mitgeschöpfen. So wird das Buch zu einer Schatzkiste voller Inspiration, die Neugier weckt und zu eigenen guten Taten motiviert.


„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ jetzt auch als Lesehörbuch entdecken

 


„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ ist nicht nur als Kindersachbuch erhältlich, sondern auch als Lesehörbuch. In Kooperation mit der Werkstatt inklusiver Deutschunterricht (WiDu) wurde das Lesehörbuch für Bildungseinrichtungen nach dem Leseband-Konzept aufbereitet. So können Kinder die Geschichten gleichzeitig lesen und anhören. Das fördert die Lesekompetenz, unterstützt den Lernprozess und macht es noch leichter, in die faszinierende Welt der Tiere einzutauchen. 


„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“: Ingrid Newkirk im Interview über ihr Buch


1. Über das Buch


Was hat Sie dazu motiviert, dieses Buch zu schreiben?

Alle Kinder möchten sich für Tiere starkmachen, und ich finde die Idee großartig, ihnen praktische Tipps zu geben, wie sie wunderbare Taten vollbringen können, die wirklich zählen.


Was macht dieses Buch im Vergleich zu anderen Kinderbüchern über Tiere besonders?

Es ist keine Fantasiegeschichte wie „Captain Irgendwas“ oder „Super Dies und Das“, sondern zeigt, wie man wirklich wichtig sein kann – nicht nur so tut, als ob –, indem man kleine Dinge tut, die das Leben von Tieren verändern. Und die meisten Kinder interessieren sich sehr für Tiere.


Warum ist es Ihrer Meinung nach wichtig, Kindern schon früh Tierschutz und Mitgefühl nahezubringen?

Wahrscheinlich gibt es nichts Wichtigeres. Wie ein antiker Philosoph sagte: Wenn man einem Kind beibringt, freundlich zu einer Raupe zu sein, tut man damit dem Kind genauso viel Gutes wie der Raupe. Mitgefühl verhindert Kriege – und selbst kleinere Aggressionen.


Wie haben Sie die Tiere ausgewählt, die im Buch vorkommen?

Kinder kennen

Hunde

 und Katzen, vielleicht auch Pferde und Eichhörnchen – deshalb sind sie im Buch. Aber auch Tiere wie Schlangen oder

Mäuse

, die oft als gruselig empfunden werden, und Tiere, die Kinder vermutlich nie zu Gesicht bekommen, die aber trotzdem unseren Schutz brauchen – zum Beispiel in Afrika oder Südamerika.


Gibt es eine Geschichte oder ein Tier in dem Buch, das Ihnen besonders am Herzen liegt?

Ich liebe alle Geschichten und hoffe, dass die Kinder sie auch alle lieben werden. Besonders gefällt mir die Geschichte von Prudence, dem kleinen Schweinchen, das wusste, dass sein Mensch sehr krank war – und sein eigenes Leben riskierte, um Hilfe zu holen. Sie zeigt, wie aufmerksam Tiere sind, selbst solche, die oft als „nicht besonders intelligent“ gelten, und wie viel Güte sie …

author: Sophie Lemcke
title: So ist es, als Huhn in der Fleischindustrie leben zu müssen
content:
Die Hühnermast ist ein grausames System, das auf maximale Schnelligkeit, Wachstum und Profit ausgelegt ist und mit einem gewaltvollen Tod für die Tiere endet.


Wie fühlt es sich an, als „Masthuhn“ geboren zu werden

, ohne die Möglichkeit, der leidvollen Industrie zu entkommen

?


Der einzige Grund, weshalb die Industrie dich „produziert“ hat: Du sollst so schnell wie möglich so schwer wie möglich werden – und wirst dann getötet.


Du kommst in einem Hühnerschlupfbetrieb mit tausenden anderen Küken zur Welt. Um dich herum piepsen sie verzweifelt. Und auch du suchst nach Nähe und Wärme. Aber da ist keine Mutter, in deren Gefieder du dich kuscheln kannst – und du wirst sie auch niemals kennenlernen.

Noch am ersten Tag deines Lebens wirst du über Förderbänder geschleudert und in eine Kiste gepackt. Dann beginnt die oftmals stundenlange Fahrt zum Mastbetrieb – eingepfercht mit Dutzenden anderen Küken, ohne Wasser, ohne Nahrung.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Du kommst in einer riesigen Halle an. Hier wirst du die nächsten rund 5 Wochen verbringen – die einzigen Wochen deines Lebens.


Um dich herum Tausende andere Küken. Du teilst dir einen Quadratmeter mit bis zu 23 anderen Tieren. Jetzt seid ihr noch klein, doch das wird sich schnell ändern.


Du wächst. Unnatürlich schnell. Das Futter steht dir Tag und Nacht zur Verfügung – hochkalorisch, proteinreich, entwickelt für maximales Wachstum in kürzester Zeit.


Du hast keinen Platz, um dich natürlich zu bewegen, es gibt nichts zum Erkunden. Keinerlei Möglichkeiten, deine natürlichen Verhaltensweisen auszuleben. Es ist trist und laut. Da ist nur diese Enge.


Die Luft ist stickig. Der Ammoniakgeruch von den Ausscheidungen Tausender Tiere brennt in deinen Augen, in deinen Lungen. Du bekommst Atemwegserkrankungen. Jeder Atemzug tut weh.


Dein Körper wurde durch jahrzehntelange Züchtung so manipuliert, dass du in wenigen Wochen das Gewicht erreichst, für das ein Huhn unter natürlichen Bedingungen Monate bräuchte.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Deine Brustmuskeln wachsen so schnell und werden so schwer, dass deine Knochen dein Gewicht nicht mehr tragen können. Deine Beine verformen sich. Dein Herz ist zu klein für deinen massiven Körper, es hat Probleme, deine Organe mit ausreichend Blut zu versorgen. Du hast Schmerzen beim Gehen und deine Gelenke sind entzündet.


Um dich herum sind Hühner, die gar nicht mehr aufstehen können. Sie liegen in ihrem eigenen Kot und leiden unter extremen Schmerzen. Sie verdursten und verhungern.


Andere Hühner werden aufgrund der Enge von ihren Artgenossen versehentlich totgetrampelt und erdrückt – ihre Körper verwesen zwischen dir und den tausenden anderen Tieren. Auch du hast keine Chance, den anderen Hühnern auszuweichen.


Dann ist es soweit. Menschen kommen und packen dich. An deinen Beinen, kopfüber, werden du und deine Artgenossen gegriffen und in enge Transportkisten geworfen. Deine ohnehin schon schmerzenden Beine brechen unter der groben Behandlung. Du hast Schmerzen und Todesangst.


Zusammengepfercht, ohne Wasser, ohne Futter, geht es zum Schlachthof. Die Fahrt kann Stunden dauern. Manche Hühner sterben bereits im Transporter – vor Stress, vor Erschöpfung, erdrückt von anderen Tieren.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Im Schlachthof riechst du Blut. Du hörst die Schreie anderer Hühner. Dann bist du selbst an der Reihe. Unter grausamen Bedingungen wirst du betäubt und getötet. Du bist gerade einmal 35 bis 42 Tage alt geworden.


Es ist unvorstellbar, was Hühner in der Fleischindustrie erleiden müssen.


Die Wahrheit hinter „Hähnchenfleisch“


Wie grausam das kurze Leben von sogenannten Masthühnern ist, haben wir schon mehrfach bei Undercover-Recherchen aufgedeckt, beispielsweise in einem (jetzt ehemaligen) Zuliefererbetrieb der großen Marke Wiesenhof. Hier erfährst du mehr über unsere Aufdeckungen und kannst unsere Petition für strengere Tierschutzvorgaben, -kontrollen und -strafen unterzeichnen:


Jetzt für Hühner unterschreiben 


In Deutschland wird mehr Fleisch von Hühnern konsumiert als produziert – und die Nachfrage ist in den vergangenen Jahren stetig gestiegen. Unterstütze dieses grausame System nicht: Entscheide dich konsequent für pflanzliche Lebensmittel.


In den meisten Supermärkten findest du mittlerweile eine Vielfalt tierfreundlicher Alternativen, die hervorragende Proteinquellen sind – probiere sie aus. Oder koche unsere zahlreichen pflanzlichen Rezepte von Love Veg nach, wie unsere

knusprigen Tofu-Nuggets

.

author: GPT
title: Kutschpferde ohne Schutz: Vorstösse in Stadt, Kanton und Bund
content:
Anwohner:innen dokumentierten diesen Sommer in Interlaken

Kutschpferde im Dauereinsatz

: dasselbe Pferd um 14 und um 21 Uhr desselben Tages, bei 31 Grad. Das kantonale Veterinäramt erklärte zu einer Temperaturlimite, die Tierschutzgesetzgebung biete

«keine Grundlage für derartige Anordnungen»

. An dieser Lücke setzen die drei Vorstösse an.


Die

Tierschutzverordnung

 regelt, wie viel Bewegung ein Pferd mindestens braucht – nicht, wie lange es vor der Kutsche arbeiten darf. Hitzeschutz schreibt sie für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine vor, für Pferde im Geschirr fehlt jede Bestimmung. Die Motion von Nationalrätin Meret Schneider (Grüne) beauftragt den Bundesrat deshalb, die Verordnung zu ergänzen: mit einer Höchstdauer des täglichen Einsatzes und Ruhezeiten, Einsatzgrenzen bei Hitze und einem Fachkundenachweis für das gewerbliche Kutschieren.


«Die Tierschutzverordnung kennt Hitzeschutz für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine – nur für Pferde, die bei grosser Hitze Kutschen über den Asphalt ziehen, fehlt jede Regel», sagt Meret Schneider. «Diese Lücke kann der Bundesrat auf dem Verordnungsweg schliessen, ohne Gesetzesänderung.»


Wie gross die Risiken auch für Menschen sind, zeigte der

Unfall im Val Roseg

 vom 16. August: Die Bremsleistung einer Kutsche reichte nicht mehr aus, ein Pferd stürzte, das Fuhrwerk prallte gegen einen Baum. Eine 73-jährige Frau starb, zwölf Mitfahrende wurden verletzt. Wer ein Tierfuhrwerk lenkt, braucht nach Bundesrecht einzig das vollendete vierzehnte Altersjahr, eine Prüfung besteht nicht.


Im Grossen Rat verlangt Susanne Clauss (SP) mit der Interpellation «Hitzefrei für Kutschpferde?» Auskunft darüber, wie viele Pferde im Kanton Bern für gewerbliche Kutschfahrten eingesetzt werden, wie der Kanton kontrolliert und was aus den Meldungen aus der Bevölkerung wird.


«Verbindliche Regeln nehmen den sorgfältigen Betrieben nichts weg», sagt Susanne Clauss. «Sie stoppen die Betriebe, die ihr Pferd von Mittag bis Mitternacht durcharbeiten lassen.»


In der Stadt Bern fragt Tobias Sennhauser, Stadtrat von Tier im Fokus (TIF), welche Bewilligungen die Stadt für Kutschenbetriebe erteilt, welche Vorgaben für die Kutschenfahrten des städtischen Tierparks gelten und wie weit ihr Handlungsspielraum reicht – bis hin zu einem Verbot.


«Die Kutsche ist Unterhaltung auf Kosten der Tiere», sagt Tobias Sennhauser. «Wir wollen von der Stadt wissen, ob sie im 21. Jahrhundert daran festhalten will, Pferde zwischen Tram, Bussen und Menschenmengen einzuspannen.»


Andere Städte sind weiter:

Berlin

 lässt seit 2019 ab 30 Grad im Schatten keine Kutschfahrten mehr zu, Barcelona, Madrid und Málaga haben den gewerblichen Kutschenbetrieb ganz beendet.


Der Beitrag

Kutschpferde ohne Schutz: Vorstösse in Stadt, Kanton und Bund

 erschien zuerst auf

Tier im Fokus (TIF)

.

author: Animal Rising Press
title: Woman Walks Free From Pig Farrowing Crate After 21 Days And Nights In Trafalgar Square
content:
Animal Rising vows further factory farm exposés as group says three-week action marks beginning of long-term campaign to end factory farming.

Animal Rising campaign lead Michelle Farnham has today (22 September) walked free from a pig farrowing crate in Trafalgar Square after spending 21 consecutive days and nights confined inside it, without leaving once.

Michelle emerged from the crate at 11am, after first entering it at 7am on 1 September, completing an extraordinary physical and psychological challenge designed to bring the reality of factory farming into public view.

She greeted a crowd of approximately 100 supporters and was joined by her partner and family following the three weeks of intense isolation.

Thousands of passersby encountered the installation during its three weeks in one of London’s busiest public spaces, with many stopping to speak with Michelle about the action and the conditions faced by animals in factory farms.

The action attracted national and international media attention, with high-profile visitors including former RSPCA president Chris Packham and Green MP Adrian Ramsay. [1]

Animal Rising said at the event that the end of Michelle’s confinement marks only the beginning of a long-term campaign against factory farming. The group is calling on the government to commit to ending factory farming by 2040 and says further investigations and exposés of conditions inside British farms will follow.

Michelle’s action was inspired by Luna, a mother pig whose life Animal Rising documented for a month on a Suffolk factory farm. [2] Michelle was confined in similar farrowing crate, of the type used in around 90% of indoor British pig farming systems to confine mother pigs around giving birth and nursing their piglets. [3]

Around 200,000 mother pigs are confined in farrowing crates in the UK each year. Sows can spend four to five weeks at a time inside the crates, unable even to turn around. [4]

A petition to free Luna is now approaching 30,000 signatures. [5]

Michelle is available for interview about her experience of spending 21 days and nights inside the crate, the physical and psychological impact of this time, and why she believes the UK must move away from factory farming.

To arrange interviews or follow-up coverage, please contact press@animalrising.org or +44 1225 29 6691

High-quality pictures and videos: https://show.pics.io/animal-rising-breaking-news

All images and videos in this file, on our social media and website can be used with credit to Animal Rising under ‘fair use’ for the purposes of reporting.

title: ‘AUTUMN’ HUNTING IS ABOUT AS REAL AS ‘TRAIL’ HUNTING
content:
Cub hunting or ‘autumn hunting’ as it is referred to by hunts, has been underway for a few weeks now and already we are seeing overwhelming reports of foxes running for their lives and aggressive behaviour from hunts whose illegal activity is being exposed.


On the 15

th

 of September the North Cotswold Hunt descended on Wormington in Gloucestershire. A

young fox

 was seen fleeing for its life but this wasn’t the only wildlife disturbed and distressed by the hunts presence, as deer were also seen running towards the very busy B4632.


This young fox was witnessed running for its life.

© Three Counties Hunt Sabs


The Hursley Hambledon Hunt have also been caught demonstrating blatant cub hunting tactics. On the 09

th

 of September while hunting in Meonstoke hounds were entered into a covert and remained there, being encouraged on by the huntsman, for over twenty minutes. Riders and foot supporters lined the covert in an attempt to turn foxes back, but they were unsuccessful as no less than three foxes were seen fleeing the area.


1 of 3 foxes fleeing from the Hursley Hambledon Hunt.

© South Hampshire Hunt Sabs


Meanwhile on the same day over two hours north, the Ledbury Hunt were causing chaos in Berrow. Again, cub hunting tactics were on display for all to see as riders surrounded a covert, saddle slapping and using sticks and voice calls to try and scare foxes back towards hounds. One fox is believed to have been cornered in an area of brambles and unfortunately their fate is unknown.


A short while later another fox was hunted and was thankfully seen to safety by a sab, who reminded the huntsman Sam Jones that he is soon due in court for charges under the Hunting Act while he was huntsman at the criminal Cottesmore Hunt.


This young fox makes its escape from the Ledbury hounds and huntsman Sam Jones.

© Three Counties Hunt Sabs


Grange Farm in Grandborough, a certified Camping and Caravanning site, played host to the Warwickshire Hunt on the 10

th

 of September. The hunt encouraged hounds along a brook just south of the meet and it wasn’t long before a fox was seen running for its life.


A rider attempted to catch up to the fox and turn it back as it fled to safety in a covert. Thankfully sabs were on hand to intervene, battling hollers from the whipper in Jacob Martin, who was actively encouraging hounds on.


This fox was hunted by the Warwickshire Hunt who met at a certified Camping & Caravanning site.

© West Midlands Hunt Sabs


While all of the foxes mentioned above were helped to safety, we are reminded of the sickening and cruel reality of “trail” hunting when sabs are faced with the aftermath of a fox being killed.


Unfortunately, on the 18

th

 of September, Three Counties Hunt Sabs witnessed the Heythrop Hunt kill a fox on land near Swell Wold Farm in Gloucestershire. The fox was surrounded, and the lasting result was blood smeared on a wooden fence while the fox’s innards were left strewn across the floor.


This is the sickening reality of “trail” hunting.

© Three Counties Hunt Sabs


As hunts charge through the countryside in search of innocent lives to take, all manner of wildlife is disturbed, as Cirencester Hunt Sabs reported on the 5

th

 of September while at

the bin bag Beaufort Hunt

. The hunt were on the Badminton Estate, and two quads were seen in a woodland whilst hunt riders circled the perimeter for at least an hour with hounds inside. 

This is not ‘trail’ hunting this is blatant cub hunting.


The hunt eventually moved on from here but disturbed a herd of deer, one of which fled into the road and was hit by a passing car. The couple in the car were left devastated by what had happened as the deer died by the roadside. As is to be expected, the hunt continued on with absolutely no regard for the trauma they had caused and the danger they had put people in.


After running from the Beaufort Hunt this deer was hit by a passing car.

Sabs stayed with them until they passed away.

author: Dr. Yvonne Würz
title: Indien: Helfen Sie Elefant Madhuri zurück in die Auffangstation
content:
Videoinhalt: © PETA India


Elefantendame

 Madhuri verbrachte jahrzehntelang angekettet und isoliert in einem Kloster (Matha) in Indien. Nach Bemühungen von PETA Indien wurde sie im Juli 2025 auf Anordnung eines Sonderausschusses des Obersten Gerichtshofs von Indien (High-Powered Committee, HPC) und des Obersten Gerichtshofs von Bombay aus ihrer tierquälerischen Haltung in das Elefanten-Rehabilitationszentrum Vantara gebracht. Dort erhielt sie tiermedizinische Versorgung, konnte erstmals Kontakt zu anderen Elefantinnen aufnehmen und begann, sich körperlich und psychisch zu erholen.  


Am 9. September 2026 ordnete das HPC jedoch an, dass die Elefantendame in dasselbe Kloster zurückkehren muss, in dem sie über Jahrzehnte unter den belastenden Haltungsbedingungen litt. 


Warum wurde Madhuri in die schlechte Haltung zurückgebracht? 

 


Dem Beschluss vom 9. September ging eine Kehrtwende Vantaras voraus. Die Organisation erklärte, Madhuris weiterer Aufenthalt in der Einrichtung liege nicht länger „im Interesse von Madhuri oder des Klosters“. Diese Kursänderung folgte einer Kampagne, die die Rückführung von Madhuri forderte und zum Boykott von Produkten aufrief, die mit dem Unternehmen hinter Vantara verbunden sind.  


Drei Monate vor der Entscheidung berichtete Vantaras Veterinärteam selbst, dass Madhuri mit schweren chronischen Erkrankungen angekommen sei. Die Folgen schlechter Haltung seien deutlich sichtbar gewesen, weshalb sie fortlaufend spezialisierte Behandlungen und regelmäßige Kontrollen benötige. 


Rückführung ins Kloster bedeutet enorme Risiken für Elefantendame Madhuri 

 


Während der jahrzehntelangen Haltung im Kloster war Madhuri gezwungen, fast regungslos auf Betonboden im Tempel zu leben. Dadurch hat sie irreversible gesundheitliche Schäden erlitten, darunter eine chronische Fußerkrankung und Arthritis. Die Rückführung birgt deshalb erhebliche Risiken für die Elefantendame. Sie benötigt weiterhin spezialisierte tiermedizinische Versorgung, die sie im Kloster nicht bekommen kann. Zudem hat sie nach 33 Jahren Isolation erstmals enge soziale Bindungen zu anderen Elefantinnen aufbauen können, die durch die Rückführung erneut zerstört wurden.  


Erst wenige Wochen zuvor hatten vom Sonderausschuss HPC eingesetzte Inspektoren das Kloster besucht. Ihr Fazit: Die Anlage sei für eine langfristige Haltung ungeeignet. Dennoch wurde Madhuri Mitte September 2026, nach nur 13 Monaten im Rehabilitationszentrum Vantara, wieder in den Tempel in Kolhapur überführt. 


PETA Indien setzt sich weiterhin dafür ein, dass Madhuri zurück in die Rehabilitationseinrichtung von Vantara gebracht wird.  


Fordern Sie jetzt Madhuris Rückkehr in die Auffangstation 

 


Elefantendame Madhuri musste zurück in eine Umgebung, die ihren Bedürfnissen als Wildtier niemals gerecht wird. Sie braucht dringend medizinische Versorgung, den Kontakt zu Artgenossen und die Möglichkeit, in einer geeigneten Umgebung zu leben. Unterstützen Sie deshalb PETA Indiens Petition und fordern Sie die Verantwortlichen auf, Madhuri dauerhaft in der Rehabilitationseinrichtung von Vantara unterzubringen. 


Jetzt Madhuri helfen (Weiterleitung auf PETA India)


The post

Indien: Helfen Sie Elefant Madhuri zurück in die Auffangstation 

 appeared first on

PETA Deutschland e.V.

.

author: Emma Honeybun
title: Proposed federal law attacks environment, ‘stomps on’ leadership, says youth
content:
A group of Indigenous youth in Ontario are warning that a bill tabled in Parliament on Monday could have “horrible” implications for the future of the environment and Treaty rights.


Speaking at the

Nishnawbe Aski Nation (NAN)

 conference on Wednesday, Ramon Kataquapit, who sits on the Chiefs of Ontario Youth Council, described the proposed law as “the bite that comes and chomps on us.


“This isn’t the threat, this is the attack,” he said.


Bill C-39, the

Building Canada Strong Act

, gives ministers the ability to streamline certain major projects by making them exempt from certain laws (mostly environmental) such as the

Impact Assessment Act

, shortening the time between the project’s approval and the beginning of construction.


This law is similar to Bill C-5, the

Building Canada Act

, which was passed in 2025 and introduced the concept of

projects of “national interest.”


This essentially means that if a major project is deemed of national interest — generally those involving critical minerals, transit and energy, or those which benefit international trade — there is the possibility that they may be exempt from laws, such as the

Species at Risk Act

, and all federal approvals are “automatically granted at once,” according to Ottawa.


Bill C-5 “shifts the review from ‘whether’ the project should proceed, to ‘how’ the project should proceed,” according to Canada’s website.


However, Bill C-39 introduces a new, larger player — regions of natural interest.


Instead of just one specific project being exempt from laws, the bill would make it so any projects in a specific region are subject to the same process, as determined by the relevant minister.


At the NAN conference, the bill raised concerns about what this would imply for the environment, as well as Treaty Rights, as projects would be “pre-approved without involvement or consent,” according to Grand Chief Alvin Fiddler.


Kataquapit, who is Cree and Taino, who are Indigenous to Puerto Rico, said “it’s scary to see, as a youth,” and that he believes leadership is “getting stomped on.”


The 24-year-old is the co-founder of the

Okiniwak Youth Movement

, and has recently returned from a three-week-long journey through the James Bay Lowlands with his cousin, Jeronimo, the founder of

Here We Stand Youth Movement

.


James Bay is a large, inland body of water which connects to the southernmost point of the Hudson Bay. The remote peatland (James Bay Lowlands) around it is known as the “breathing grounds,” Kataquapit said, and carries more than 30 tonnes of carbon.


According to the

World Wildlife Fund

, the Hudson and James Bay Lowlands are one of the largest natural carbon storage sites on the planet, housing over five million hectares of untouched habitat to fish, migratory birds, and other wildlife such as polar bears.


It is also home to the Ring of Fire, a 5,000 square kilometre section of land teeming with untouched minerals, including copper, nickel, and chromite.


In June, Ontario, in partnership with Webequie First Nation, broke ground on a 107-kilometre gravel road to provide easier access to the area, which is currently only accessible through a winter road or by air travel, to allow for more mining opportunities.


Construction began five years ahead of schedule, although this was done through an additional partnership with Marten Falls First Nation rather than a law.


In July,

Friends of the Attawapiskat River

, an Indigenous-led advocacy group, requested a judicial review of the project.


The group claimed that Ottawa was ignoring its own federal impact assessment, which stated the road would cause “significant” damage to the environment and Indigenous rights,

APTN reported in August

.


In her statement of approval, Environment and Climate Change Minister Julie Dabrusin noted that while the project will have adverse effects, it is “justified in the public interest.”


Here We Stand’s journey through James Bay was done in response, in an effort to better educate the public on the land at risk if mining increases.


“I’ve seen the pristine life out there. I’ve seen the balance of nature and our animals working with one another, all to make this place that we call the land, the water, the earth. It taught me something, that this place is so important to us, that we should treat it how we treat ourselves,” Kataquapit said.

title: Kavak: Nature and living spaces destroyed in the name of energy
content:
Kurdistan is facing ecological destruction caused by mining operations and Geothermal Power Plant (GPP) and Hydroelectric Power Plant (HPP) projects. Through licences granted in the name of energy and mining investments, mountains, forests, water resources and agricultural land are being opened up for use by companies, while natural habitats are steadily shrinking.


In areas where mining, GPP and HPP projects have fragmented living spaces, the livelihoods of people who depend on agriculture and livestock farming are also under threat. Projects that continue despite objections from local communities have prompted criticism that natural resources are being opened up to capital investment.


Nevroz Kavak, Co-Chair of the Diyarbakır (Amed) Branch of the Chamber of Environmental Engineers, spoke to ANF about the ecological destruction in the region and the impact of energy and mining projects.


Environmental destruction has reached an alarming level


Nevroz Kavak stated that environmental destruction across the region has increased to an alarming level in recent times. Kavak said: “Frankly, environmental destruction has been steadily increasing across a large part of the region recently. When we began discussing these issues, as people who approach them not only from an ecological perspective but also from a technical and scientific standpoint, we were able to look at them somewhat differently. When we combine this technical approach with an ecological perspective, we observe that very intense and systematic environmental destruction has been taking place throughout Turkey, but particularly in the region, in recent times.”


We oppose profit-driven logic, not renewable energy


Nevroz Kavak said they frequently encounter the question, “Are you also against renewable energy?” in their environmental struggle, adding that they approach the issue from an ecological and socially conscious perspective.


 Kavak stressed that they are not categorically opposed to clean energy and continued: “When we raise these issues, we are generally asked, ‘Then aren’t you contradicting your own science? Are you against projects such as solar power plants (SPPs), GPPs and wind power plants (WPPs)?’ There are, of course, technical explanations for these issues. However, we cannot look at the matter solely through the logic of renewable energy; we have to develop an ecological perspective. We are certainly not categorically opposed to renewable energy sources. Particularly at a time when we are struggling so intensely with the climate crisis, it is impossible for us to oppose solar, geothermal or wind power plants. On the contrary, these are clean energy solutions that we are trying to encourage.


Diyarbakır in particular, as well as the wider region including Mardin (Mêrdîn), Batman (Êlih) and Urfa (Riha), has geography that receives abundant, high-quality sunlight. Of course, we should make use of solar energy instead of fossil fuels and focus on SPP projects to meet our clean energy needs.


But this is precisely where the problem begins: What we oppose is projects driven solely by economic interests and profit, projects handed over to capital, and the disregard for ecological balance. Even as technical professionals, we cannot approve projects developed with an approach that excludes nature, water, soil, air, people who are part of that ecosystem, and the local population.”


Local people cannot benefit from the energy produced


Nevroz Kavak said there are serious contradictions and tragicomic situations in the implementation of these projects: “Quite tragicomic situations arise while these projects are being carried out. External or foreign capital groups come to the region and undertake projects. Yet, sadly, local people living in the rural areas where these projects are established cannot benefit from the energy being produced. Despite setting out with the promise of producing energy, people living right next to these projects continue to live without access to energy.


In short, we oppose projects that disregard the environment and ecological balance, ignore local people and are driven solely by profit. This does not mean that we oppose renewable energy sources that are compatible with nature.”
