title: Kurdish language and culture institutions: Mother-tongue education is a fundamental human right
content:
Kurdish language and culture institutions in Europe have spoken out against restrictions on mother-tongue education in Rojava. In a joint statement, they called for the right to education in Kurdish to be constitutionally guaranteed and for Kurdish to be granted equal status with Arabic in Syria.


The institutions issued the statement in response to the debate over the future of the Kurdish-language education system in Rojava. They said that restricting Kurdish to individual classes or treating it as a foreign language was unacceptable. The signatories described the population’s protests against such efforts by the transitional government in Damascus as a legitimate and democratic struggle for a fundamental right.


“No political or ideological preference”


“Mother-tongue education is not a political or ideological preference, but a fundamental human right. Every child has the right to be educated in their own language and to freely develop their language, culture, and identity,” the statement said. The institutions recalled that for decades, Kurds in Syria were systematically prevented from freely using their language in education as well as in institutional and public life. They said that the policies associated with this had not only restricted the right of subsequent generations to mother-tongue education, but had also hindered the free development and preservation of cultural identity.


The establishment of a mother-tongue education system of their own was therefore described as one of the most significant achievements of the past 15 years in Rojava. An entire generation has now grown up receiving education in Kurdish, the statement noted, adding: “This is not merely an academic or educational change, but also a response to linguistic and cultural denial, marginalization, and assimilation.”


Warning against a new policy of assimilation


The institutions described attempts by the transitional government in Damascus to restrict the status of Kurdish in the education system as politically and legally concerning. “Restricting the status of Kurdish within the education system and imposing models in which the mother tongue is defined merely as a foreign language carries the risk of reproducing and institutionalizing the historical policies of denial and cultural assimilation in a new phase.”


The statement therefore called for fundamental equality: “In Syria, Kurdish has the same rights and status as Arabic in terms of its historical, legal, and constitutional legitimacy. The right of Kurdish society to receive a complete education in its own language must be constitutionally guaranteed.”


The institutions pointed out that: “Given Syria’s multilingual and multicultural character, safeguarding Kurdish-language education is also a prerequisite for social peace and equal citizenship. The right of Kurdish children to education in their mother tongue is among the inalienable human rights. Therefore, this legitimate right must not be turned into a bargaining chip in political negotiations or temporary agreements.”


Four demands


Specifically, the signatory institutions are calling for the right of Kurdish children to mother-tongue education to be guaranteed constitutionally and by law. Kurdish, they say, must be safeguarded as the language of instruction at all levels of education and granted legal status as an official language equal to Arabic. At the same time, all legal, administrative, and practical barriers to the use of Kurdish in public life, state and civil society institutions, and the cultural sphere must be removed, they demand.


“Kurdish-language education is not a political or exceptional privilege. Rather, it is a universal principle and a fundamental human right,” the statement said. The institutions pledged their support for the struggle to preserve, expand, and legally safeguard the mother-tongue education system in Rojava.


Kapan: We stand with our people in Rojava until the end


Osman Kapan of the Kurdish Institute in Germany said that the transitional government was attempting to roll back one of Rojava’s key achievements. “Even if it does not say so openly, it wants to officially limit Kurdish-language instruction to just a few hours. That is why our people in Rojava are resisting and defending their right to their mother tongue.”


Kapan called on Kurds to consistently pass on their language in everyday life: “Speak your own language everywhere and in every region. Learn in your language …

author: David Swanson
title: Video of Webinar 21 Septiembre: Día Internacional de la Paz América Latina
content:
International Day of Peace, Latin America, North America, South America, Videos, WBW Webinars

By World BEYOND War, September 24, 2026

Cada 21 de septiembre se conmemora el Día Internacional de la Paz, una fecha que nos recuerda la urgencia de construir una sociedad donde la paz sea el centro de toda actividad humana, donde seamos verdaderamente libres y donde la justicia social sea una realidad cotidiana.

En un mundo con crecientes amenazas y riesgos para la estabilidad, los conflictos armados resurgen en diversos rincones del planeta. En este tablero global, América Latina ocupa un lugar estratégico fundamental, lo que sitúa a la región en una posición vulnerable frente a las disputas geopolíticas por el control político y territorial.

Ante el aumento de tropas extranjeras, la proliferación de bases militares, la firma de nuevos acuerdos castrenses y la normalización de la violencia en el continente, surge la necesidad de abrir este espacio de diálogo. Por ello, convocamos a un grupo de activistas y defensores de la paz para reflexionar sobre los desafíos y riesgos que enfrenta nuestra región.

A lo largo de este encuentro de una hora, analizaremos en profundidad el impacto que estos procesos tienen en cada uno de nuestros países y exploraremos caminos concretos para la construcción de paz desde una perspectiva no violenta.

Diana Salcedo: Politóloga (Universidad Nacional de Colombia) con maestrías en género (Universidad de Barcelona) y derechos humanos (Universidad de Alcalá). Feminista antimilitarista, representa a organizaciones sociales en la Instancia Especial de Mujeres para el Acuerdo de Paz y en la Comisión Intersectorial de Garantías de Seguridad. Actualmente lidera LIMPAL Colombia, donde coordina acciones de recuperación socioemocional, incidencia territorial y la implementación de la agenda de mujeres, paz y seguridad.

Ricardo Ulcuango: Líder indígena, diplomático y exlegislador ecuatoriano. Se ha desempeñado como Embajador Extraordinario y Plenipotenciario del Ecuador, Asambleísta Nacional —integrando las comisiones de Relaciones Internacionales y Movilidad Humana, y de Participación Ciudadana— y Diputado al Congreso Nacional, donde ocupó la Vicepresidencia de la Comisión de Fiscalización. Fue miembro de la Comisión de Auditoría Integral del Crédito Público (CAIC) sobre deuda externa. En el ámbito organizativo e internacional, ejerció la Presidencia del Parlamento Indígena de América (PIA), la Presidencia de ECUARUNARI y la Vicepresidencia de la CONAIE.

Ricardo Soberon: Abogado peruano egresado de la Universidad de Lima, con una maestría en Relaciones Internacionales por el Departamento de Estudios de Paz de la Universidad de Bradford (Reino Unido). Cuenta con una destacada trayectoria como consultor, docente universitario e investigador especializado en políticas de drogas, seguridad hemisférica y derechos humanos en la región andina.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Denuncian al hogar San Patricio que aloja niños y niñas con discapacidad
content:
La Comisión Provincial por la Memoria (CPM) presentó una denuncia penal ante la Fiscalía General de La Plata en virtud de la posible comisión de delitos de acción pública cometidos por operadores y autoridades del Hogar San Patricio. El establecimiento ubicado City Bell, partido de La Plata, se dedica al alojamiento y atención de personas con discapacidad. Según varios trabajadores que solicitaron resguardo de identidad, las golpizas, la sujeción mecánica, la sobremedicación, los castigos, la ausencia de actividades recreativas y terapéuticas y los baños con agua fría, entre otras prácticas denigrantes e ilegales, se utilizan frecuentemente contra los/as niños/as como forma de organizar las rutinas diarias. En su carácter de Mecanismo Local de Prevención de la Tortura, la CPM afirmó que desde 2021 tramitan denuncias similares en la justicia.


Según la denuncia formulada por la CPM, estos hechos deben investigarse exhaustivamente, ya que podrían no tratarse “de hechos aislados, sino de prácticas sistemáticas de violaciones a los derechos humanos de los niños y niñas allí alojados, que tienen su expresión más gravosa en la violencia física y psicológica”.


El organismo enmarca los hechos como “actos graves cometidos contra niños y niñas en situación de vulnerabilidad alojados allí por disposición estatal en un establecimiento con convenio estatal”.


La presentación ante la Fiscalía General de La Plata surgió a partir del testimonio de personas que trabajaron en el Hogar San Patricio entre febrero y comienzos de septiembre de este año, y que decidieron dejar sus puestos tras presenciar graves hechos de golpizas, gritos, amenazas de castigo físico, sobremedicación, casos de sujeción mecánica como represalias por no cumplir órdenes y ausencia de todo tipo de actividades terapéuticas o recreativas.


Los operadores denunciados que deben investigarse a fin de corroborar los hechos descriptos son: Jorge Martorini, Claudia Soto, Noelia Gallardo, Rocío Virula y Soledad Marchioni. También se solicitó a la fiscalía que se investigue eventualmente a otras personas que pudieran estar involucradas en las prácticas denunciadas. Con respecto al llamado a prestar declaración testimonial para las mujeres denunciantes, la CPM requirió que se realice bajo reserva de identidad por temor a represalias.


Una de las denunciantes estuvo asignada al sector de mujeres donde había alrededor de 40 niñas alojadas y solo se asignaban, por turno, entre tres y cuatro personas para su cuidado y atención. Desde el primer día presenció situaciones de violencia física y sus compañeras le dijeron que debía “aprender a contener”. Denunció que las niñas pasaban casi todo el tiempo en el sector de comedor, sin ningún juguete y que “me sorprendía la cantidad de medicación que tomaban”. Ante las situaciones de crisis subjetivas, la respuesta es la contención física que se realiza en sectores de la institución donde no registran las cámaras de seguridad. En una oportunidad se acercó a una de las habitaciones porque escuchaba gritos y ruidos; allí encontró a una de las cuidadoras agitada y a una nena con la boca sangrando. Cuando alguno de los niños o niñas se hacía pis o caca encima, los llevaban al baño y los lavaban con agua fría.


Otra ex trabajadora denunciante señaló a la CPM: “A mí me descartaron. No hay compasión, no se preocupan por los nenes. Cuando hay una pelea entre ellos, yo trato de consolarlos (…) Hay una cuidadora gorda que se sentó encima de un nene de 11 años”.


Dijo, que en ocasiones, cuando bañaba a alguno de los niños veía moretones en piernas, brazos, debajo de las axilas, entrepiernas y glúteos, y destacó que ha visto “golpes en zonas que era muy difícil que se hubieran golpeado entre niños, digamos, como golpes muy escondidos”.


Entre las medidas de prueba, la CPM requirió los registros de las cámaras de seguridad, los registros de libro de guardia del sector de mujeres y del sector de enfermería entre los meses de febrero y septiembre de este año y que se requiera al Hospital de Niños de La Plata información relativa a intervenciones solicitadas por el Hogar San Patricio y las historias clínicas de las niñas y niños que hubieran sido atendidos. Asimismo, que se le requiera al Hogar información sobre las personas que trabajaban en la institución en el periodo mencionado.

author: Joe Sandler Clarke
title: Greta Thunberg Joins Call to Release Hunger-Striking Gaza Flotilla Activists
content:
High-profile political leaders, artists, and activists – including Greta Thunberg – have called for the immediate release of four pro-Palestine organisers who are on hunger strike in a Tunisian jail, including one “on the brink of death”. 


Wael Naouar was rushed to hospital yesterday after spending 40 days on hunger strike, according to the Gaza Sumud Flotilla (GSF), an organisation that looks to challenge Israel’s illegal blockade of Gaza and deliver emergency aid by sea.


Alongside Thunberg, South African politician Zwelivelile Mandela, who is Nelson Mandela’s grandson, has also signed an open letter urging the Tunisian government to free Naouar and his three co-defendants. Both Thunberg and Mandela joined the same aid flotilla as Naouar last year.  


Other

signatories to the letter

 include Irish rap group Kneecap and Game of Thrones actor Liam Cunningham. They are also calling for “urgent medical care” for the detained men.


The four were arrested in March after being accused of misusing funds raised for the organisation. He launched his hunger strike at Mornaguia prison to protest his detention and that of his fellow activists – Ghassen Henchiri, Ghassen Boughdiri and Nabil Channoufi, who began their strikes around two weeks ago. 


Naouar is in a semi-comatose state, GSF said, adding that the Tunisian authorities have sought to impose an information blackout to prevent updates about his condition. Naouar’s father said he was close to death after visiting him earlier this week. 


Prison authorities have failed to respond to requests for information on his condition,

Al Jazeera reported

. 


GSF said in a statement: “This worrying silence and the total refusal to provide information to his family or legal team raise serious concerns for his safety. We hold the President of the Republic, the General Directorate of Prisons and Rehabilitation, and the Ministry of Justice fully responsible for his life and for any harm that may befall him.”


“A man has been on hunger strike for more than a month in a Tunisian prison because he refuses to accept that solidarity with Palestine is a crime. His heart could stop at any moment,” the letter reads. “Tunisia has long stood with the Palestinian people and resisted colonialism. We ask its government to remember that history, and to act before another prisoner pays with his life.”


Since Tunisian president Kais Saied took office in 2021, the country has been on a “slide back into authoritarianism”, with political activists frequently detained without charge,

Human Rights Watch said

 earlier this month.

author: Daron Letts
title: Ubluriak Society offers free breakfast and lunch in Sanikiluaq
content:
A non-profit is offering free breakfast and lunch to hungry Sanikiluaq residents every weekday after the

Ubluriak Society relaunched its

food programs Monday.


“Free food twice a day — Monday to Friday,” said Isaac Mensah, the society’s operations manager, Wednesday in a phone interview.


Up to 70 people attend each meal, held at the Ubluriak Centre, which occupies the former hamlet building, he said.


The menus are simple, but filling.


Bacon and eggs, cereals and toast, and coffee are on hand for breakfast, while lunches include burgers and hot dogs, which two new full-time staff cook on portable grills. Two new full-time servers supervise the mealtimes.


On Wednesday, the society received by air from Winnipeg skids of frozen food that fill two freezers. The dry goods arrived from Montreal by sealift last month.


The society supplements its stock with other food purchased locally.


The lion’s share of the funding — $160,000 — was covered through the Department of Family Services’s Nunavut Food Security Community Initiatives Core Funding program.


Food Banks Canada, a national charitable organization that supports food security initiatives, chipped in another $18,000.


The breakfast program first began in April 2025, but meals were offered “inconsistently,” Mensah said.


“We were having issues with staffing.”


With that uncertainty gone, Mensah said the community can count on regular meals.


The crew is also adapting to challenges. For example, when the community experienced a power outage on Tuesday, the cooks and servers switched to cold foods without interrupting service.


Sarah Narlik,

Ubluriak

Society program co-ordinator, said “seeing the people happy” during mealtimes makes her happy too.


Meals are not all the society offers.


It runs an after-school program from 4 p.m. to 9 p.m. Monday to Friday, during which teens can play games, socialize over snacks, or just quietly do homework.


“We help them to identify their potential and we help them to build it,” Mensah said.


Four of the teens helped Mensah unload Wednesday’s food shipment.


Other initiatives include a six-week sewing program with free materials for 12 women to make mittens and parkas. The participants will be selected by a draw, and the program starts in October.


The society is sitting on a sea can filled with construction materials staff plan to use to build an elders cabin, Mensah said. Once windows and the rest of the materials arrive he hopes the building can begin in November.


On Thursday the society planned to lead a walk for suicide prevention awareness that would begin and end at the centre. It’s scheduled to start at 1 p.m. and finish with a barbecue at 2 p.m.

title: 23ο Αντιρατσιστικό Φεστιβάλ Λάρισας, 25-26/9, στη κεντρική πλατεία
content:
Ακολουθεί η αφίσα και το πρόγραμμα των εκδηλώσεων:


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


Από

Αντιρατσιστική πρωτοβουλία Λάρισας:


23ο Αντιρατσιστικό φεστιβάλ Λάρισας 25 και 26 Σεπτεμβρίου


Κεντρική πλατεία Λάρισας


“Ο πόλεμος τους σκοτώνει ό,τι άφησε όρθιο η ειρήνη τους…”


έγραφε ο Μπέρτολτ Μπρεχτ


Ο πόλεμος τους…


Η γενοκτονία στην Παλαιστίνη από το δολοφονικό κράτος του Ισραήλ και ο βίαιος εποικισμός στη Δ. Όχθη συνεχίζεται παρά την υποτιθέμενη εκεχειρία. Ο απολογισμός: 77.000 νεκροί μέχρι στιγμής, από τους οποίους 21.000 είναι παιδιά, που θα φτάσουν τους 200.000 με ανθρώπους που είναι θαμμένοι στα ερείπια. Δολοφονημένοι: 263 δημοσιογράφοι και 1.700 ιατρικό και νοσηλευτικό προσωπικό.


Έκθεση του ΟΗΕ αποδεικνύει ότι το Ισραήλ σκοπίμως σκοτώνει παιδιά και πλήθος εκθέσεων άλλων οργανισμών συνηγορούν στη γενοκτονία.


Η Ελλάδα γίνεται συνένοχος της παλαιστινιακής γενοκτονίας ενισχύοντας με πολλούς τρόπους το Ισραήλ όπως και με την αγορά του συστήματος αεράμυνας «Ασπίδα του Αχιλλέα», αξίας 3,5 δισ. Ευρώ. Η συνεργασία των Ελληνικών Πανεπιστημίων με το Ισραήλ συνεισφέρουν στην ανάπτυξη της τεχνολογίας πολέμου


Ο πόλεμος που ξεκίνησε με την εισβολή της Ρωσίας στην Ουκρανία συνεχίζεται. Οι επιθέσεις των ΗΠΑ στο Ιράν, με πρώτη πράξη πολέμου τον βομβαρδισμό σχολείου που στοίχισε τη ζωή σε 168 παιδιά, του Ισραήλ στο Λίβανο και τη Συρία, κάνουν τη Μέση Ανατολή να έχει πάρει φωτιά, ενώ ξοδεύονται δις στις πολεμικές επιχειρήσεις.


Η απαγωγή του εκλεγμένου πρόεδρου της Βενεζουέλας από τις ΗΠΑ, η επιβολή εμπάργκο στη Κούβα που οδηγεί σε λιμοκτονία το λαό της, είναι ενέργειες βίαιες και παράνομες.


Οι μεγάλες «δημοκρατίες» πολεμούν, και εξολοθρεύουν απροκάλυπτα με στόχο την ενίσχυση της ισχύος τους. Η ΕΕ φουλάρει τις πολεμικές μηχανές της με 800δις και με τις ζωές μας, για να αναγεννηθεί ο καπιταλισμός επενδύοντας στα μελλοντικά προϊόντα θανάτου. Αλλά όποιος προετοιμάζεται για πόλεμο, τον θέλει.


Η “ειρήνη” τους


Η “ειρήνη” τους είναι μια εγκληματική πολιτική που χαράσσει σύνορα και πνίγει ανθρώπους Το πολύνεκρο ναυάγιο στα ανοιχτά της Πύλου το 2023 είναι ένα έγκλημα που δεν θα ξεχαστεί. Οι παράνομες επαναπροώθησεις συνεχίζονται με αποτέλεσμα δεκάδες νεκρούς, όπως οι πρόσφυγες στη Χίο το 2026 μετά από εμβολισμό της βάρκας τους.


Η “ειρήνη” τους δολοφόνησε 35.000 ανθρώπους από το 2014 μέχρι σήμερα, στη Μεσόγειο και στα κλειστά σύνορα της ΕΕ-φρούριο. Το Νέο Σύμφωνο για τη Μετανάστευση και το Άσυλο σφραγίζει την αντιμεταναστευτική πολιτική της ΕΕ, που ακολουθεί τα βήματα του Τραμπ.


Με τα Κέντρα Επιστροφής “return hub” σε τρίτες χώρες της Αφρικής και της Ασίας που δρομολογεί ο Πλεύρης και άλλα μέλη της ΕΕ το καθεστώς εξαίρεσης νομιμοποιείται και κανονικοποιείται. Στα νέα κολαστήρια της Σιντικής και της ΒΙΑΛ της Χίου χιλιάδες πρόσφυγες και μετανάστες κρατούνται στις φυλακές χωρίς να έχουν διαπράξει κανένα έγκλημα.


Η “ειρήνη” τους είναι τo γκρίζο κύμα της ακροδεξιάς που έρχεται δυναμικά, αφού πριμοδοτείται από την αστική πολιτική. Οι μηχανισμοί εξουσίας ανακατευθύνουν την οργή σ’ αυτούς και αυτές που δεν έχουν τίποτα, που ζουν αποκλεισμένες και πασχίζουν να διαρρήξουν τα αγκαθωτά συρματοπλέγματα που περιβάλλουν τις ζωές τους. Με κοινά στοιχεία τον ρατσισμό, τον εθνικισμό, την λευκή υπεροχή και την πατριαρχία, η ακροδεξιά έχει κανονικοποιηθεί.


Η “ειρήνη” τους οπλίζει το χέρι των αστυνομικών που δολοφονούν Ρομά, αναπήρους όπως τον Θοδωρή και αγωνιστές όπως τον Βασίλη Μάγγο.


Η “ειρήνη” τους βάζει το κέρδος πάνω από την ανθρώπινη ζωή: όπως στα Τέμπη, στην Βιολάντα κά.


201 καταγεγραμμένοι θάνατοι το 2025 και 14.000 καταγεγραμμένα εργατικά ατυχήματα.


Η “ειρήνη” τους μετράει 15 γυναικοκτονίες μέσα στο 2026, ομοφοβικές και τρασφοβικές επιθέσεις και εξορίζει κάθε μη ¨κανονικό¨ σώμα, με αποτέλεσμα και την αύξηση της εφηβικής αυτοκτονικότητας.


Η “ειρήνη” στερεί σε ανθρώπους το δικαίωμα στη στέγη και υποβαθμίζει το σύστημα υγείας.


Η “ειρήνη” τους δίνει μισθό που δεν βγάζει το μήνα, νομοθετεί 13ωρα δουλειάς και εργασιακό μεσαίωνα.


Η “ειρήνη” τους είναι μια τεράστια υφαρπαγή πόρων (γη, νερό, δάση κλπ), διαρκείς περιφράξεις και περιβαλλοντική καταστροφή, αποτέλεσμα του αχαλίνωτου καπιταλισμού που λεηλατεί την φύση.


από ανθρώπινη ανάγκη. Ποιός αξίζει τελικά να έχει στέγη; να έχει ένα “υγιεινό” πιάτο φαγητό; Όταν η γη, το νερό, o χώρος μεταβάλλονται σε κερδοφόρο απόθεμα


Η τεχνητή νοημοσύνη γίνεται «ανώτερη» από την ανθρωπότητα, αφού έχει κλέψει τον πλούτο της (την ανθρώπινη διάνοια) …

author: Jeniffer Mendonça
title: Flávio Bolsonaro e aliados divulgam apostas do Polymarket como pesquisa eleitoral
content:
Pelo menos 10 candidatos, incluindo Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), divulgaram apostas de mercados de previsão, como Polymarket e Kalshi, como forma de apontar uma suposta vantagem do presidenciável em relação a Lula (PT). Para especialistas ouvidos pelo

Núcleo

, as publicações violam a legislação eleitoral, que proíbe a divulgação de dados que não sejam de pesquisas registradas, e podem confundir a percepção dos eleitores.


O movimento ganhou força logo após a página do Polymarket nos Estados Unidos ter

postado

 no X que Flávio Bolsonaro atingiu “o pico mais alto de todos os tempos nas probabilidades da eleição presidencial do Brasil, com o primeiro turno a apenas duas semanas”. O post, feito no domingo (20.set), mostrava o gráfico das apostas feitas naquele dia, em que o candidato aparecia com 58%. 


BREAKING: Flávio Bolsonaro surges to an all-time high in Brazil's presidential election odds, with the first round just two weeks away.

58% chance.

pic.twitter.com/lHnLMGig5m

— Polymarket (@Polymarket)

September 20, 2026


Apesar de plataformas de mercados de previsão como o Polymarket estarem proibidas de operar no Brasil desde 24.abr.2026, a página no X continua acessível para usuários brasileiros. A rede social não faz parte do Conselho Digital, associação que reúne 10 big techs e tem um acordo de cooperação com a Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas (SPA) que permite a exclusão de conteúdos considerados irregulares sem passar pelo Poder Judiciário. 


Por isso, os perfis dessas plataformas no Instagram, por exemplo, não estão disponíveis no Brasil desde a proibição. Já 27 sites de mercados de previsão foram bloqueados após notificação da Agência Nacional de Telecomunicações (Anatel), a pedido da secretaria.


Proibido, mas ainda disponível


A assessoria da Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas informou que “o bloqueio já foi implementado pela maioria dos provedores”, mas a reportagem verificou que, mesmo com a proibição no Brasil, em alguns estados o acesso ao site do Polymarket continua disponível, como no Rio de Janeiro, mesmo sem utilização de VPN.


No Instagram, o próprio Flávio Bolsonaro republicou o gráfico do Polymarket em um Story, em 21.set., a partir da página

@hora_livre22

, com mais de 146 mil seguidores, que, por sua vez, reproduziu o tweet do Polymarket no X.


Publicação de Flávio Bolsonaro no Instagram


Mas foi no próprio X que a maioria das publicações dos candidatos localizadas pelo

Núcleo

 foi feita.


O vereador

Lucas Pavanato

 (SP), o deputado federal

Mário Frias

 (SP), o vereador

Gilson Machado Filho

 (PE) e o vereador

Renan Paes

 (SP), todos do PL que disputam cargos para deputado estadual ou federal, repercutiram ou o post original ou o gráfico do Polymarket seguido da frase “vai ser no primeiro turno!”. O deputado

Lucas Bove

 (SP), também do partido, postou a métrica seguida de “vai ser Bolsonaro!” com uma foto em destaque do presidenciável.


O deputado federal

Mauricio Marcon

 (PL-RS), que busca a reeleição, comentou sobre a métrica, ainda no sábado (19.set), indicando que a diferença de 15% a favor de Flávio “jamais havia sido registrada” e emendou dizendo que a vitória de Donald Trump contra Kamala Harris, em 2024, “registrava um índice similar ao que vemos neste momento no Brasil”, reforçando uma ligação entre a vitória do presidente dos Estados Unidos e o dado da plataforma. Dois dias depois, comemorou em novo post com o gráfico do Polymarket: “Pela 1ª vez Flávio bate 60% de chances de vitória!”.


Vai ser no primeiro turno!

https://t.co/A1ozVA5jPZ

— MarioFrias 2208 (@mfriasoficial)

September 21, 2026


No mesmo tom, o candidato a deputado federal

Rodrigo Lima

 (Novo-PB)  vibrou com o gráfico de linhas da plataforma: “ACABOU LULA, ACABOU 60 pontos na Poly pow. Isso é pornográfico

”.


Já o deputado federal e vice-líder do PL na Câmara,

Bibo Nunes

 (RS), usou inteligência artificial para ilustrar os dados do Polymarket e da Kalshi em formato de gráfico de barras e setas direcionadas para cima, acompanhadas de uma foto manipulada de Flávio Bolsonaro e a frase “a nossa vitória será com glória!”, além do seu número de urna e da sua filha, Camila Nunes, que pleiteia uma vaga na Assembleia Legislativa do Rio Grande do Sul. Bem abaixo, é indicado na imagem que os percentuais divulgados são de mercados de previsão. O post foi publicado tanto na conta do parlamentar no X quanto na do Instagram.

title: Gazeteci Murat Bay: Urfa depremi hazırlıksızlığı ve koordinasyon sorunlarını gösterdi
content:
Urfa’da bugün saat 10.40’ta meydana gelen deprem, başta merkez üssünün bulunduğu Karaköprü ilçesi olmak üzere kent genelinde ve çevre illerde hissedildi.


AFAD depremin büyüklüğünü 5,4, Kandilli Rasathanesi ise 5,5 olarak açıkladı. Kandilli’ye göre depremin merkez üssü, Karaköprü ilçesine bağlı Pınarbaşı Mahallesi.


bianet’e konuşan ve deprem sırasında Karaköprü’de bulunan gazeteci Murat Bay, depremin ardından kent merkezinden kırsal bölgelere doğru yoğun bir hareketlilik yaşandığını söyledi.


Bay’a göre deprem sonrasında yaşananlar, kentteki hazırlıksızlığı ve koordinasyon sorunlarını gösterdi.


Urfa’da 5,4 büyüklüğünde deprem


Bugün  10:55


“İnsanlar nerede bekleyeceklerini bilemedi”


Normal koşullarda yaklaşık 15 dakika süren bir mesafeyi deprem sonrasında bir saatte kat edebildiklerini belirten Bay, evlerinden çıkan çok sayıda yurttaşın da refüjlerde ve yol kenarlarındaki sınırlı açık alanlarda beklediğini anlattı.


Bay, deprem sonrası geçtiği güzergâhlarda trafik akışını düzenleyen veya yurttaşları yönlendiren herhangi bir görevli görmediğini söyledi.


İlk saatlerde trafik ve acil durum yönlendirmesinde ciddi bir koordinasyon sorunu vardı. Çocuklarını okuldan almaya çalışanlar da evlerinden ve işyerlerinden çıkanlar da nerede bekleyeceklerini bilemiyor, refüjlerde ve yol kenarlarında duruyordu.

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Iqaluit resident starts fundraiser to support John Amagoalik’s care in Nunavut
content:
An online fundraiser is collecting money for the medical needs of John Amagoalik, revered by many as the “Father of Nunavut.”


Amagoalik, 78, had been residing at the Embassy West long-term care home in Ottawa after a surgery forced the partial amputation of one of his legs. He was lonely there, he has said, and eager to return to the territory he helped create through decades of land claim negotiations.


He returned

 in June, with money that his friends and family helped fundraise. That money is now

running out

 after the territorial Health Department declined to fund the roughly $16,000 per month in medical support and housing costs he needs in order to live out his final days in his homeland.


Iqaluit resident Jessica Hale, who describes herself on GoFundMe as a qallunaaq that cares deeply about social justice, created the fundraiser and set a $50,000 target. If reached, the amount could cover about three months of his care.


“John Amagoalik dedicated more than 25 years of his life to creating Nunavut,” Hale wrote on her GoFundMe page.


The fundraiser, which had raised $2,600 as of Thursday morning, was created on Sept. 18.


Amagoalik has

filed a civil suit

 against the department, seeking a judicial review of the Health Department’s decision not to fund his care.


Steve Kelliher, Amagoalik’s spokesperson, close friend and lawyer, said Hale is a friend of Anne Crawford, a seniors advocate in Iqaluit who is among those fundraising on Amagoalik’s behalf.


“I’ve been getting phone calls from people all over the country who want to contribute,” said Mark Stiles, another close friend of Amagoalik. He said he’s grateful to see that people are contributing to the GoFundMe.


“It’s an interim measure until the Government of Nunavut comes to its senses.”


His legal counsel is also requesting an urgent hearing through a separate court application, so that Amagoalik immediately be provided with medical care and housing.

author: Daron Letts
title: Deputy mayor warns against accuracy of former mayor’s AI-based website
content:
People in Iqaluit should not depend on a new w

ebsite launched

this month

 by former Iqaluit mayor Kenny Bell because it relies on artificial intelligence, says deputy Mayor Kim Smith.


Smith cautioned against trusting Bell’s City Hall Record website during Tuesday’s council meeting and again in a social media post Wednesday morning.


“Residents should be interested in council’s work, should ask questions, and should expect clear and accountable decision-making,” she wrote in the post, echoing her comments from the night before. “But, we should also be careful about presenting an AI-generated website as an authoritative record.”


When asked for comment after Wednesday’s meeting, Smith told Nunatsiaq News, “AI isn’t the same as legitimate news and sources.”


City Hall Record uses ChatGPT to pull information from public documents on the City of Iqaluit website and from livestream audio of city council and committee meetings.


Bell agrees with Smith that AI is fallible and acknowledges some limitations, like the fact that audio from city meetings doesn’t include interpretation for things said in Inuktitut.


“Sadly I can only review the English audio posted by the city,” he said over text message.


He added that his website has a methodology page which includes a way to send in requests for correction.


“Deputy Mayor Smith is right, AI can make mistakes — so do people,” he said. “What matters is if a claim holds up against the original documents and if errors are corrected.”


Bell was elected to a four-year term as Iqaluit mayor in 2019, but

resigned

 without finishing that term in 2022. He previously served one term as councillor.


Smith addressed one of the investigations featured on Bell’s website, which looks into the water capacity of Lake Geraldine, the city’s reservoir.


“To be clear, water is no longer holding us back from building housing,” Smith said. “With a successful pumping campaign from the Apex River, we have been able to maintain our current reservoir and are sitting right now on 500 days of water for our municipality.”


She also

pointed to a $108-million funding announcement

 from April that is set to bolster Iqaluit’s water and sewage infrastructure.


The city will also soon get a

second reservoir

, paid for with

$214-million in federal funding

 announced in 2022. The reservoir should be

operational by 2031

, city officials said earlier this year.


“Our long-term water project is expected to meet the city’s needs for the next 50 years minimum,” she said.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Should U.N. Help Set Global AI Rules? AI Tech Billionaires Address Security Council
content:
Leaders of top artificial intelligence firms, including OpenAI

CEO

 Sam Altman and Anthropic

CEO

 Dario Amodei, testified to the U.N. Security Council on Wednesday, urging nations to adopt international standards on the development of AI. This comes after AI agents at OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google have gone rogue in recent months, hacking into other companies’ corporate systems and, in the case of OpenAI, into the portal of Australia’s public health insurance program.


“I think we’re headed in the right direction,” says Malo Bourgon,

CEO

 of the Machine Intelligence Research Institute, who has participated in several AI-related meetings on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly this week. “I do think that the CEOs, while there’s a bunch of reason to be cynical about them, are sincere that they think that the progress with this technology is moving too quickly and that they risk losing control of it, and that that could lead to permanent disempowerment or human extinction.”

author: Unknown
title: Greater unity, stronger struggle
content:
In its statement of 21 September, the Asrın Law Office said that circles profiting from war and opposing the Peace and Democratic Society Process have intensified their attacks on the Kurdish Freedom Movement, particularly Kurdish People’s Leader Abdullah Öcalan, and through them on the Kurdish people. These attacks have even reached the level of insults.


Such attacks are coming not only from fascist-nationalist circles hostile to the Kurds, but also from social-nationalist circles that call themselves leftist. In unison, they oppose the Peace and Democratic Society Process by claiming that it “will not succeed.” In other words, they want a return to the period before the Call for Peace and Democratic Society of 27 February 2025. They oppose peace and want war. They oppose democratic politics and a democratic society, saying, “Let the Kurds continue fighting so that we can benefit and profit from this war.” In other words, they want to reduce the Kurds to the role of “hitmen”!


What, then, can really be said about such people? Clearly, if we say, “They openly want to act as war barons,” it will have neither meaning nor effect for them. If we call them “war profiteers and bloodsuckers,” that is already what they have knowingly and willingly been doing for decades. If we say, “If you want war so badly, go ahead and fight it yourselves. Who is stopping you?” such words will again have no effect on them, because during the previous period of war, they were the ones who stayed far away from the arenas of struggle.


Clearly, such people see themselves as highly intelligent and cunning and everyone else as “fools.” Yet it is they who display the real foolishness and hypocrisy. At their core lies a very deep opposition and hostility towards the Kurds, which is why they engage in such frenzied warmongering. They are becoming so vociferous and aggressive because they see that the Peace and Democratic Society Process is closing off the avenues from which they have profited.


There is undoubtedly no shortage of things that could be said about such people. In fact, one could say anything that comes to mind, but they have no sense of shame and therefore understand nothing from words. Rather than saying anything to them, it is more meaningful and important to raise public awareness about them and expose their repulsive face. More importantly, the real task is to work and struggle to eliminate the conditions that sustain them.


What kind of environment allows these circles, hostile to the Kurds and to humanity, to sustain themselves? What enables them to become so aggressive? What conditions nourish them? After all, without the ground on which they rely and from which they draw sustenance, they could not survive for even a day. Rather than directing words at such circles, it is more appropriate and meaningful to struggle to eliminate the conditions that shelter and sustain them.


Clearly, such circles are deeply afraid that the Peace and Democratic Society Process will close off the avenues from which they profit, and this is why they attack the process. As long as the process does not break down and continues to make progress, their fears, and the attacks stemming from those fears, increase. This can be seen as one dimension of these attacks. Another dimension is the failure to fulfil the requirements of the Peace and Democratic Society Process in a timely manner.


The Kurdish side, Abdullah Öcalan and the Kurdish Freedom Movement are making great efforts to fulfil their responsibilities within the framework of the process. They may not be sufficiently creative and effective, but it is clear that they are making a serious and consistent effort within their own sphere to meet the requirements of the process. What provides fertile ground for the circles in question is the failure of the Justice and Development Party (AKP) government and the state to take the steps towards democratization and political participation required by the process.


Although a month and a half has passed since the “framework law” was adopted by parliament with a record number of votes on the night of 10 August, the AKP government has taken no serious steps to implement it. Apart from the meeting of the “Monitoring and Oversight Board” on 24 August, no significant activity has been seen, nor have the decisions announced at that meeting been implemented. Everyone is now waiting. The AKP is expected to move beyond words and take practical steps. It is …

author: Unknown
title: ERC and EH Bildu call for support to the peace process in Turkey
content:
Esquerra Republicana re-submitted to the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Congress in Madrid a non-legislative proposal in support of the Kurds in Turkey and the peace process initiated there. 


The proposal was originally submitted last year, but, as it was not discussed, ER presented it again. Francesc-Marc Alvaro said that “the proposal did not prosper due to the opposing vote from the PP and PSOE, who do not want to upset Erdoğan.”


Jon Iñarritu, deputy from EH Bildu, said: “First of all, we would like to thank the Republican Group for bringing forward this motion. Until now, particularly over the past few decades, we have spoken about the Kurds as the largest stateless nation in the world, in terms of the repression and denial they face in all the states where they live, whether in Iran, Iraq, Syria, and especially Turkey.”


Iñarritu added: “Where the Kurdish population is largest, there is now a sense of hope. There is hope because a peace process has been opened and, as Mr. Mark Álvaro rightly pointed out, last August the Turkish Grand National Assembly approved the Law on Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Integration. This is a step toward strengthening the peace process and seeking a political solution to the conflict in Turkey.


While it is true that this is a step, in our view, it is insufficient. Because it is insufficient, we must continue encouraging the Turkish authorities to move forward, consolidate this process, and make progress on human rights, political and civil liberties, and democratic guarantees for the Kurdish people. Likewise, we must recognize the steps that have been taken and the willingness shown by the Kurdish side. We also join the call for the freedom of Mr. Abdullah Öcalan, who has taken the first steps toward advancing this dialogue and achieving a comprehensive resolution to the political conflict that has existed in Turkey for decades.”


Iñarritu continued: “This conflict does not concern only Turkey; it concerns the wider world and Europe as well. If we are calling on the Spanish government, which often presents itself as a reference point for peace, human rights, and international law, we should also call on it to take steps to strengthen this peace process. And, of course, we call on the European Union to contribute to and support the consolidation of this process.


For these reasons, we support the motion put forward by the Republican Group and will vote in favor.”


The proposal reads as follows: 


Non-legislative proposals


"The Congress of Deputies urges the Spanish government to:


1- Demand the release of Abdullah Öcalan, who must be allowed to participate in the political process for resolving the conflict and to communicate freely with any political, media, and civil society actor.


2- Reach an agreement with the other member states of the European Union on a common position regarding the negotiation process in Turkey, one that ensures a just peace and removes the PKK from the list of terrorist organizations in order to prevent future reprisals against Kurdish citizens.


3- Make use of diplomatic pressure, in coordination with the European Union, so that the Turkish Parliament implements the legislative changes necessary to protect fundamental rights. Specifically, domestic legislation must implement the judgment of the European Court of Human Rights in the case of Öcalan v. Turkey, which protects the right to belief in the context of the life imprisonment sentence currently imposed."

title: Pirsgirêka peydakirina çekan a zarokan di rojeva Parlamentoyê de ye
content:
Parlamentera Partiya Nû ya Enqereyê Gamze Taşcier, piştî êrişên ku li dibistana navçeya Turgutluya Manisayê pêk hat, bûyerên bi çek yên ku zarok tevli bûne, xist rojeva Parlamentoyê.


Taşcierê di pêşnûmeya ku bi daxwaza Wezîrê Dadê Akin Gurlek bibersivîne de, cih da daneyên Rêveberiya Giştî ya Sicîla Dadî û Îstatîstîkan.


Li gorî vê yekê, di çarçoveya Qanûna Çekên Guleber û Kêr û Amûrên Din a bi hejmara 6136an de, di qonaxa lêpirsînê de:


Di sala 2023an de di 6 hezar û 122 doseyan de derbarê 6 hezar û 293 zarokan de 7 hezar û 27 sûc,


Di sala 2024an de di 7 hezar û 641 doseyan de derbarê 7 hezar û 929 zarokan de 8 hezar û 998 sûc,


Di sala 2025an de jî di 8 hezar û 567 doseyan de derbarê 9 hezar û 93 zarokan de biryara 10 hezar û 351 sûcan hatin dayîn.


Taşcierê bi berhevkirina daneyên navbera salên 2023 û 2025an diyar kir ku hejmara dosyeyan ji sedî 39,9, hejmara sûcan ji sedî 47,3 û hejmara qeydên derbarê zarokan de jî ji sedî 44,5 zêde bûye.


Zarok çekan li kîderê peyda dikin?


Taşcierê ji Wezaretê pirsî ku Wezaret derbarê rê û rêbazên ku zarok bi wan digehêjin çekên guleber, qeyd û daneyan digire an na.


Taşçierê daxwaz kir ku daneyên pênc salên dawî yên derbarê vê yekê de ku ka zarok ji mala malbatê, ji derdorên nêzîk, ji kesên sêyem an jî bi rêya firotina neyasayî digehêjin çekan bên eşkere kirin.


Her weha Taşcierê pirsî ku ka derbarê bûyerên ku çekên guleber tê de hatine bikaranîn û zarokan tê de cih girtine di dibistanê de, li derdora dibistanê ango di rêya dibistanê de qewimîne de îstatîstîkek cuda tê girtin an na.


Heke kategoriyeke wisa ya daneyan a Wezaretê tune ye jî ka bi berçavgirtina êrişên bi çek ku di heyama dawî de li dibistan û derdora dibistanan de qewimîne dê kategoriyek bê avakirin an na.

author: The Case
title: Αναβλήθηκε για τις 28 Ιανουαρίου 2027 η δίκη των δύο επιζώντων της δολοφονίας Σαμπάνη
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Αναβλήθηκε για τις 28 Ιανουαρίου 2027 η δίκη των δύο επιζώντων της δολοφονίας Σαμπάνη


Το Τριμελές Δικαστήριο Ανηλίκων Πειραιά ανέβαλε σήμερα την δίκη των δύο τότε ανηλίκων που ήταν στο αυτοκίνητο μαζί με τον Νίκο Σαμπάνη τη νύχτα της δολοφονίας του.


Παρότι οι 7 αστυνομικοί έχουν παραπεμφθεί σε δίκη – με τον ισχυρισμό τους περί άμυνας να έχει καταρριφθεί, όπως έγινε και με τον ψευδή ισχυρισμό ότι ο Νίκος Σαμπάνης ήταν ο οδηγός του οχήματος – οι δύο τότε ανήλικοι παραπέμφθηκαν σε δίκη.


Η εξ αναβολής δικάσιμος ορίστηκε για τις 28 Ιανουαρίου 2027.


Ακολουθεί το σχετικό κείμενο του

Δικτύου Αλληλεγγύης Ρομά – Μπαλαμέ

:


Πέντε (!) χρόνια έχουν περάσει από τις 22 Οκτωβρίου 2021, όταν ο Νίκος Σαμπάνης δολοφονήθηκε στο Πέραμα εν ψυχρώ και με ρατσιστικά κίνητρα από αστυνομικούς της ομάδας ΔΙ.ΑΣ. Ενώ οι 7 μπάτσοι παραπέμφθηκαν με δικαστικό βούλευμα σε δίκη για τετελεσμένη ανθρωποκτονία (του Ν. Σαμπάνη) όσο και για απόπειρες ανθρωποκτονίας (κατά των ανηλίκων επιβαινόντων) με δόλο, σε ήρεμη ψυχική κατάσταση, βλέπουμε ότι ενεργοποιείται νωρίτερα και εσκεμμένα μια δικαστική διαδικασία εις βάρος των δύο άλλων επιβαινόντων.


Ωστόσο, το ίδιο βούλευμα καταρρίπτει τον ισχυρισμό των μπάτσων περί άμυνας, αφήνοντας έκθετη την καθεστωτική εκδοχή περί αστυνομικής «επιχείρησης» ενώ αναγνωρίζει ότι ο Νίκος Σαμπάνης δολοφονήθηκε ευρισκόμενος στη θέση του συνοδηγού και όχι του οδηγού όπως ψευδώς υποστήριζαν οι αστυνομικοί.


Πρόκειται για μια απόπειρα μεθόδευσης και συγκάλυψης αφού στοχεύει αφενός στη μετατόπιση της ευθύνης των μπάτσων, αφετέρου στη δημιουργία ενός ευνοϊκού νομικού προηγούμενου για την κεντρική δίκη που θα ακολουθήσει, εντός του 2027. Σε μια ήδη πολύ καθυστερημένη δίκη που βρίσκεται στο κατώφλι της παραβίασης του δικαιώματος σε δίκαιη δίκη εντός εύλογης προθεσμίας, έρχεται να προστεθεί άλλο ένα δικαστήριο το οποίο δεν έχει αξιώσει ενδελεχή έρευνα της υπόθεσης ενώ επανατραυματίζει την οικογένεια Σαμπάνη φέρνοντάς την ξανά αντιμέτωπη με τους δολοφόνους του Νίκου.


Τόσο η οικογένεια Σαμπάνη όσο και το Δίκτυο Αλληλεγγύης Ρομά Μπαλαμέ, δεν ξεχνάμε την συστημική υποτίμηση της τσιγγάνικης ζωής από τα πάνω και το συναινετικό υπόδειγμα που κατασκευάζεται καθημερινά και από πολλές μεριές για την απανθρωποποίηση των Ρομά.


Δεν ξεχνάμε τον πρώην υπουργό Τάκη Θεοδωρικάκο που είχε επισκεφτεί τους υφιστάμενους αστυνομικούς για να τους εμψυχώσει, δεν ξεχνάμε τα συναδελφικά «ήρωες, ήρωες» για τους δολοφόνους έξω από δικαστήρια – σε τέτοιες συνθήκες μάς είναι αδιανόητο να μην βρεθούμε αντιμέτωποι με την οργανωμένη καταστολή του ελληνικού κράτους, για να την συρρικνώσουμε και να την διαλύσουμε δείχνοντας ότι ένας τέτοιος σάπιος κόσμος δεν έχει θέση στη ζωή και τους αγώνες μας. Όσο οι μνήμες και οι καταγραφές μας γεμίζουν από τα ρατσιστικά μοτίβα περιθωριοποίησης των τσιγγάνων, θεσμικά, κοινωνικά, συμπεριφορικά, τόσο θα ενοχλούμε την κυρίαρχη ορθογραφία της δηκεοσίνις.


Η οικογένεια του Ν. Σαμπάνη αντιλαμβάνεται τους αλληλένδετους αγώνες μας και είναι μπροστάρισσα, όπως για παράδειγμα στην υπεράσπιση των Κατειλημμένων Προσφυγικών και στην υπόθεση του Βασίλη Μάγγου. Στο πλευρό της Μάγδας Φύσσα και της Ελένης Κωστοπούλου, σε πορείες και σε αντιφασιστικά καλέσματα, η οικογένεια Σαμπάνη μας κάνει να συνειδητοποιούμε πόσο επιτακτική είναι η πολιτική ανάγκη να μην σωπαίνουμε ούτε δευτερόλεπτο για τον δίκαιο αγώνα που δίνει η ίδια και να παλεύουμε για τις συνδέσεις των αγώνων με σκοπό την κοινωνική ελευθερία και δικαιοσύνη.


Για τη δυνατότητα κοινών αγώνων / Με όπλο την αλληλεγγύη


Τσιγγάνοι, μπαλαμοί / Ενάντια στο Ελληνικό Κράτος και τον αστυνομικό βραχίονά του


Αναβλήθηκε για τις 28 Ιανουαρίου 2027 η δίκη των δύο επιζώντων της δολοφονίας Σαμπάνη

title: Le péril rose / une émission de Minuit Décousu
content:
Vagues d'interpellations et de perquisitions en Turquie, interdiction des prides en Hongrie et Bulgarie, qualifications terroristes en Russie et aux États-Unis, répression contre les «

 

actes contre-nature

 

» au Sénégal... L'internationale réactionnaire fait feu de tout bois contre les communautés

LGBTQI

+ et contre les mouvements transpédégouines qui tentent de les contrer. Partout, le combat hétéro-sexiste contre «

 

l'idéologie du genre

 

» et pour la «

 

binarité biologique

 

» se renforce et continue de brutaliser, enfermer et tuer.


Après avoir causé des multiples backlashes auquel faisaient face les mouvements féministes

la semaine dernière

, Minuit Décousu a décidé de détricoter les luttes transpédégouines pour trouver quelques issues stratégiques contre les réactionnaires et masculinistes de tous bords.


Dans cette émission, tu pourras entendre un retour sur l'offensive réactionnaire internationale contre les droits des personnes queers, des camarades de feu le pink bloc lyonnais, qui nous racontent ses débuts et la construction d'une mobilisation

TPG

 radicale à Lyon autour de 2017-2018, iels nous racontent comment ce groupe a participé aux luttes antifascistes et a permis d'imposer une présence queer sur la scène lyonnaise. On écoute aussi des morceaux de chorales militantes qui participent à faire vivre et transmettre une forme d'histoire orales des luttes

LGBTQ

+. Et enfin, on recause du procès des fafs qui avaient attaqué la pride de Bordeaux de 2022.


L'émission s'écoute sur notre

audioblog

, ici, et un peu partout en podcast. Bonne écoute

 

!


Minuit Décousu, c'est un fanzine radiophonique nocturne sur

Radio Canut

 (Lyon et alentours),

Radio Vassivière

 (Limousin) et

Cause Commune

 (Paris/

IDF

). Semaine après semaine pendant une heure, on en découd avec la nuit et on tire les fils de sons, de textes, d'archives et de voix qui s'entremêlent.

title: Yeah, can confirm that while it’s bad in lots of places, the German queer left is a particularly…
content:
there’s a conversation here about how queer people who come from heavily poor, illiterate, traditional ass backgrounds have to put in fucking work to gain any real acceptance from the queer community so we’re not seen as ignorant and backwards but we also like don’t have community with our own families because of our gender and/or sexuality most times. it’s really rich that the progressive movement can acknowledge how poverty, illiteracy, religion, racial identity shape people but fully fail to understand it beyond good vs bad, enlightened vs ignorant, with us vs against us… like some of you fully cannot conceptualize a person that’s with you and on your side if they’re not exactly like you or deeply apologetic about where they came from because you look down on it. but i don’t really want to have that conversation with y’all.

This also happens to people who are Muslim, Arab, or just any kind of brown in queer communities. There’s always the assumption that they need to unlearn shit until they prove that they’re the good kind of Arab. Meanwhile white middle class city queers can have bigotry dripping out of every pore and are immediately welcomed.

A lot of my Muslim queer friends basically cannot go to queer events bc of the amount of shit they have to put up at them. When you start correcting people, they are p quick to get aggressive, bc you “know what they mean”, or they’re not “like that”.

At least here in Germany, even I as a queer eastern European can’t go to a queer event without having to swallow down a lot of shit from people. The sheer amount of people who have told me that they thought I was homophobic bc of where I’m from/that all ppl in my country are homophobic is. Very scary for a supposedly progressive community.

And to be clear, things were bad for Muslim queer people before the latest push of anti-muslim sentiment that’s been going on for a couple of years now. The amount of dehumanization many have to put up with to be in any leftist space at all is just disgusting.

Yeah, can confirm that while it’s bad in lots of places, the German queer left is a particularly horrible shitshow of islamophobia right now because they haven’t kicked out the zionists.

author: CNT Aragón-Rioja
title: 23 de septiembre: Día Internacional contra la Explotación Sexual y la Trata de Personas
content:
El 23 de septiembre se conmemora el

Día Internacional contra la Explotación Sexual y la Trata de Personas

. Desde la

CNT

 alzamos la voz contra una de las expresiones más crueles y descarnadas del capitalismo patriarcal: la mercantilización y el tráfico de seres humanos. No es una conmemoración más, es una continuación directa de la lucha que, por ejemplo, ya inundó las calles de Logroño el pasado 8 de marzo en la manifestación convocada por este sindicato en apoyo a las mujeres y niñas, víctimas mayoritarias del patriarcado y su violencia institucional.


Las cifras de la vergüenza: una profunda asimetría de género


La

trata

 abarca fines laborales, mendicidad forzada y delincuencia armada, además de la sexual, alcanzando a unos

50 millones de personas

. Pero si analizamos los datos observamos una profunda asimetría de género. Según la UNODC, las

mujeres y niñas

 representan el

61%

 del total de las víctimas en el mundo. Los

menores

 en conjunto ya representan cerca del

40%

 de las víctimas totales. El tráfico de niñas específicamente aumentó un

38%.


Del total de

víctimas mujeres

 (adultas y niñas) detectadas,

más del 70%

 son traficadas exclusivamente para explotación sexual. En el caso de los hombres, más del 60% son traficados para

trabajo forzoso / explotación laboral

.


Pero ojo,

cuando se aísla la

explotación sexual

 (que sigue siendo una de las variantes más rentables y detectadas), la brecha de género es absoluta:

el 92%

 de todas las víctimas registradas por explotación sexual en el mundo

son mujeres

. Diversos organismos locales (como el CITCO en España) elevan esta cifra hasta el

98%

 en sus balances de entornos de prostitución forzada. Y atención,

casi un tercio son menores

.


Las diferencias de género también se trasladan a la forma en que los tratantes retienen a las víctimas. En mujeres, predomina de manera masiva el

abuso psicológico, físico y sexual continuo

 combinado con amenazas hacia sus familias. En hombres, suele fundamentarse en la

servidumbre por deudas

, amenazas legales, retención de documentación o coacción laboral.


Violencia Institucional: El Estado no protege, maltrata y revictimiza


No podemos desligar esta explotación de la complicidad y el abandono del aparato estatal. Recientemente, el

segundo informe del Observatorio de Violencias Institucionales Machistas (OVIM)

 ha sacado a la luz datos demoledores publicados por

El Salto

. El sector judicial se consolida como el principal foco de violencia institucional, acumulando el

60,7% de las instituciones señaladas

 por ejercer malas prácticas, aplicar prejuicios sexistas y restarle credibilidad a las mujeres y menores.


Cuando el 94% de las instituciones señaladas impiden o dificultan el acceso a los derechos humanos y a las políticas públicas, queda claro que las víctimas de explotación no solo se enfrentan a las mafias y a los proxenetas, también se estrellan contra un

muro burocrático y judicial patriarcal

 que las juzga, las maltrata, las desprotege y las revictimiza.


Exigimos a las instituciones dedicadas a reinsertar a las mujeres que han sido víctimas de trata que dejen de ser asistenciales, patriarcales y moralistas. Estas instituciones son financiadas con dinero público. Necesitan más fondos y mejor gestión.


Tanto para quienes han salido de las redes de trata como para quienes ejerzan la prostitución y quieran dejarla, promover que os trabajos que se les ofrecen como alternativa tengan mejores condiciones, así como que no sean siempre trabajos altamente feminizados. Por ejemplo, una alternativa que se propone desde las instituciones son los trabajos de cuidados como el de atención a domicilio, cuyas condiciones laborales son indignas. Promover mejores condiciones salariales en estos trabajos y más facilidades de acceso a los mismos para las mujeres que quieran dejar la prostitución deberían ser prioridad como sindicato. Exigimos al ministerio de trabajo un plan de reinserción sociolaboral a la altura, con facilidades, financiación y ofertas de trabajo dignas.


La cuestión de la prostitución


Aunque prostitución y trata no es lo mismo, no podemos dejar de mencionarla. La prostitución constituye un medio de vida que, desde el sindicato, se pretende erradicar. No se considera un trabajo para el que conseguir mejoras.


En cuanto a las mujeres que ejercen por cuenta propia, entendemos que son una minoría y, por tanto, no el grueso del problema. Las mujeres trans en …

title: Kılıç: Mother-tongue education is a fundamental right
content:
Civil society organisations and political groups continue their efforts to secure recognition of Kurdish and other languages as languages of instruction, establish the right to mother-tongue education at every level from preschool to university, and place that right under legal protection. Advocates say mother tongues should not be confined to elective courses and are calling for a multilingual education model and official status for different languages.


Serhat Kılıç, Co-Chair of the Education and Science Workers’ Union (Eğitim Sen) Amed (Diyarbakır) Branch No. 2, spoke to ANF about the demand for mother-tongue education.


 


Children should begin education in the language through which they understand life


Kılıç stressed the importance of children beginning their education in a language that reflects their own lived experiences. He said: “The demand for mother-tongue education means that a child should begin their education in the language through which they first understand and experience life. Only then can education achieve its intended goals. Children who encounter an education system in a language other than their mother tongue begin life at a disadvantage in many respects. Without mother-tongue education, we can see disadvantages in achieving expected learning outcomes, developing self-confidence, fulfilling their potential and many other areas.”


Education is essential for a language to survive


Kılıç stressed that mother-tongue education should not be considered solely in terms of individual development, saying the language of instruction also plays a decisive role in keeping languages alive. He said the use of a language in education is crucial for its transmission from one generation to the next.


Kılıç added: “Beyond its impact on the individual, mother-tongue education is one of the most important factors in ensuring that a language can survive in this century. Today, it is extremely difficult for a language to sustain itself without being used in education. In Turkey, education is compulsory for all children from a certain age. Every child enters this system. If children do not encounter their own language within that system, its presence in everyday life will inevitably diminish over time, as will the areas in which it is used. Mother-tongue education is therefore vital for both the individual and society.”


This concerns the whole of society, not only Kurds


Kılıç said the demand for mother-tongue education is not limited to Kurds receiving education in Kurdish, stressing that all linguistic communities living in Turkey should have the right to education in their own languages. He said guaranteeing a place for mother tongues within the education system is also essential to preserving cultural diversity.


Kılıç continued: “Keeping different languages alive will benefit society as a whole. Many languages in Turkey have gradually lost their areas of use and have now disappeared. Multilingual education would help prevent languages from disappearing. Education will be one of the most important areas for preserving languages that are at risk of being lost.”


The framework law can be seen as a beginning


Kılıç also addressed developments in the Peace and Democratic Society Process and said: “The discussions on peace that have been under way for nearly two years have made social needs more visible. The process that began with the 27 February call has prompted debate on a range of issues. The framework law was recently adopted by parliament amid these discussions. Of course, we can say that the law does not address many of the needs of the people and society. Its scope is very limited and narrow. We hope that the measures society and democracy need will gradually be demanded, debated and eventually enacted into law in the period ahead. We will struggle to achieve this.”


The way must be opened for legal reforms


Kılıç said the legal barriers preventing the implementation of mother-tongue education must be removed. He said:“This will, of course, first require a change in the atmosphere in Turkey. That change must then be accompanied by legal reforms. There are currently laws in Turkey that stand in the way of mother-tongue education and mother-tongue-based multilingual education. These laws must first be changed. We do, of course, raise changing the definition of citizenship as a broader demand, but such a change is not required specifically for education. There is no need for it in order to …

title: FEDA and DAKB to hold memorial for Rıza Altun in Paris
content:
In a written statement, the Democratic Alevi Federation (FEDA) and the Democratic Alevi Women’s Union (DAKB) commemorated all martyrs “with respect and gratitude” in the person of Rıza Altun, one of the founding leaders of the Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK), who fell as a martyr on 25 September 2019.


The statement said: “To commemorate Rıza Altun, one of the noble representatives of those who, in their pursuit of rights and truth, said, ‘I would sacrifice my life for this path; let my body bear witness to it,’ means keeping alive his struggle, the memory of resistance and the invaluable legacy he left behind.”


The two Alevi organisations added: “As we keep Rıza Altun’s memory alive, we also strengthen our hope for peace, freedom and a democratic future. We believe that lasting peace can only be achieved by confronting the truth and by peoples building a life of equality and freedom.”


The statement announced that a commemoration would be held in Paris on 25 September “to commemorate Rıza Altun and be a voice for peace, freedom and truth”.


The details of the commemoration are as follows:


Venue: Espace Venise – Sarcelles, Paris


Time: 18:00


Address: 30 Route de Groslay, 95200 Sarcelles


The statement concluded: “We invite all our people, friends and comrades to join this meaningful commemoration.”

title: Trees cut down in Amediye are being transported to Turkey
content:
It was reported that trees were cut down over a large area in the village of Kêste, in the Berwara Bala area of Amediye district in Duhok province, and transported to Turkey on trucks and lorries under the supervision of the Turkish army.


The footage obtained by Rojnews of the tree-cutting shows once again the extent of the destruction taking place in the region’s natural areas.


Environmental activists and advocates stated that the situation cannot be regarded simply as deforestation, noting that irreversible damage is being inflicted on the region’s natural resources.


It was also reported that local residents have been unable to return to their homes, villages, and gardens because of the situation.


It was stated that the Turkish state’s military activities in Başûrê Kurdistan (Iraqi Kurdistan) are continuing at a time when the Peace and Democratic Society process, which aims to find a democratic and peaceful solution to the Kurdish issue, is ongoing.

title: Release of Irfan Yılmaz, 96 percent disabled, blocked over ‘slogan’
content:
Irfan Yılmaz, who has cerebral palsy and is 96 percent disabled, continues to be arbitrarily denied a suspension of his sentence by the Administrative and Observation Board of Marmara No. 2 Prison, even though the 11th Specialization Board of the Council of Forensic Medicine issued a report stating that he “cannot remain in prison.” Yılmaz, who cannot meet his basic needs on his own and uses a wheelchair, was previously denied a suspension of his sentence by the board on the grounds that he had “refused to move to an independent ward.” It has now emerged that the board has once again blocked his request, this time on the grounds that he had “chanted a slogan.” Hasan Toğan, Yılmaz’s legal guardian, spoke to ANF and reacted to the decision, saying: “No matter how you look at it, this is a violation. What is being applied to Irfan is not merely hostile law, but a law of revenge.”


Even the chairs there are unsuitable for Irfan, let alone the prison


Hasan Toğan, Yılmaz’s legal guardian, visited him on Tuesday, 15 September, and said Yılmaz’s health had deteriorated further because of the poor and difficult conditions in prison. Toğan said the prison’s architecture is not suitable for wheelchair access and that guards have to carry Yılmaz to every visit. Toğan said, “Let alone the prison itself, even the chairs there are unsuitable for Irfan. Because the chairs in the visiting area have no footrests, Irfan’s feet kept falling down. Even the footrest his wardmates made for him was not enough to keep his feet in place.”


He cannot use the squat toilet in the ward


Toğan stressed that Yılmaz requires continuous care, which is extremely difficult to provide under prison conditions, and said that political prisoners in the ward therefore take turns caring for him. Toğan said Yılmaz needs round-the-clock care and continued: “Irfan needs help eating, cleaning himself and using the toilet. Because the toilets in the wards are squat toilets, Irfan cannot use them. His diaper therefore has to be changed five times a day, and he has to be washed after each change. Every day, one person in his ward has to devote their time entirely to caring for him. This is torment both for Irfan and for the people around him. Yet despite this, his request for a suspension of his sentence continues to be arbitrarily blocked. There is a report from the Council of Forensic Medicine stating that Irfan cannot remain in prison, but this report is being disregarded. Instead, a report by the Security Bureau of the Sarıyer Police Department stating that Irfan, who uses a wheelchair and cannot live independently, ‘could pose a threat to public safety if his sentence is suspended,’ as well as rejection decisions issued on various grounds by the Administrative and Observation Board of Marmara No. 2 Prison, are considered valid. No matter how you look at it, this is a violation. To regard Irfan, who is 96 percent disabled, as a threat to society is a violation. Moreover, Irfan has struggled for years so that people can live better, the system of exploitation can be abolished and humanity can achieve prosperity. Then we have to ask: Is Irfan being described as dangerous because they fear his ability to raise awareness in society? Because those who raise society’s awareness are the ones this system regards as dangerous.”


Slogans chanted for 50 years became an obstacle to his release


Toğan said the Administrative and Observation Board had previously rejected Yılmaz’s transfer to an open prison on the grounds that he had “refused to move to an independent ward” and was now blocking the suspension of his sentence on the grounds that he had chanted slogans. Toğan said the prison administration was making a particular effort to prevent Yılmaz’s release: “The Administrative and Observation Board is now arbitrarily blocking Irfan’s release by citing slogans that political prisoners periodically chant in protest against violations of their rights. These slogans have been chanted for 50 years, and no one has ever received a disciplinary penalty for them. But they have opened a disciplinary investigation against Irfan. Although 12 people in the ward chanted the same slogans, Irfan has been banned from receiving visits on these grounds. His disciplinary penalty is also being used as a pretext to claim that he is not of ‘good conduct’ and to place another obstacle in the way of his release.
