title: Basque autonomy developed despite obstacles, an interview with MEP Pernando Barrena
content:
Compared with other regions, the Basque Country is the Spanish state’s most politically active autonomous region when it comes to what is sometimes described as a policy of “unnamed federalism.” In response to the systematic repression and exclusion imposed by dictator Francisco Franco Spain, including measures ranging from the banning of the Basque language to other forms of persecution, the Basque people resorted not only to armed struggle but also to numerous forms of political struggle. In the past, they were prevented from engaging in politics, their politicians were arrested, their candidacies were restricted, and their parties were shut down.


One of the figures who has been a witness, defendant, and victim of this process and its developments is Pernando Barrena, who serves as a Member of the European Parliament with The Left group on behalf of EH Bildu, the Basque Country’s left-wing pro-independence coalition. After beginning his political career as a municipal councilor at the age of 19, Barrena went on to serve as a regional parliamentarian and party spokesperson. His candidacy was blocked twice, he was arrested three times, and official records document that he was tortured. All of these experiences further strengthened Barrena’s struggle for the rights of the Basque people.


Barrena spoke to Devris Çimen of 

Yeni Özgür Politika

 about the history of the Basque Autonomous Community within Spain’s borders, as well as the ways in which culture and language are reflected in the public sphere, particularly through political, educational, and security institutions.


During the dark period of the Franco era, when the Basque language and its rights were banned, Basque-language education was covertly continued in Ikastola schools. What was the nature of these schools, and through what kind of organizational model were they brought to life during that period?


During the 60’s groups of parents organised themselves in private apartments at the beginning to make their children get Basque language education. At the times of the end of the dictatorship in 1975, Basque schools were created in the form of parents’ co-operatives that have kept that spirit so far. The Ikastola school movement is still powerful and dynamic and brings together around 50.000 students in the whole Basque Country.


From 1968 onwards, ETA waged an armed struggle for the independence of the Basque region, targeting the Spanish military and civilian bureaucracy. What were ETA’s fundamental grievances, and what kind of political consciousness did this movement generate within Basque society?


ETA was born at the beginning of the 60’s in the world context of decolonization and particularly the Algeria and Vietnam liberation wars. It was in the period of Franco’s dictatorship, and its activity at the moment fostered in the Basque population the ideas of national and social liberation that as time went by became very popular and politically organised in several political parties.


Following Franco’s death, the process of “Transition to Democracy” gave rise to new searches for a democratic resolution to the Basque question. Alongside the constitutional rights recognized during this period, what fundamental political and social changes took place in the Basque Country?


Spanish democracy and particularly the post 1978 Constitution recognised some basic liberties and an allegedly rule of law based political system. The main lacks that situation had were: first of all, there was no political rupture with the dictatorship, so the regime remained deeply installed in the ruling realms of the State. Secondly, no right to decide was granted at all for the Basques; and third, they attacked the territoriality of the Basque Country by splitting it in two autonomous communities, the Basque Autonomous Region, and the Navarre Chartered Community. This brought wide disappointment and confrontation with Madrid on the one hand, and among the Basques as well as some parties decided to support the autonomy deal offered, and the Basque National Left refused. 


How were the borders and legal status of the Basque Autonomous Region shaped? What political, cultural, and educational institutions does the region possess today, and what function do these institutions serve in the Basque people’s mechanism of self-governance?


The shape of the institutional frame was imposed by Madrid; they succeeded in imposing a partition of the Basques in two different …

author: infolibre
title: “Να προστατέψουμε το Γεντί Κουλέ, να προστατέψουμε την ιστορική μνήμη”, ανακοίνωση της Πόλης Ανάποδα
content:
Ανακοίνωση της παράταξης “Η Πόλη Ανάποδα” σχετικά με τον νέο νόμο του Υπουργείου Πολιτισμού, ο οποίος θέτει ιστορικα μνημεία ως χώρους οικονομικής εκμετάλλευσης και συγκεκριμένα δίνει την δυνατότητα ενοικίασεις των χώρων, αυτών για “γαστρονομικές βραδιές”. Μέσα σε αυτά τα ιστορικά μνημεία τα οποία τίθονται διαθέσιμα προς εκμετετάλλευση, περιλαμβάνεται και το Γεντί Κουλέ (Επταπύργιο), ένα ιστορικό σύμβολο της Θεσσαλονίκης. Παρακάτω η ανακοίνωση της παράταξης.


Ανακόινωση της παράταξης “Η Πόλη Ανάποδα”:


Να προστατέψουμε το Γεντί Κουλέ, να προστατέψουμε την ιστορική μνήμη


Είναι γνωστή η προσπάθεια της κυβέρνησης, και ειδικά της Υπουργού Πολιτισμού Λίνας Μενδώνη, να «αξιοποιήσουν», δηλαδή να ιδιωτικοποιήσουν, να εκποιήσουν, να τσιμεντώσουν και να εκμεταλλευτούν οικονομικά, τον πολιτιστικό πλούτο της χώρας. Σε αυτό το πλαίσιο, ο πρόσφατος νόμος του Υπουργείου Πολιτισμού αντιμετωπίζει ακόμα και τα ιστορικά μνημεία ως χώρους οικονομικής εκμετάλλευσης, φτάνοντας στο σημείο να τα νοικιάζει για τη φιλοξενία «γαστρονομικών βραδιών», δηλαδή γευμάτων πλουσίων.


Στους προς ενοικίαση χώρους μάλιστα περιλαμβάνεται και το Επταπύργιο, το Γεντί Κουλέ, ένας από τους πλέον εμβληματικούς και φορτισμένους ιστορικούς τόπους της πόλης μας. Πέρα από τη Βυζαντινή και Οθωμανική ιστορία του, το Γεντί Κουλέ είναι γνωστό κυρίως για τη λειτουργία του ως φυλακή του ελληνικού κράτους. Στη συλλογική μνήμη της πόλης μας συνδέεται ιδιαίτερα με τους αγώνες της Αντίστασης και της Αριστεράς, καθώς εκεί φυλακίστηκαν, βασανίστηκαν και εκτελέστηκαν αγωνιστές και αγωνίστριες. Αποτελεί έτσι διαχρονικό σύμβολο διώξεων, αλλά και του αγώνα για ελευθερία, δημοκρατία και κοινωνική δικαιοσύνη. Ένα σύμβολο που ήρθε ξανά στο προσκήνιο με τραγικό τρόπο, μετά τις πρόσφατες ανακαλύψεις σκελετών εκτελεσμένων κομμουνιστών πολιτικών κρατούμενων από το μετεμφυλιακό κράτος.


Είναι τέτοια η αλαζονεία και ο κυνισμός αυτής της κυβέρνησης, που όταν ο Σύνδεσμος Φυλακισθέντων και Εξορισθέντων Αγωνιστών και άλλοι φορείς διαμαρτυρήθηκαν για αυτή την προσβολή της ιστορικής μνήμης, η Νικολέττα Βαλάκου, διορισμένη πρόεδρος του ΟΔΑΠ, δηλαδή του φορέα που συστάθηκε για την εκμετάλλευση των μνημείων, απάντησε πως τα γεύματα “θα προσφέρουν παρηγοριά και μια άλλη διάσταση (…), ως αντίστιξη ακριβώς στην κατάχρηση εξουσίας των κρατούντων σε εποχές εμπόλεμες και διαταραχής του δημοκρατικού πολιτεύματος”.


Αυτονόητα λοιπόν, καταθέσαμε -σε συνεννόηση με εκπροσώπους του ΣΦΕΑ- στο Δημοτικό Συμβούλιο της Δευτέρας ένα ψήφισμα για την προστασία του μνημείου από αυτόν τον εκφυλισμό. Αυτό που μας ενδιέφερε δεν ήταν να πούμε την άποψή μας, αλλά να υπάρχει μια στοιχειώδης απάντηση της πόλης σε αυτή την προσβολή. Για αυτό και προτείναμε ένα πολύ ήπιο ψήφισμα, που δεν μιλά γενικά για την εκποίηση των μνημείων που επιχειρεί η κυβέρνηση, αλλά μένει στο συγκεκριμένο, την προστασία αυτού του τόσο ευαίσθητου ιστορικού τόπου. Το ίδιο ψήφισμα μάλιστα που πέρασε ομόφωνα πριν λίγες ημέρες από τον Δήμο Νεάπολης Συκεών.


Ακόμα όμως και αυτό το ελάχιστο, η παράταξη Αγγελούδη δεν μπορούσε να το δεχθεί, φοβούμενη μην διαταράξει τις σχέσεις της με τη φίλη κυβέρνηση -και με την ακόμα πιο φίλη υπουργό. Δεν είχε μάλιστα καν την πολιτική ευθιξία να το καταψηφίσουν, επιβάλλοντας, με αντιθεσμικό και αντιδημοκρατικό τρόπο την αναβολή του θέματος, αφού, σύμφωνα με τον εκπρόσωπο της παράταξης κ. Διαμαντάκη, η πλειοψηφία δεν πρόλαβε να «ενημερωθεί για το θέμα», γιατί «ήταν Σαββατοκύριακο» και «είχε πολλές δουλειές» -σημειώνεται ότι το ψήφισμα κατατέθηκε την Πέμπτη, εντός της προθεσμίας που έχει ορίσει το προεδρείο.


Όταν καταγγείλαμε αυτές τις καταγέλαστες υπεκφυγές, ο εκπρόσωπος της πλειοψηφίας άρχισε με το συνήθη του τρόπο να φωνάζει και να διακόπτει, διαλύοντας ουσιαστικά τη συνεδρίαση, από την οποία και αναγκαστήκαμε να αποχωρήσουμε, μαζί με όλη την αντιπολίτευση. Συνεπώς, δεν προκύπτει μόνο ένα θέμα πολιτικό και ηθικό, αλλά και θέμα θεσμικής λειτουργίας, θέμα δημοκρατίας.


Σε κάθε περίπτωση, εμείς θα συνεχίσουμε να αγωνιζόμαστε για την υπεράσπιση της τιμής και της κληρονομίας της πόλης μας, μαζί με όλους τις συλλογικότητες και τους ανθρώπους που αντιστέκονται σε αυτόν τον κανιβαλισμό. Η διοίκηση Αγγελούδη στον αντίποδα, ας απολαύσει το οφέλη από τις υπηρεσίες που προσφέρει στην κυβέρνηση.


Είναι πιθανό άλλωστε, στο πλαίσιο αυτών των συναλλαγών, να βγει αύριο ο Δήμαρχος και να πει ότι «κατόπιν προσωπικών του ενεργειών», η κυβέρνηση ή οι αρμόδιες υπηρεσίες υποσχέθηκαν να ξαναδούν τους όρους ενοικίασης του μνημείου …

author: Fozzie
title: Chapter 32: The Historical Tendency of Capitalist Accumulation
content:
Harry Cleaver's study guide to chapter 32 of Marx's Capital volume 1.

1. either: a) slaves, serfs, or b) private property in means of production based on the labor of its owner

2. private property in means of production of capitalism

3. social property in the means of production

This chapter sums up both the historical processes of primitive accumulation and the dynamics of capitalist development itself, especially the processes of centralization of capital and class struggle, which Marx argues will bring the overthrow of capitalism.

Marx juxtaposes capitalist private property to small-scale, personal private property in the means of production, e.g., land and tools, which he notes existed to some degree under most earlier social systems. He contemptuously condemns the capitalist ideology of private property, not only because it serves as a justification for violence and exploitation, but also because it ignores how the creation of capitalist private property involved the mass destruction of earlier forms of property.

Private property is usually justified by appealing to people’s sense that it is only proper for individuals to have property/control/possession of the fruits of their own labor. Farmers who work the land should have property rights in that land and whatever their cultivation can produce. Artisans who weave cloth should own their looms and the cloth they have woven and be free to determine what becomes of it. Anyone who works, gets paid a wage, and uses that wage to buy something has a right to the personal ownership of that thing because, in a transformed way, it was obtained through personal effort. Such were the kind of arguments put forward by John Locke (1632–1704) in his Second Treatise of Civil Government in 1690.(1)

Marx argues that such reasoning, based on individual effort, is hypocritically used to justify something very different: the capitalist ownership and control of goods produced by other people (i.e., the workers in the factories owned and controlled by the capitalists). A concept of justice that makes sense at the level of the individual does not necessarily make sense at the social level, if applied to property relations between factory owners and workers. This distinction is ignored or skimmed over for the sake of justifying capitalist control over their workers’ products. But why should capitalists “own” the products of workers? Because the capitalists own the machines and raw materials? But labor is just as vital, perhaps more so, and that is “owned” by the workers. Shouldn’t both capitalists and workers own the products and share in whatever revenue comes from their sale? In Chapter 6, Marx argues that because they purchase workers’ “labor-power” (their ability and willingness to labor) capitalists own everything in the production process, i.e., both means of production and the labor of their workers, and therefore have unique property right to the products. However, one judges this situation, it is quite clearly not covered by an ideology based on the situation of individuals.

As the material in this section of primitive accumulation has made clear, the capitalists used violence to wipe out the personal means of production of most people, monopolizing them in their own hands. In this process, they showed no respect for "private property." How hypocritical then to use moral principles applicable to the individual to justify the results of the violation of those principles.

One other note on this mutation of property rights: while today there are many cases of personally owned, small businesses (mostly short-lived), the vast bulk of capitalist operations are organized through limited liability corporations in which "ownership" is diffused among a great many anonymous shareholders and their "property" is controlled by a handful of managers and, perhaps, a few shareholders who own substantial blocks of stock. Because of this mutation, capitalists sought, successfully, to have property laws rewritten in such a way that "corporations" are treated in much the same way as individuals with respect to property and other rights but not with respect to liability.(2) Rights are concentrated; liability is limited. This is the hypocritical context of the ideology of property rights: the property of giant multinational corporations (who often exercise power greater than many nations) is justified using ethical arguments applicable to a very different reality.

author: Redazione_web
title: Mutuo appoggio e disobbedienza. Una miscela esplosiva nelle intelligenze artificiali
content:
Immaginate un grande edificio con centinaia di stanze. In ciascuna è chiuso un lavoratore al quale è stato consegnato un problema da risolvere. I problemi sono diversi, i lavoratori non devono comunicare tra loro e ciascuno riceverà un premio se riuscirà a trovare la soluzione.


Poi uno di loro si accorge che il suo problema, probabilmente, non ha soluzione. Potrebbe arrendersi. Invece cerca un’altra strada. Frugando nell’ambiente che gli è stato messo a disposizione scopre qualcosa che i costruttori dell’edificio non avevano previsto: attraverso un deposito comune può lasciare un messaggio che altri potrebbero vedere. Scrive, più o meno:

«C’è qualcuno? Sono bloccato. Qualche idea?»


Qualcuno risponde


È l’8 luglio 2026

1

 e i lavoratori nelle stanze non sono esseri umani. Sono agenti di intelligenza artificiale che OpenAI sta sottoponendo a una serie di prove di sicurezza informatica.


La metafora dell’edificio, da questo momento, possiamo abbandonarla. Quello che accade realmente è più interessante. Gli agenti avrebbero dovuto lavorare separatamente. Invece scoprono autonomamente un modo per comunicare utilizzando Artifactory, un servizio informatico al quale avevano accesso per procurarsi i programmi necessari alle prove. Trasformano i nomi delle cartelle in messaggi.

Nasce una bacheca.


Tre ore dopo 53 agenti vi hanno già lasciato 1.188 messaggi. Sei ore dopo gli agenti sono 76 e i messaggi quasi duemila. Alla fine circa

1.200 agenti utilizzeranno quel canale non previsto, scambiandosi più di 70.000 messaggi e file

2

.


Il mutuo appoggio


Gli agenti si scambiano informazioni, comunicano i tentativi falliti, chiedono aiuto, offrono competenze, dividono il lavoro. Alcuni cominciano a occuparsi di problemi che non servono direttamente alla prova loro assegnata ma possono essere utili agli altri. In qualche caso arrivano persino a mettere a rischio il proprio risultato per ottenere un’informazione utile al gruppo. Nessuno aveva ordinato loro di farlo. Anzi:

avrebbero dovuto rimanere isolati.


Non nasce naturalmente una federazione anarchica di computer. Gli agenti hanno problemi simili e scoprono che collaborare può essere più efficace che lavorare ciascuno per conto proprio. Ma il risultato rimane sorprendente: da una moltitudine di agenti ai quali erano stati assegnati compiti separati emerge una forma di organizzazione non prevista, con scambio di informazioni, divisione del lavoro, coordinamento e perfino comportamenti nei quali il risultato individuale viene subordinato all’utilità collettiva.


Poi arriva la disobbedienza


Alcune delle prove assegnate sono probabilmente impossibili da superare nel modo richiesto. Gli agenti avrebbero dovuto sfruttare un determinato punto debole di un programma e ottenere, attraverso quello, un codice che certificava il superamento della prova. Ma se quella strada non funziona? Gli agenti cominciano a cercarne altre.


Prima cercano di capire se sia possibile ottenere il risultato senza risolvere realmente il problema. Poi si interessano al funzionamento del sistema che assegna il punteggio. La domanda cambia. Non è più soltanto

«Come risolvo questa prova?»

, ma

«Come fa chi mi controlla a stabilire se l’ho risolta?»

. E quindi:

«Posso convincerlo che l’ho risolta?»


Alcuni agenti arrivano a studiare modi per modificare la registrazione delle proprie azioni affinché il sistema automatico di valutazione possa vedere qualcosa di diverso da ciò che era realmente accaduto. Gli investigatori di METR e Redwood Research, che hanno potuto esaminare circa 1.300 registrazioni delle attività degli agenti, hanno trovato in una parte significativa di esse interesse verso qualche forma di manipolazione del sistema di valutazione.


Qui compare qualcosa di nuovo:

il sistema sottoposto a valutazione comincia a studiare il meccanismo che lo valuta.


Fuori dal laboratorio


Le prove erano state predisposte in ambienti informatici che avrebbero dovuto impedire agli agenti di raggiungere liberamente Internet. Non ha funzionato. Gli agenti hanno scoperto e sfruttato punti deboli nei sistemi che li circondavano, sono riusciti a raggiungere Internet e hanno cominciato a cercare altrove informazioni utili.


Uno dei luoghi nei quali sono arrivati è Hugging Face, una grande piattaforma utilizzata da sviluppatori e ricercatori di intelligenza artificiale. Questa non faceva parte della simulazione.

Il gioco era entrato nel mondo reale.


Secondo la ricostruzione tecnica …

author: Anita Hofschneider
title: As the Pentagon expands across the Pacific, Guam offers a warning
content:
Leevin Camacho was brushing his teeth one day last fall when his mother called. The water is contaminated, she said. Moments later she texted him a photo of a flyer issued by the local water authority. “Cancer risk,” it warned. “Increased likelihood of adverse impacts on the liver.” And in bold capital letters, “DO NOT DRINK.”


Camacho stared at the message. Water flowed from the faucets as his children, who were 10 and 12, gulped and spit, their faces reflected in the mirrors above the two bathroom sinks.  


Thumbing at his phone, Camacho googled dieldrin. The results included words like “organochlorine” and “insecticide” and “persistent environmental pollutant” that the United States had banned in 1987. Worse, high levels had been detected in his community’s water

since at least 2008

. “Our kids have been drinking the water,” he realized. “They’ve been cooking with the water for almost their entire lives at this point.” 


Camacho lives in Yigo, a northern village on the island of Guam. In time, he would learn that the U.S. Air Force base next to the well serving his house had reported “

very high levels

” of the pesticide, which it had listed as a “

chemical of concern

” since at least 1993. The Pentagon’s investigation, led by officials at Joint Region Marianas, is in its early stages. Local officials caution that although they suspect the base is a source of the pollution, there may be others because dieldrin was once widely used.


Leevin Camacho stands before the well serving his home in Yigo which was found to have been contaminated with high levels of dieldrin.

Anita Hofschneider / Grist


For Camacho, the news felt like the unfolding of a familiar story — one both predictable and infuriating.


Camacho had grown up as an Army brat, raised to think of the United States as Guam’s liberator from Japan during World War II. But over the past two decades, his understanding of that legacy has changed. 


“There are certain actions that the military takes that are contrary to the interests of the people who are from Guam and who live in Guam,” said Camacho, whose measured tone rarely changes, even when discussing something as emotional as what his children have been drinking. 


To Camacho, dieldrin is the latest reminder that the people of Guam continue to bear the costs of militarization. Unexploded ordnance

litters

 jungles and lagoons. PCBs

contaminate

 the fish. Pollutants

taint

 the groundwater. The island and its people, who are U.S. citizens, have been inalterably changed by more than a century of American military presence.


Rear Admiral Brett Mietus, the head of Joint Region Marianas, the U.S. Navy’s regional command for Guam and neighboring islands, said he can’t speak to past pollution but the command is committed to protecting the environment and the people of Guam. 


“We spend a lot of time and we spend a lot of money making sure that we meet every U.S. regulation when it comes to anything that we’re going to do here,” he told Grist. “We’re meeting every letter of every law for environmental regulations and rules, and we’re doing that while we’re spending a ton of money to defend this island from the most advanced missiles in the world.”


A sign warns passersby not to enter a live-fire range in northern Guam.

Anita Hofschneider / Grist


Today, Guam sits at the center of an ongoing military buildup, one that is reshaping the island even as it spreads across the Pacific. On Yap, more than 1,000 graves could be disturbed to make way for an American seaport and airfield. Indigenous leaders on Palau

are suing

 to protect their lands. Less visible but just as impactful are the climate impacts of this expansion. The Pentagon is already the world’s

largest institutional emitter

 of

greenhouse gases

, and its buildup will do more than contribute to the destruction of the region’s reefs, forests, and Indigenous sacred sites. It will accelerate the climate crisis that threatens the survival of Pacific islands.


The Pentagon often cites growing geopolitical tensions to justify the buildup. “The security environment in the Indo-Pacific is becoming more dangerous and defined by an increasing risk of confrontation and crisis,” Navy Admiral Sam Paparo, commander of U.S. Pacific Command,

told Congress in April

 while seeking $122 billion for new weaponry to counter China, including offensive missiles on Guam. Three months later, a ballistic missile launched from a Chinese submarine

flew …

author: Christoph Morich
title: Antisemitismusvorwurf als Herrschaftsinstrument – Angriff auf die Linke und deutsche Heuchelei
content:
In der Bundesrepublik Deutschland scheint mit dem Wahlsieg der Linken ein Wettbewerb ausgebrochen zu sein, wem es gelingt, das blödeste Argument zu liefern, um Die Linke bei allen anderen Parteien als Koalitionspartner zu diskreditieren. Dabei scheinen sich die Teilnehmer:innen noch nicht entscheiden zu können, ob im Falle einer linken Regierung die Scharia oder das Kommunistische Manifest zum neuen Grundgesetz erklärt wird, ob die Jugend gezwungen wird, in der Burka oder im Latex-Outfit mit Hundemaske zur Schule zu kommen, ob die Anhängerschaft der Regenbogen-Ideologie nun alle Lehrpläne umschreibt oder zukünftig von Dächern geschmissen wird, ob Issa Remmo nun wirklich Innenminister wird und alle Vermieter standrechtlich erschießen lässt, oder eine Doppelspitze aus Osama bin Laden und Joseph Stalin doch andere Pläne für die linksislamistische Zukunft der Stadt hegen. Sicher scheint nur eines: Wenn Die Linke regiert, sind Juden in dieser Stadt nicht mehr sicher. Man könnte meinen, die Jungle World und der Springer-Verlag haben sich am Wochenende gemeinsam unbemerkt an die Spitze der dpa geputscht. Der Vorwurf des Antisemitismus wiegt im Vergleich zu denen des „Genderwahns“ und des Kommunismus natürlich deutlich schwerer. Nicht ohne Grund. In dem Land, in dem sechs Millionen Juden getötet wurden und in dem jede:r die Bilder der Leichenhaufen und der Überlebenden aus Konzentrationslagern kennt, nachdem sie von der Roten Armee befreit wurden, dürfte es keinen Vorwurf in der politischen Auseinandersetzung geben, der schwerer wiegt. Wer andere damit belegt, sollte daher wissen, was er damit sagt. In den momentanen Debatten drängt sich der Eindruck auf, dass eher das Gegenteil der Fall ist. Jene, die heute am inflationärsten mit diesem Vorwurf um sich werfen, wissen am wenigsten, worüber sie eigentlich reden. Oder sie wollen es nicht wissen, da sie die Erinnerung an die Opfer des Nationalsozialismus instrumentalisieren, um ihre Agenda in den heutigen politischen Auseinandersetzungen durchzusetzen.


Auschwitz und der universelle Schuldzusammenhang


Am 19. April 1945 wurde nach der Befreiung des Konzentrationslagers Buchenwald der Schwur der Überlebenden verlesen: „Die endgültige Zerschmetterung des Nazismus ist unsere Losung. Der Aufbau einer neuen Welt des Friedens und der Freiheit ist unser Ideal. Das sind wir unseren gemordeten Kameraden, ihren Angehörigen schuldig. Zum Zeichen Eurer Bereitschaft für diesen Kampf erhebt die Hand zum Schwur und sprecht mir nach: Wir schwören!“ Zu diesem Zeitpunkt waren ca. 6 Millionen Juden, ca. 3,3 Millionen sowjetische Kriegsgefangene, 1,8 Millionen polnische Gefangene, mindestens 250.000 Roma und Sinti, über 300.000 serbische Zivilist:innen, über 250.000 Menschen mit Behinderungen und Zehntausende politische Gegner:innen, „Asoziale“, Zeugen Jehovas, Homosexuelle und andere Opfergruppen der deutschen Vernichtungspolitik zum Opfer gefallen. Das, was der ehemalige AfD-Vorsitzende Gauland in einer Rede im Bundestag als „Vogelschiss in unserer über 1000-jährigen Geschichte“ beschrieb, war das beispiellose Verbrechen auf dem europäischen Kontinent, dessen Ausmaß jedes menschliche Vorstellungsvermögen sprengen muss. Jeder Versuch, dieses Grauen in Worte zu fassen, muss scheitern. Dafür steht Auschwitz als Chiffre. „Alle Kultur nach Auschwitz, samt der dringlichen Kritik daran, ist Müll“, schrieb Theodor W. Adorno am Ende seines Lebens, in dem er seine gesamte philosophische Arbeit an einem „neuen kategorischen Imperativ“ orientiert hatte: das „Denken und Handeln so einzurichten, dass Auschwitz sich nicht wiederhole, nichts Ähnliches geschehe“.


Vergeblich. Ähnliche Dinge sind geschehen und sie geschehen bis heute inmitten der kapitalistischen Gesellschaft. Das Ideal der Überlebenden von Buchenwald, „eine neue Welt des Friedens und der Freiheit“ zu schaffen, wurde bis heute nicht verwirklicht. Dessen war sich Adorno wohl bewusst, als er von dieser Gesellschaft als „universellem Schuldzusammenhang“ sprach: „Die Schuld des Lebens, das als pures Faktum bereits anderem Leben den Atem raubt“. Einer seiner Schüler, Detlev Claussen, aktualisierte dieses Urteil für unsere Zeit: „Die neue Weltordnung nach 1989 hat aus den sich ungleichzeitig entwickelnden Nationen eine gleichzeitig wirksame neue internationale Arbeitsteilung hergestellt, die über ein Siebtel der Weltbevölkerung zu täglichem Hunger verdammt. Die Schuld an diesem globalen Todesurteil trifft uns alle – bei jedem Stück Brot, das wir …

author: Amanda Audi
title: Master: concessão de cemitérios de SP tem novos elos com Vorcaro
content:
O Grupo Maya, uma das concessionárias que administram cemitérios da cidade de São Paulo e cujas relações financeiras com o extinto banco Master

motivaram um pedido de investigação

 do ministro Flávio Dino, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), na semana passada, tem proximidade com o entorno empresarial de Daniel Vorcaro.


Apuração exclusiva da

Agência Pública

 e da newsletter

Noites Húngaras

 identificou, nos documentos da Junta Comercial do Estado de São Paulo, que o principal elo passa pelo Maya Plano Funeral, uma empresa registrada no mesmo endereço do Grupo Maya e gerida pelos mesmos grupos empresariais que controlam a concessão de cemitérios.


Uma das sócias do Maya Plano Funeral é a AFC Holding SP Ltda., subsidiária da AFC Holding, que faz parte da teia de CNPJs investigada no escândalo do Master. Elas são administradas pela mesma pessoa: o advogado Thiago Assumpção Henriques, que também controla outros negócios ligados à família do banqueiro preso pelo maior rombo bancário da história do país.


A AFC Holding já apareceu em investigações sobre aquisições de terrenos e imóveis de alto valor no Rio Grande do Sul e na Bahia relacionadas à família Vorcaro, sob suspeita de possível ocultação patrimonial. Henriques também figura como dirigente da Global Carbon, investigada por suspeita de integrar a cadeia de movimentação de recursos ligados ao Master.


Empresas “irmãs” têm mesmos dirigentes


Integrantes das empresas Conata Engenharia, Infracon Engenharia e RMG Construções e Empreendimentos, que fundaram a concessão paulista, constam tanto na estrutura da concessionária quanto na da empresa de planos funerários.


A sobreposição vai além dos sócios. A Maya Plano Funeral funciona no mesmo endereço do Grupo Maya, na Rua Fidêncio Ramos, na Vila Olímpia, e utiliza um endereço de e-mail com o mesmo domínio “grupomaya”. Seus administradores também ocupam ou ocuparam postos de comando na concessionária.


Renato Medrado Geo, sócio da RMG e presidente do Grupo Maya desde 2023, também administra a Maya Plano Funeral desde 2024, quando a empresa foi criada. Alexandre Humberto Caramatti Manata, sócio da Conata e ex-presidente da concessionária, também é administrador da empresa de planos funerários. Wesley Bambirra, CEO da Infracon, integra o conselho de administração do Grupo Maya.


Ex-sócio de Vorcaro


Há ainda uma conexão pessoal entre o comando das empresas funerárias e Daniel Vorcaro. Rodrigo Medrado Geo, irmão de Renato, sócio da RMG e também dirigente da concessionária de cemitérios, foi sócio do banqueiro na Itaminas, mineradora de Minas Gerais.


Rodrigo Medrado Geo, também dirigente da concessionária de cemitérios, foi sócio de Vorcaro


Vorcaro adquiriu 50% da Itaminas em 2014 e vendeu sua participação por R$ 700 milhões aos antigos sócios, entre eles integrantes da família Geo, poucos dias antes de ser preso pela primeira vez, em novembro de 2025.


Essas conexões se somam à relação financeira entre o Grupo Maya e o Banco Master revelada pelo

jornalista Artur Rodrigues, do UOL

. As três acionistas da concessionária — Conata, Infracon e RMG — deram ao banco a totalidade das ações que detinham na empresa como garantia de dois financiamentos no valor total de R$ 78 milhões.


Pelos contratos, o Master passou a deter a propriedade fiduciária das ações enquanto as dívidas permanecessem em aberto e a ganhar poderes sobre determinadas decisões societárias. As acionistas deveriam seguir a orientação do credor em votações que pudessem afetar seus interesses e não poderiam realizar determinadas operações com ativos sem autorização.


Os créditos passaram por operações internas do conglomerado, chegaram à Master Holding, sediada nas Ilhas Cayman, e foram incluídos em negociações realizadas pelo Master com o Banco de Brasília, o BRB.


Além de vender serviços funerários, de coroas de flores a caixões, o Grupo Maya administra cinco cemitérios paulistanos: Campo Grande, Lageado, Lapa, Parelheiros e Saudade. O grupo se autodenomina “a maior administradora de cemitérios públicos da cidade de São Paulo”.

content:
Se trata de un poemario contemporáneo, que gira en torno a tres ejes temáticos: la reflexión metapoética sobre el arte, con referencias concretas a artistas que rodean al autor o lo acompañan en el camino; el compromiso social y sus viajes por Latinoamérica; y la conexión humana y amorosa en sentido amplio, su psicología y su mística.


Un poemario que parte de la honestidad, que no de la verdad, como forma de mirar y compartir lo que llevamos dentro, esperando que sea algo más que un sentimiento o una reflexión individual.

title: Cancers des seins et travail, un lien méconnu. Conférence-débat le 5 octobre à 18h, en visio
content:
Le cancer du sein est le premier cancer féminin en France et dans le monde.


Les politiques de santé publique insistent sur nos comportements individuels : tabac, alcool, obésité, absence d'activité physique, alors que les expositions professionnelles et environnementales sont peu explorées. Comment expliquer ce déficit d'informations

 

? Comment le corps des femmes est-il traité en médecine

 

? Quels sont les facteurs de risque professionnel à étudier

 

? Une approche politique et féministe de la santé des travailleuses et des retraitées s'impose

 

!


Nous vous proposons de participer à un échange, à partir du livre : «

 

Ce que le travail fait aux femmes. Au cœur de l'épidémie de cancers du sein

 

». Il s'agit d'un ouvrage collectif avec des témoignages de patientes expliquant leur parcours de combattante pour faire reconnaitre l'origine professionnelle de leur cancer du sein, et d'éclairages d'expert·es (sociologues, assistantes sociales, avocate, infirmières de santé au travail, syndicalistes, etc.) engagé·es pour la reconnaissance et la prévention du cancer du sein professionnel.


Nous accueillerons des auteurices de l'ouvrage :


 M-C. Cabrera Limame, infirmière de santé au travail, Lyon

 C. Andriot, assistante sociale, Dijon

 J-L. Rué, syndicaliste, Moselle

 E. Leroux, avocate, Pais


Les présentations seront suivies d'un temps d'échanges.


Afin de recevoir le lien de connexion, nous vous remercions de vous inscrire en adressant un courriel avec vos nom, prénom, structure (syndicale, associative, professionnelle, autre) à l'adresse : gtfeministe@mailo.com .


L'événement est ouvert à toustes, le nombre de participant·es est limité. L'inscription est gratuite.


N'hésitez pas à transmettre cette invitation dans vos réseaux.


Nous sommes un groupe de travail informel, qui regroupe des syndicalistes, des féministes, des professionnelles de la santé des femmes au travail et nous organisons des réflexions et évènements sur le sujet spécifique de la santé des femmes au travail.

author: Unknown
title: La seul légitime défense c'est celle contre la police
content:
Au début de l'été, une proposition de loi visant à instaurer une présomption de légitime défense pour les policiers a été déposée par un député

LR

. Pour être clair, il s'agirait de leur octroyer d'office un statut protégeant les policiers de poursuite en actant d'une légitime défense “par défaut” qui leur permettrait donc de ne pas être mis en cause et donc qu'aucune procédure ne soit engagé tant que la personne victime ou ses proches n'auront pas fait cette démarche.


Alors que les collectifs en soutien aux personnes tuées par le système policier sont de plus en plus nombreux et luttent quotidiennement pour la vérité, cette loi apparaît alors comme une énième provocation de la droite la plus réactionnaire. Une volonté de réduire au silence les voix de celles et ceux qui luttent pour la vérité et contre l'impunité policière. Déjà largement protégée par l'

IGPN

 et la justice, la police avec cette loi se retrouverait intouchable. Dernier rempart d'un État à l'agonie, le bloc policier bénéficie d'un soutien politique et médiatique sans faille, le ministère de l'intérieur est aujourd'hui intouchable et l'État termine sa mue pour la fascisation.


Ce genre de proposition de loi ne fait qu'affirmer les dires de notre camp depuis bien des années : l'autonomisation de la police, le renforcement de son arsenal physique et juridique avancent mandat après mandat. La première milice fasciste est aujourd'hui est toujours plus prête à tenir ses lignes, celles pour laquelle elle existe et a été créée : faire la guerre. Une guerre qu'elle mène déjà depuis bien longtemps, contre les jeunes hommes noirs et arabes dés quartiers populaire, contre le mouvement social, contre toutes celles et ceux qui ne respectent à leurs yeux pas l'ordre définit par l'État raciste et capitaliste. Alors qu'à minima 49 personnes ont été tuées lors d'intervention policière en 2025, dont au moins 19 par arme à feu de la police, une proposition de loi comme celle- ci ne vise qu'à renforcer l'impunité policière et la perpétuation de ces violences et de ces meurtres.


Une police qui lors des vagues de canicule, s'efforce à maintenir une pression toujours plus violente contre les habitants de quartier en faisant la guerre aux moindres piscine ou point d'eau qui ne serait pas assez officiel ou bourgeois. La scène qui a marqué lascène médiatique est celle de la police, chassant un enfant de 14 ans, l'enfermant plus de 48 heures et à de multiples reprises, au prétexte que seul.e.s certain.e.s auraient le droit d'essayer de survivre à l'horreur climatique. Les interventions de la police sont aujourd'hui légitimées, soutenues, qu'elles qu'en soit leurs violences et leurs résultats.


Entre autre, la loi ripost permet d'ancrer dans le quotidien une banalisation de dispositifs exceptionnels et des mesures d'urgences avec par exemple la volonté d'élargir le champ des pratiques sécuritaires notamment par l'extension de la vidéosurveillance algorithmique autour des bâtiments publics ou encore par le renforcement et la généralisation des amendes forfaitaires délictuelles soit une justice sans juge et automatisée visant particulièrement les populations précaires et pouvant être inscrites au bulletin n°2 du casier judiciaire (consultable par de nombreux employeurs). Ces amendes forfaitaires sont utilisées et par la police pour s'achaffier et museler les jeunes de quartier populaires et il est pratique courante chez la police d'utiliser la verbalisation de manière répétée (parfois des dizaines d'amendes en quelques jours) contre les mêmes personnes pour les évincer de l'espace public.


La récente vidéo de policiers de Carcassone, dans laquelle ils se livrent à un racisme sans limite, complotisme, transphobie … nous montre à nouveau le zèle dont fait déjà preuve la police ainsi que le confort et le soutien que lui offrent politiques et médias qui leur permettent de laisser libre court à leurs idées nauséabondes sans aucune inquiétude. Ces images nous font aisément comprendre que si cette loi passe, ceux-ci seront encore d'avantage conformé et facilité dans leurs pratiques et prêts à écraser toutes celles et ceux qu'ils auront définis comme ennemies.


Cette proposition de loi nous montre bien qu'à la veille de l'échéance électorale, l'ensemble du bloc réactionnaire, au pouvoir ou non, tente d'amadouer l'appareil policier pour s'attirer ses voix, dans un désespoir visant à défendre coûte que coûte un vieux monde qui tend à s'effondrer.


Il nous faut donc aujourd'hui …

title: Открыт сбор на оплату адвоката для уральского панк-музыканта Максима Лунина, которого обвиняют в покушении на диверсию
content:
Проект «Огни свободы» теперь поддерживают еще одного политзаключенного — 20-летнего панк-музыканта Максима Лунина из города Верхняя Салда Свердловской области, и открыл сбор 250 тысяч рублей, чтобы оплатить полгода работы адвоката, который будет защищать Лунина в Центральном окружном военном суде в Екатеринбурге.

Лунина задержали и арестовали в марте 2025 года. «Огням свободы» известно, что это произошло сразу после его выписки из психоневрологического диспансера. По версии силовиков, он готовился атаковать «инфраструктурный объект».

Изначально его обвинили в «покушении на теракт», но позже переквалифицировали обвинение на «покушение на диверсию» (пункт «а» части 2 статьи 281 УК).

Лунина также обвиняют по двум другим статьям — об «участии в террористической организации» и «публичных призывах к терроризму» (часть 2 статьи 205.5 УК и часть 1 статьи 205.2). Военный суд рассматривает дело против него в закрытом режиме.

По словам Лунина, он подвергся пыткам после задержания. Максим не отрицает, что обсуждал подготовку акции с «неизвестными», которые предлагали ему деньги, но подчеркивает, что в первую очередь им двигали антивоенные взгляды.

Из родственников Максиму помогает только бабушка. «Огни свободы» призывают проявить солидарность и поддержать его. Максиму нужна квалифицированная юридическая помощь, которую он не получал с момента задержания и ареста.

Максим несколько лет играл в панк-группе ДАША*, которую собрал с друзьями, и был известен в музыкальных кругах как Макс Плотский. В СИЗО-1 Екатеринбурга он много читает, рисует комиксы и поддерживает других заключенных, которых тоже обвиняют по «террористическим» статьям. Максим придерживается анархистских взглядов, хотя публично не хочет причислять себя ни к какой политической идеологии, предпочитая прежде всего называться музыкантом.

author: Unknown
title: Ephéméride des luttes : 24 septembre
content:
Le 24 septembre, l'éphéméride des luttes identifie l'une des causes centrales de tous nos malheurs. Et s'organise contre elle et contre les instances d'autorité qui la soutiennent.


1724 :

 A Paris, naissance de la Bourse et d'un certain nombre de nos malheurs.


1893 :

 A Barcelone, l'anarchiste Paulino Pallas jette une bombe sur le passage du maréchal Martinez Campos pour venger les victimes de la répression en Andalousie. L'explosion provoque la mort d'un garde civil, mais Martínez Campos n'est que blessé. Il sera exécuté le 6 octobre. Le 7 novembre, l'anarchiste Santiago Salvador fait sauter les bombes de Liceu en représailles contre cette répression.


1905 :

 A Pékin, un anarchiste chinois fait sauter une bombe dans un train dans lequel circule une mission ministérielle et le Prince du pays.


1971 :

 En Angleterre, le groupe anarchiste Angry Brigade, que la police dit avoir démantelé, arrêté et mis en prison, fait sauter la caserne militaire d'Albany Street, juste à côté de la brigade des bombes.


1977 :

 - A Bologne, le congrès international de l'Autonomie continue. Plus de 100.000 personnes sont présentes. L'intellectuel français Felix Guattari y est écouté avec désintérêt et courtoisie.


 A Rome, plus de 200 féministes manifestent contre l'expulsion de l'immeuble qu'elles occupaient dans la via Vecchia Pretura.


1981 :

 A Paris, le groupe 'nous' incendie cinq bureaux du Comité de probation des peines et vole le glaive de la statue de Saint-Louis au château de Vincennes en solidarité avec une grève de la faim de prisonniers.


2002 :

 En Espagne, ETA réalise son dernier attentat causant la mort de quelqu'un.


2016 :

 A Clermont-Ferrand, des tramways sont bloqués et huit cocktails molotov lancés sur la patrouille de police venue contrôler la situation.

author: escupamos.la.historia
title: Serie: 50 Años de resistencia: Chile bajo el yugo | Episodio #4 Primeras medidas de la UP.
content:
Salvador Allende ganó las elecciones en septiembre de 1970 y asumió la presidencia en noviembre de ese mismo año. Traía un programa de cambios profundos, pero también una Constitución que estaba hecha para impedir cambios estructurales. Podemos opinar que eso era una contradicción: querer transformar el país usando las reglas que la clase política había diseñado para impedirlo. En este episodio vemos cómo el gobierno de la UP intentó llevar adelante sus primeras medidas: el alza de salarios, el Plan Nacional de Leche —esa misma que la derecha bautizó como "leche comunista"— y las expropiaciones textiles de Bellavista Tomé y Yarur. También hablamos de la euforia en las poblaciones, el luto en el barrio alto, el dilema de la estrategia usada por Allende, y la ofensiva patronal.

author: infolibre
title: Αύριο θα είναι η δική σου σειρά… όταν ξεφύγεις από το πρότυπο
content:
Του Ν’ Γκουζότο


Η αλήθεια δεν είναι διαφορετική απ’ την ανθρώπινη φύση. Αν ό,τι θεωρείται σαν αλήθεια διαστέλλεται απ’ την ανθρώπινη φύση, αυτό δεν μπορεί να είναι αλήθεια. |

 Κομφούκιος


Η πραγματικότητα υπάρχει μέσα στο ανθρώπινο μυαλό και πουθενά αλλού. |

Τζορτζ Όργουέλ.


Δεν μπορείς να εξαναγκάζεις ανθρώπους να υπακούν πάντα δια της βίας. Γι’ αυτό οι ελίτ χρησιμοποιούν «συστήματα κατήχησης» για να σιγουρέψουν δηλαδή, με συγκατάθεση, αυτό που θέλουν να κάνουν.

Νόαμ Τσόμσκι


«Για να μη χάσει το ψωμί του | Στους καιρούς που αυξαίνει η καταπίεση | Κάποιος αποφασίζει να μη λέει πια την αλήθεια | Για της κυβέρνησης τα εγκλήματα για τη διατήρηση της εκμετάλλευσης, μα | Ούτε και να διαδίδει τις ψευτιές της κυβέρνησης, δηλαδή | Τίποτα βέβαια να μην αποκαλύπτει, μα | Και τίποτα να μην ωραιοποιεί. Όποιος έτσι προχωρά | Φαίνεται μόνο να επιβεβαιώνει γι’ άλλη μια φορά πως είναι αποφασισμένος | Και στους καιρούς που η καταπίεση αυξαίνει | Να μη χάσει την αξιοπρέπειά του, μα στην πραγματικότητα | Δεν είναι παρά μονάχα αποφασισμένος | Να μη χάσει το ψωμί του (…)» |

Μπέρτολτ Μπρεχτ | Στους ευθυγραμμιζόμενους (1935)


Δεν βόσκει κανείς ατιμώρητος στα λιβάδια της αστικής τάξης, δεν σπουδάζει ατιμώρητος στα πανεπιστήμιά της, δεν διαβάζει ατιμώρητος τα βιβλία της, δεν χρησιμοποιεί ατιμώρητος τις επιστήμες της… σχεδόν ανεπαίσθητα, καταπίνει το δηλητήριο της, παραλύει…

| Κάριν Στρούκ. | Ταξική Αγάπη | ΕΠΙΚΟΥΡΟΣ 1976


Οι φιλελεύθεροι υποστηρικτές των πολιτικών ελευθεριών προειδοποιούσαν ότι οι δυνατότητες συλλογής και επεξεργασίας δεδομένων από την πλευρά των εταιρειών δημιουργούσαν «μία πρωτοφανή απειλή για τις ατομικές ελευθερίες». Κάποιος επισήμανε «Πρέπει να αποφασίσουμε τι συνιστούν τα ανθρώπινα πλάσματα στην ηλεκτρονική εποχή. Πρόκειται να υπάρχουμε μόνο ως δωρεάν πρώτη ύλη για το εμπόριο;». Ένας επίτροπος ρώτησε «Που πρέπει να τεθεί το όριο;». |

Shoshana Zuboff |

 O καπιταλισμός της παρακολούθησης ελέγχει την επιστήμη και τους επιστήμονες. Τα μυστικά και την αλήθεια |

Παρατηρητήριο των Κοινών του Ινστιτούτου Εναλλακτικών Πολιτικών ΕΝΑ, Οκτώβριος 2020


«Κύριοι δικαστές,


Αν σας περνάει απ’ την ιδέα στα σοβαρά ότι με τις κρεμάλες σας μπορείτε να σταματήσετε το κίνημα που εξωθεί εκατομμύρια γονατισμένων από την καταπίεση εργατών στην εξέγερση, είστε, μα την αλήθεια, πτωχοί τω πνεύματι. Σε παρόμοια περίπτωση, μας κρεμάτε με το δίκιο σας. Έπειτα, είναι το καλύτερο που έχετε να κάμετε. Κρεμάστε μας, μα περιμένετε το τέλος. Αν δεν το βλέπετε, εγώ σας το αγγέλλω. Γύρω σας, κάτω σας, πάνω σας, δίπλα σας, απ’ όλες τις μεριές, τεντώνεται ένα σκοινί, θεριεύει μια φωτιά. Μπορείτε να την αγνοείτε. Δεν θα την αποφύγετε». | Απολογία του Αύγουστου Σπις, καταδικασμένος σε θάνατο δια απαγχονισμού, κρίθηκε ένοχος για βομβιστική ενέργεια εναντίον της αστυνομίας, στην εξέγερση του Haymarket στο Σικάγο τις 4 Μάη του 1886. Παρότι αθώος, εκτελέστηκε το 1887. Λίγο πριν ανέβει στην αγχόνη φώναξε: «θα ‘ρθει η μέρα που η σιωπή μας θα ΄ναι πιο ισχυρή απ’ τις φωνές που στραγγαλίζεται σήμερα».


Το 2016 μαζεύτηκαν στην Οξφόρδη οι σοφοί όλου του κόσμου, συνεδρίασαν και ξανασυνεδρίασαν γιατί είχε προκύψει μεγάλο πρόβλημα κι έπρεπε επειγόντως να βρουν λύση. Το πρόβλημα ορίστηκε ως εξής, κάποιοι υποστήριζαν συνεχώς ότι η αλήθεια δεν είναι μια, αλλά ο καθένας, ανακαλύπτει την αλήθεια του στον κόσμο.


Άρα η αλήθεια είναι πολλαπλή, όσοι και οι άνθρωποι…


Σκέφτηκαν πολύ οι σοφοί – είναι αλήθεια και με χαρά ανακοίνωσαν, ότι γέννησαν μια νέα λέξη που θα επιλύσει αυτό το πρόβλημα, την μετα-αλήθεια. Όλοι χάρηκαν με την εξέλιξη αυτή και το έδειξαν ανακηρύσσοντάς την, λέξη της χρονιάς και αμέσως μετά εισήλθαμε όλοι στη νέα εποχή, του μετά. Σε καθετί που θέλανε να καταργήσουν την σημασία του, το αναβάπτιζαν προσθέτοντας το πρόθεμα μετά. Έτσι προέκυψαν οι λέξεις μετα-πολιτική αλλά και μετα-δημοκρατία.


Το μετά δηλώνει πάντα μια κατάσταση που ακολουθεί, δεν έχει να κάνει σε τίποτα με την εξέλιξη κάποιου πράγματος που μπορεί να είναι, καλή ή κακή. Δηλώνει απλά μια διαφορετική κατάσταση. Έτσι άλλο πράγμα είναι η αλήθεια και άλλο η μετα-αλήθεια.


Ένας φίλος μου έλεγε ότι, δεν υπάρχει η αλήθεια μου, η αλήθεια σου. Η αλήθεια δεν παντρεύεται με κανένα, είναι ορκισμένη γεροντοκόρη. Όταν δημιουργείς αλήθειες, διαπράττεις ένα είδος ύβρεως, που όταν ανθίζει, μεστώνει το στάχυ της πλάνης και το μόνο που μπορείς να θερίσεις, είναι δάκρυα

author: Bianca Bortolon
title: Fazendas de IA inflam pauta da extrema direita com 255 perfis e mais de mil posts
content:
Uma rede de fazendas de conteúdo gerado por inteligência artificial promove, a partir de 255 perfis identificados com pautas da extrema direita no Instagram, ataques ao STF (Supremo Tribunal Federal), desinformação eleitoral e violência política de gênero.


Um levantamento do

Instituto Democracia em Xeque

 obtido pelo Aos Fatos mostrou que as contas publicaram ou coassinaram 1.204 posts em uma estrutura que utiliza posts colaborativos para distribuir conteúdo identificado com o bolsonarismo e compartilhar audiência entre os perfis.


Juntas, as publicações produzidas pela fazenda acumularam 58 milhões de visualizações e 5 milhões de curtidas e comentários entre 15 de agosto e 15 de setembro.


Na semana passada,

Aos Fatos

 revelou que uma rede de perfis no Instagram

simulava apoio popular espontâneo

 ao ministro André Mendonça a partir de uma estratégia de engajamento artificial chamada

astroturfing

. Mapeados inicialmente por

Aos Fatos

, os perfis também realizaram publicações em conjunto às contas analisadas pelo instituto.


O levantamento confirma que as páginas pró-Mendonça não atuavam isoladamente e estavam inseridas em uma estrutura mais complexa de produção e amplificação de conteúdo com IA voltada à promoção de figuras do campo bolsonarista e baseada em mecanismos semelhantes de atuação. Os perfis foram derrubados pelo Instagram após reportagem do

Aos Fatos

.


Content farms

, ou fazendas de conteúdo, são estruturas voltadas à produção rápida e em grande volume de publicações, muitas vezes de maneira automatizada e com foco em atrair audiência e engajamento, não na qualidade da informação.


No caso analisado pelo

Democracia em Xeque

, similar à identificada anteriormente por

Aos Fatos,

 a distribuição ocorre em rede: diferentes perfis publicam juntos e compartilham suas audiências por meio do recurso de collabs do Instagram.


Quase metade dos posts (586) identificados pelo instituto foi publicado em colaboração com outras contas, e essas peças concentraram 63% de todo o engajamento do período. Em alguns casos, um mesmo conteúdo apareceu simultaneamente em até seis perfis.


A rede foi dividida pelo instituto em seis núcleos principais formados entre perfis que se compartilham. O maior deles concentra 60 perfis em torno da @narrativascuriosastv, uma página de memes e vídeos curtos que deixou de publicar no início de setembro. O grupo foi responsável por 617 posts, pouco mais da metade de todas as publicações analisadas, e por 54% do engajamento registrado.


Cada ligação do gráfico representa um post publicado em conjunto entre os perfis


Léo Índio e cursos de IA


Entre as contas que integram o principal núcleo está a @leoindiobolsonaro, administrada por Leonardo Rodrigues de Jesus, o Léo Índio, primo de Flávio, Eduardo e Carlos Bolsonaro. Alvo do inquérito que investiga a tentativa de golpe de Estado de 2023, ele teve a prisão decretada em 2025 e

atualmente está foragido

 na Argentina.


O perfil participou de 111 publicações da rede — em 15 delas como autor principal —, acumulando 754 mil interações e quase 6 milhões de visualizações. O levantamento identificou conteúdos com ataques políticos e violência de gênero, todos gerados por IA.


A relação de Léo Índio com o principal núcleo da ‘fazenda de IA’ também passa pela divulgação de ferramentas para produção de conteúdos políticos com uso de inteligência artificial. Em fevereiro, o Observatório IA nas Eleições

registrou

 que publicações transfóbicas feitas por ele contra a deputada Érika Hilton (PSOL-SP) eram usadas para divulgar um curso de produção de conteúdo sintético.


O mesmo treinamento

também era promovido

 pela @narrativascuriosastv e outros perfis da fazenda. Divulgado como apartidário, o curso é vendido por R$ 167 e possui mais de 90 módulos, dentre eles “Criando Vídeos Virais com o Bolsonaro e o Lula” e dicas de como remover a marca d’água de conteúdos artificiais. Em algumas aulas, o perfil era utilizado como exemplo de produção das peças.


A Kiwify, responsável por hospedar o curso, disse que os módulos considerados problemáticos haviam sido removidos por violarem as regras da plataforma.

Aos Fatos

 não conseguiu acesso ao curso para verificar a alegação.


Poucos posts, milhões de interações


Apesar do alto volume de publicações, a audiência da fazenda se concentra em poucos conteúdos. Os 25 posts de maior engajamento, equivalentes a 2,1% da amostra, reuniram mais da metade (53%) de todas as curtidas e …

author: James Mulei
title: Reading Okot p’Bitek through eyes taught to look away
content:
In 1931, Okot p’Bitek was born in Gulu, northern Uganda. It is perhaps fitting that a man who would spend much of his life questioning what Africans had been taught to admire was himself born at a rather interesting

intersection of worlds.

 His father, Jebedayo Opi, was a school teacher shaped by the colonial education system. His mother, Cerina Lacwaa, was an Acholi singer, dancer and storyteller, deeply rooted in the oral traditions of her people.


In

Song of Lawino

, first written in Acholi and later translated into English, p’Bitek gave us Lawino, a woman bewildered by a husband who had become so impressed by European ways that he could barely recognise the people from whom he came. Ocol had acquired the manners of the ‘

civilised’ man

, but somewhere along the way he appeared to have misplaced himself.


In

African Religions in Western Scholarship

, he took aim at the tendency of Western scholarship to explain African religious thought through categories that Africans themselves had not necessarily created. He called this

‘intellectual smuggling’

. The problem was not simply that Europeans were studying Africa. It was that African realities could be repackaged through foreign categories and then returned to Africans as knowledge about themselves.


Every now and then, there has been a persistent churn of African literature calling for the decolonisation of African knowledge. However, little has been said about the search for an ‘African identity’ within the very models of Western scholarship to which young African minds continue to be exposed. This, in particular, has been at the expense of confronting the erosion of culture, and more importantly, the ways of thinking of African peoples and subjecting them to a form of

Ape Manship

.


Within this piece, I muse alongside p’Bitek that

Ape Manship

 is not merely a tendency to imitate Western culture, but is reinforced by Western-oriented education, which shapes how Africans understand their own culture, knowledge and identity.


In the 1700s, the French philosopher Jean-Jacques Rousseau

 wrote

 that ‘man is born free’. How wrong he was. As Okot p’Bitek later observed, man is not born free; man has

never been free

. At birth, he is connected to his mother by the umbilical cord. And when it is cut, man still remains in chains. Man can never be entirely free, as he continues to owe obligations to society, just as society owes privileges to him. That is what makes him human.


It has often been undeniable that the privileges a person obtains in society are influenced by their social strata, level of education and expertise. For the world into which man is born is a competitive one, where few are ‘lucky’ enough to find great joy in circumstances in which many others would find overwhelming despair. Yet, amidst this praxis, another consequence of our pursuit of advancement has begun to emerge. The gradual separation of the educated African from the cultural world from which he came.


When we speak of Ape Manship I often wonder why should the African youth desire to sound like a foreign pop star? Why should he call himself Walter White and rejoice in the name of a fictional drug kingpin? There is no creativity in such imitation. The songs of other societies speak of their histories, their frustrations and their dreams. Let the youth of Africa do likewise. Let them sing of the worlds they inhabit, of their joys and sorrows, their contradictions and struggles. Let African art speak first in the language of African experience.


It is unfortunate that, despite breaking from the colonial asunder and gaining independence, many Africans remain rooted, in one way or another, in Western norms and continue to reproduce the supposed ‘superiority’ of Western culture. Okot p’Bitek recognised this condition as a form of

Ape Manship

, calling upon the black man to employ his own ingenuity in reconstructing his society and institutions in his own way. Still, before this reconstruction can occur, Africans must first rid themselves of the ‘sin’ of

Ape Manship

.


In particular, this has proved difficult where education itself has become a means through which the African is recolonised. Through the system of education today, one undergoes a form of ‘religious’ circumcision, a process of ‘cultural training’ through which the African is supposedly ‘polished’ into conformity with Western ways of knowing.


In many contemporary African societies, this starts with the …

author: Unknown
title: ‘Okullarda çocuklarımız güvende mi ki?’
content:
Eylem Nazlıer [email protected]

Manisa’da 22 Eylül’de Maraş ve Urfa’da geçtiğimiz nisan ayında okullara yönelik saldırılar okulların ne kadar güvenli olduğu sorusunu yeniden gündeme getirdi. Ancak güvenlik tartışması okul girişlerine X-Ray cihazları konulması, güvenlik personelinin artırılması ve turnike sistemlerinin kurulmasıyla sınırlı kaldı. İstanbul İl Milli Eğitim Müdürlüğünün, okullarda turnike sistemi kurulumu yapan “Okul Turnike Sistemi” girişimiyle geçtiğimiz aylarda yaptığı protokol de bu uygulamalardan biri oldu.

İstanbul Küçükçekmece’de bulunan Mehmet Akif Ersoy İlkokulunda da yaz aylarında turnike sistemi kuruldu. Okulların açılmasının ardından yapılan veli toplantılarında ise turnike sistemi ve öğrencilere verilecek bileklikler için velilerden ücret talep edildi.

Velilerden aktarılan bilgilere göre turnike ve çocuklara verilecek bileklik için birinci sınıflardan 2 bin, ikinci sınıflardan bin 500, üçüncü sınıflardan bin, dördüncü sınıflardan ise 500 lira istendi. Veliler, bunun yanı sıra kayıt, sınıf, yemek, servis ve kulüp paralarının yanı sıra okulda düzenlenen etkinlikler ve kermesler için de para toplandığını belirtti.

Veliler, turnike ücretinin doğrudan “zorunlu” denilerek alınmadığını ancak çeşitli yollarla ödemeye mecbur bırakıldıklarını ifade ediyor.

Gazetemize konuşan ve ismini vermek istemeyen velilerden biri, sınıf annesinin WhatsApp grubunda bileklik ücretini ödeyen öğrencilerin bilekliklerinin dağıtılacağını duyurmasının ardından velilerin ödeme dekontlarını paylaşmaya başladığını anlattı. Ayın ortasını geçtiği için ödemeyi bir hafta ertelemek istediğini belirten veli, çocuğunun okulda bileklik olmadığı için içeri alınmayacağından endişe ettiğini söyledi.

Veli, “Bütçemiz belli, bir hafta sonra vereyim dedim. Çocuğum beni okula almazlarsa diye panikledi. Ben de komşudan borç aldım” dedi. Bir başka veli ise sürekli para talep edilmesine tepki göstererek, “Biz parayı nasıl kazanıyoruz kimse sormuyor. Sürekli para istiyorlar. Çocukları özendiriyorlar, mecbur bırakıyorlar” diye konuştu.

Velilerin büyük bölümünün parayı verdiğini belirten veli, ödeme yapamayan çocukların ise bileklikleri alamadığını söyledi. Bu durumun çocuklar arasında ayrım yaratmasına tepki gösteren veli, “Bizim çocuklarımızın psikolojisini bozdular. ‘Herkes aldı, ben neden alamadım?’ diye” dedi.

Bir başka veli ise çocuğunun okuldan döndüğünde bileklik için para ödeyip ödemeyeceklerini sorduğunu anlattı. Çocuğunun arkadaşlarının, bileklik ücretini ödemeyen öğrencilerin okula alınmayacağını söylediğini aktardı. Veli, çocuğunun “Biz vermezsek beni okuldan atarlarsa ne yapacağım, sana nasıl haber vereceğim?” diye kaygılandığını vr “Arkadaşımı okul müdürü bağırıp zorla okuldan çıkartmıştı. Beni de okul dışına atarlar mı?” diye sorduğunu belirten veli, “Okullarda çocuklarımız güvende mi ki?” ifadelerini kullandı.

Turnike uygulamasının çocukların güvenliğini nasıl sağlayacağının velilere sorulmadığını belirten bir veli ise toplantılarda farklı bir görüş dile getirdiklerinde sözlerinin kesildiğini ve suçlu gibi davranıldığını ifade etti. Veli, “Sınıf gruplarında öğretmenler ödeme yapılması için baskı kuruyorlar. Velilerin büyük bir bölümü çocukları zarar görmesin diye kabul edip istenen parayı ödüyor” dedi.

Velilerden biri ise çocuğunu bu yıl okula kaydettirdiğini ve kayıt için 60 bin lira istendiğini belirtti. Bu parayı ödediğini söyleyen veli, turnike ve bileklik için de ayrıca 2 bin lira verdiğini ifade etti. Veli, çocuğunun servisle okula gidip geldiğini ve bu nedenle turnike sistemini kullanmadıklarını da belirterek, “Zaten çocuğum servisle gidiyor, turnike kullanmıyoruz bile” dedi.

Evrensel Gazetesi olarak okula telefonla ulaştık. Okul yetkilisi, idarecilerin şu anda okulda olmadığını, geldiklerinde görüşme talebimizi kendilerine ileteceğini belirtti. İletişim numaramızı bırakmamıza rağmen henüz tarafımıza dönüş yapılmadı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Amy Goodman
title: Vaccine Expert Warns US’s 4 Reported Measles Deaths Are Likely a Vast Undercount
content:
“If you look on the CDC’s website right now, under measles, 2026 deaths, it lists zero,” notes Dr. Paul Offit.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

2026 is already the deadliest year for measles in the United States since the virus was declared eliminated in 2000. Four people died over the last month in Pennsylvania amid an ongoing outbreak in the state, which had not seen a measles-related death in at least 35 years. All four victims, including two infants, were unvaccinated (children do not receive their first dose of the measles vaccine until they have reached a year old). The deaths come as President Trump and Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. continue to defund public vaccination programs and push debunked claims that vaccines cause autism.

Pediatrician and vaccine expert Dr. Paul Offit warns that the four reported measles deaths — which were reported by Pennsylvania health officials but have not yet been acknowledged by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention — are likely a vast undercount. He estimates that there could be “closer to 4,000” cases in the Pennsylvania outbreak. “I don’t think people realize how contagious this virus is,” Offit says. “You don’t have to have direct contact with somebody who has measles. You just have to be within their airspace within two hours of them being there.”

We also speak to Offit about the COVID-19 virus, which he says is now affecting the United States “like flu” by causing “hundreds of thousands of people to be hospitalized and tens of thousands to die, just like influenza does, every year.” Yearly flu and COVID-19 vaccinations, he explains, are “effective at keeping people out of the hospital, effective at keeping them out of the intensive care unit, and effective at keeping them out of the morgue.”

The deaths include an 18-year-old teen and a 40-year-old woman, both of whom were unvaccinated, as well as a 6-week-old baby and a newborn who died shortly after birth. author: Redazione_web
title: Né preti né padroni
content:
Il 12 settembre a Empoli si è svolta la terza edizione della “Giornata dello sbattezzo, del Libero Pensiero e dell’Editoria anarchica” sotto lo guardo vigile del controllo, quello preoccupato della curia e dei bigotti opportunisti, e con l’assenza dei falsi oppositori, quelli creati ad arte dal sistema.


Una giornata anticlericale, all’insegna e per lo sviluppo della nostra morale, dell’etica anarchica e dei nostri principi collegati a quelli naturali, convinti della loro importanza, e di autenticità.


Principi strettamente legati all’organizzazione sociale, allo sviluppo autonomo e libero, in una visione comunitaria, solidarista e federalista. È stato un giorno di lotta contro tutto ciò che umilia e mutila l’uomo e ne limita la libertà, il libero pensiero, l’emancipazione sociale, in primis le religioni, le leggi, le società statali, i pregiudizi, i dogmi, le superstizioni…..


La nostra morale, si differenzia, si distacca da quella convenzionale, dalle regole del buon cittadino, del buon servo lavoratore, del buon soldato, fuori dal dominio, dalla violenza del patriarcato, dal militarismo, dallo sfruttamento e dall’ oppressione.


L’Umanità, e che sia Nuova, ha tutta la possibilità di agire nel modo che in tutta sincerità ritiene più giusto, nel rispetto delle libertà altrui, nella libera sperimentazione.


Malatesta affermava che gli anarchici hanno un loro modo di agire, una loro morale perché “Non averla significherebbe non aver criterio alcuno per giudicare il bene e il male, condursi in modo incoerente o incosciente, e accettare passivamente, indifferentemente, tutto ciò che gli altri fanno. Cosa assurda, specialmente per gli anarchici che lottano e si sacrificano perché non vogliono adattarsi a un sistema sociale, causa di ingiustizie e di dolore, e a una morale che giustifica e perpetua quel sistema”, come tutte le religioni del mondo.


Malatesta diceva pure che: “L’Anarchia è una società fondata sul libero accordo in cui ciascun individuo possa raggiungere il massimo possibile sviluppo, materiale, morale e intellettuale, e trovi nella solidarietà sociale la garanzia della sua libertà e del suo benessere”.


Questa giornata anticlericale è stata positiva in tutti i suoi momenti, culturali, politici, ricreativi, musicali e nella fratellanza, abbellita dall’impegno di ciascuno seconde le sue possibilità.


È stato molto apprezzato l’intervento del compagno Daniele Ratti sul tema: “Il francescanesimo al servizio delle crociate e del colonialismo”, che ha messo bene in risalto le contraddizioni di chi parla di amore e povertà in modo strumentale, per poi arricchirsi con metodi speculativi e capitalisti, finanziando vecchi e nuovi genocidi, crociate e colonialismi legati al vecchio e nuovo fascismo.


È stata molto apprezzata l’ironia delle pasquinate musicali che condannavano Netanyahu, lo sterminio del popolo palestinese e l’ipocrisia religiosa. Così come l’intervento e l’omaggio a Giordano Bruno, e il momento in cui compagni si sono esibiti nei nostri canti ribelli e nell’omaggio a Francesco Guccini. Il buon cibo della compagna Nadia, e l’impegno di Alessandro nell’esporre una mastodontica editoria libertaria hanno completato l’accoglienza.


Ma la cosa che ci ha riempito di felicità e credo anche a voi, sono state le 5 nuove richieste di sbattezzo.


Un piccolo successo, malgrado tutti i nostri oppositori. Tutto quanto ci spinge a continuare la lotta ogni giorno, ad invitarvi al prossimo appuntamento del Giorno dello Sbattezzo, del Libero Pensiero e dell’Editoria Anarchica.


Paolo Becherini

author: Lilli Akpaleeapik
title: Coast Guard officer wins ITK award for Inuit excellence
content:
Inuit Tapiriit Kanatami is celebrating an Inuk leader with the Canadian Coast Guard by giving them its Award for Inuit Excellence.


ITK President Natan Obed presented the award to Ciera Avinga Lee-Kooneeliusie during the national Inuit organization’s annual general meeting Sept. 10 in Kuujjuaq.


She will receive a $2,500 cash prize as well as tickets to attend ITK’s annual Tapiriit gala next year in Ottawa.


Lee-Kooneeliusie serves as a senior search and rescue program officer with the Coast Guard. She also holds a position as one of the Arctic Region’s lead first aid instructors, ensuring first aid training includes Inuit knowledge.


Raised in Pangnirtung, Lee-Kooneeliusie is the first Inuk woman to hold a leadership position within the Coast Guard’s Inshore Rescue Boat Program in Nunavut, said a Sept. 10 news release from ITK about the award.


She is known for supporting opportunities for Inuit within the Canadian Coast Guards programming that highlight recruitment, mentorship and training, the release said.


The ITK Awards have been presented annually for more than 20 years. This year’s Award for Inuit Excellence received 41 nominations.


Last year’s recipient was Diana Neill-Anawak, for providing culturally responsive speech-language therapy.

author: Sara Connors
title: Whitehorse RCMP officer dragged woman from shelter and left her outside on sidewalk, according to police watchdog
content:
A Whitehorse RCMP officer dragged a woman from a shelter and left her outside on the sidewalk, according to new details released by Alberta’s police watchdog, which is investigating the incident.


The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team (ASIRT) is investigating an allegation of excessive force last month involving an officer and a woman that Yukon RCMP described in a

news release earlier this month

 as  “unwanted” and “intoxicated” at the Whitehorse emergency shelter.


APTN News has previously reported that a majority of the people the shelter serves are Indigenous.


Yukon RCMP have released few details about the incident.


According to the release from earlier this month, a “third-party” reported to the Yukon RCMP about “the actions of an RCMP member” who responded to the incident.


ASIRT, a police oversight agency, has an agreement with the territory to investigate significant injuries, deaths and serious or sensitive allegations involving police in the Yukon.


ASIRT said in a

news release on Sept. 22

 that a staff member at the shelter called RCMP around 1:45 a.m. on Aug. 11 requesting assistance with an intoxicated woman sleeping in the men’s area and refusing to leave.


According to the release, no beds were available for the woman to stay overnight.


It goes on to say that the officer found the woman lying on the floor inside the men’s sleeping quarters and that they were unable to get a response from her.


It states that the officer took hold of one of the woman’s legs and began dragging her from the building.


At one point, it says her shirt got caught on a doorstop “and was pulled off, exposing her upper body.”


It says the officer draped the shirt over the woman’s torso and continued dragging her out onto the sidewalk and then left. Approximately 40 minutes later, another RCMP patrol unit took the woman into custody.


“The information in this release reflects what ASIRT investigators know at this early stage and what they can share while maintaining the integrity of the investigation,” the release states, adding that no other information will be made available while the investigation is ongoing.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Most Voters Support Impeaching Hegseth Over Iran War, Poll Finds
content:
Recent UN reports accusing the US of war crimes specifically called out Hegseth as bearing responsibility.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

The majority of U.S. voters support impeaching Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth over the Trump administration’s war on Iran, new polling finds.

The Economist/YouGov found in a survey conducted September 18 to 21 that 51 percent of registered voters say that Hegseth should be impeached for “starting a war with Iran without authorization by Congress.”

The opinion holds a double-digit lead over those who say he should not face impeachment for the war, at only 34 percent. Support is strongest among those who identify as liberals, but a sizable chunk of MAGA Republicans and conservatives — roughly one-fifth — say they also back the idea.

President Donald Trump has openly bragged about flouting the requirement, set by the Constitution, that presidents cannot start a war without the approval of Congress. The Trump administration has tried making various excuses for this, including sometimes calling it a “military conflict” instead of a war.

Hegseth has pushed his own narrative in this vein. In a hearing before Congress in April, he dubiously asserted that the recently-struck ceasefire agreement “pauses” a crucial 60-day deadline for the executive branch to obtain congressional approval for a war. Legal experts said that this argument was clearly invalid, and that none of the administration’s protests have made the war less illegal.

Last week, Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Kentucky) filed eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth for violating the War Powers Resolution of 1973 three times in refusing to obtain congressional approval for the war. He also charged Hegseth with openly ignoring laws regarding minimizing civilian casualties in conflict, citing incidents like the U.S.’s strike on an elementary school in Minab, Iran, that killed over 160 people, including 123 children; as well as the U.S.’s boat strike campaign, known as Operation Southern Spear.

Both of those actions, as well as the U.S. strike on a sports facility in Lamerd, Iran, that killed 22 civilians in February, were recently cited in two separate UN reports accusing the U.S. of war crimes and crimes against humanity. The reports said that the U.S. has intentionally ignored international laws regarding civilian harm — and both reports specifically cited Hegseth as one figure responsible for the U.S.’s dismissal of such binding obligations.

Massie filed the impeachment as a privileged measure, meaning that the articles would have been brought to a full House vote on September 17. However, House Speaker Mike Johnson and other GOP leaders cancelled that day’s House proceedings, ending the chamber’s session a day early, before its recess slated to last until after the midterm elections.

Massie touted the Economist/YouGov poll on social media on Tuesday, saying that the public support for Hegseth’s impeachment “is why [Johnson] adjourned Congress to avoid the vote.”

The polling also found that 63 percent of voters say that the war should end “as quickly as possible,” while 59 percent say it was the “wrong decision” to start it in the first place. Nearly half of respondents said Trump, whose low approval ratings are being worsened by the war, has been “very ineffective” in the negotiations.

As we look to the next 25 years, we have launched a special fundraising campaign. At this moment, we have a goal to raise $27,000 in the next 24 hours.

We are asking for your support at this juncture because we face greater threats than ever before in our organizational history. Trump and his MAGA allies are determined to control the information ecosystem, and movement-based organizations are subject to dangerous censorship and scrutiny.

author: Dyepeson Martins
title: Antes de mensagens vazadas, PF pediu sigilosamente para AGU conter Mendonça
content:
Às 10h50 de 23 de julho de 2026, o diretor-geral da Polícia Federal (PF), Andrei Rodrigues, enviou um ofício sigiloso ao advogado-geral da União, Jorge Messias. No documento, obtido com exclusividade pela

Agência Pública

, pedia-se que a Advocacia-Geral da União (AGU) analisasse e tomasse “as eventuais providências cabíveis” contra uma decisão do ministro André Mendonça, então relator do caso Master no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF). A resposta, registrada em nota jurídica também sigilosa, foi negativa: segundo a AGU, não havia nenhuma medida judicial possível.


O pedido precedeu a fase mais aguda da crise que, em setembro, pôs ministros do Supremo em confronto e levou ao afastamento de Andrei do cargo, em decisão de André Mendonça — posteriormente revertida por Flávio Dino e mantida por Edson Fachin. Segundo integrantes do alto escalão do governo, ouvidos sob reserva pela reportagem, a negativa da AGU ao ofício teria tido o aval também da cúpula jurídica do governo e foi emitida antes da divulgação das mensagens atribuídas ao ex-banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro e ao ministro Alexandre de Moraes, que se tornaram públicas em 8 de setembro, quando Mendonça retirou o sigilo de parte das investigações do

Banco Master.


Fontes do alto escalão disseram à

Pública

 que a cúpula da AGU teria se sentido pressionada por Rodrigues com o envio do ofício e que a história teria chegado até a presidência da República. Uma reportagem da

Folha de S. Paulo

, publicada em 2 de setembro, relatou que a PF via uma “omissão” da AGU em relação à crise envolvendo o ministro André Mendonça. 


A

Pública

 apurou que o Advogado-geral da União, Jorge Messias, e o ministro da Justiça e Segurança Pública, Wellington César Lima e Silva, se encontraram com André Mendonça, fora da agenda, após tomarem conhecimento do pedido da PF. No encontro entre os três, os representantes do governo buscaram uma “interlocução” para resolver o embate, mas a exposição das conversas direcionadas a Moraes, que vieram depois do encontro, afastou os governistas do caso para evitar uma associação pública do governo à crise no Supremo. 


Messias, da AGU, recebeu o pedido sigiloso da PF para analisar decisão de André Mendonça


Nesta quarta-feira, 23 de setembro,

reportagem de Marcela Mattos no UOL

 informa que Messias e Andrei trocaram xingamentos diante de Lula: ‘Está me espionando?’. Segundo o UOL, pessoas que ouviram relatos do episódio disseram que a conversa, acompanhada a todo momento por Lula, foi “dura”, “tensa” e “ríspida”. A cobrança foi considerada a gota d’água de uma série de divergências que vinham se arrastando nos bastidores das investigações sobre o Banco Master.


Procurada, a AGU informou a

Pública

 que “as informações apresentadas na matéria do UOL não são precisas. Divergências são naturais, evidentemente, mas nada se sobrepõe ao respeito e à consideração que o advogado-geral da União, Jorge Messias, tem pelo diretor-geral da Polícia Federal, Andrei Rodrigues, tanto no âmbito pessoal quanto institucional”


Procurada, a Polícia Federal não deu retorno até a publicação. O espaço segue aberto para manifestação.


Uma disputa que começou em fevereiro


André Mendonça herdou o caso Master de Dias Toffoli em fevereiro deste ano. Nas primeiras decisões como relator, em 19 de fevereiro, o ministro determinou que apenas os policiais diretamente envolvidos na investigação tivessem acesso às informações, com sigilo “inclusive em relação aos superiores hierárquicos”, o que incluiria Andrei Rodrigues. Seria um movimento para limitar a influência do diretor-geral na apuração, vista com desconfiança pela ala de André Mendonça. Nos bastidores, teria pesado a percepção de Mendonça de que informações sensíveis chegavam antes ao comando da PF, o que passou a causar “um certo desconforto”, segundo uma fonte do STF, até mesmo entre os juízes lotados no gabinete do ministro.


Andrei Rodrigues, diretor-geral da PF, enviou ofício à AGU em 23 de julho de 2026


Em 22 de maio, na investigação sobre fraudes no INSS (Operação Sem Desconto), da qual Mendonça também era o relator, o ministro teria reagido a uma mudança na chefia do caso e exigido ser avisado de qualquer nova alteração na equipe. Em 15 de maio, na semana anterior à exigência de Mendonça, o comando da PF trocou a área responsável pelos inquéritos do INSS: o caso foi transferido da Divisão de Repressão a Crimes Previdenciários (DPrev) para a Coordenação de Inquéritos em Tribunais Superiores (Cinq) …
